## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (Python, C++, Go or Java), or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree in an industry setting.
* Experience in Machine Learning or Artificial Intelligence.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience with large-scale data processing pipelines and tools (e.g., Flume, SQL).
* Experience with anti-abuse systems, fraud detection, or security.
* Experience with AI driven development and Agentic workflows.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Software Engineer on the Google DeepMind Abuse team, you will be at the forefront of protecting Google DeepMind's Generative AI products from misuse. You will design, build, and scale account-centric detection systems within the GenAI Safety Platform, ensuring a safe experience for millions of users while enabling the full potential of our AI models

You will be working on a mission-critical team at the intersection of Generative AI and abuse fighting, one of the most dynamic and challenging fields at Google. This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the safety and trustworthiness of groundbreaking AI products used by millions, develop innovative solutions to novel abuse vectors specific to GenAI, and contribute to a safer online environment and ensure AI is used responsibly.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

### Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain components of our account-centric abuse detection systems on the GenAI Safety Platform.
* Develop and implement classifiers to identify policy-violation and abusive behavior in near real-time, leveraging account-level signals.
* Collaborate with other engineers to integrate detection systems with enforcement mechanisms like strikes and limited disabilities.
* Analyze data to understand abuse patterns and improve the effectiveness of our detection methods.
* Write and test production-quality code, and participate in code reviews.

* Laurea in Informatica o campo tecnico correlato, o equivalente esperienza pratica. * 2 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (Python, C++, Go o Java), o 1 anno di esperienza con una laurea avanzata in un ambiente di settore. * Esperienza in Machine Learning o Intelligenza Artificiale.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Esperienza con condotte e strumenti di elaborazione dati su larga scala (ad esempio Flume, SQL). * Esperienza con sistemi antiabuso, rilevamento di frodi o sicurezza. * Esperienza con lo sviluppo guidato da AI e flussi di lavoro di ben 24 c.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia avanti.

Come ingegnere software del team di Google DeepMind Abuse, sarete in prima linea nella protezione dei prodotti Generative AI di Google DeepMind da abusi. Progetterete, costruirete e scalerete sistemi di rilevamento account-centrici all'interno della piattaforma di sicurezza GenAI, garantendo un'esperienza sicura per milioni di utenti, consentendo al contempo il pieno potenziale dei nostri modelli AI

Lavorerai su un team mission-critical all'incrocio tra Generative AI e gli abusi, uno dei campi più dinamici e impegnativi di Google. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità unica di definire la sicurezza e l'affidabilità dei prodotti AI innovativi utilizzati da milioni di persone, sviluppare soluzioni innovative per nuovi vettori di abusi specifici per GenAI, e contribuire a un ambiente online più sicuro e garantire che gli AI siano utilizzati in modo responsabile.

Il team Core costruisce la base tecnica dietro i prodotti di punta di Google. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori degli elementi di progettazione sottostanti, piattaforme di sviluppo, componenti di prodotto e infrastrutture di Google. Questi sono i punti di partenza essenziali per esperienze eccellenti, sicure e coerenti per i nostri utenti e per guidare il ritmo di innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso i prodotti di Google.s per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti.

Come team di core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda.

Responsabilità

* Progettare, costruire e mantenere i componenti dei nostri sistemi di rilevamento degli abusi focalizzati sul conto sulla piattaforma di sicurezza GenAI. * Sviluppare e implementare classificatori per identificare la violazione delle politiche e il comportamento abusivo in tempo quasi reale, sfruttando i segnali a livello di account. * 21a con altri ingegneri per integrare i sistemi di rilevamento con meccanismi di applicazione come scioperi e disabilità limitate. * Analizzare i dati per capire i modelli di abuso e migliorare l'efficacia dei nostri metodi di rilevamento. * Scrivere e testare codice di qualità della produzione, e partecipare a recensioni di codice.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (Python, C++, Go or Java), or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree in an industry setting.
* Experience in Machine Learning or Artificial Intelligence.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience with large-scale data processing pipelines and tools (e.g., Flume, SQL).
* Experience with anti-abuse systems, fraud detection, or security.
* Experience with AI driven development and Agentic workflows.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Software Engineer on the Google DeepMind Abuse team, you will be at the forefront of protecting Google DeepMind's Generative AI products from misuse. You will design, build, and scale account-centric detection systems within the GenAI Safety Platform, ensuring a safe experience for millions of users while enabling the full potential of our AI models

You will be working on a mission-critical team at the intersection of Generative AI and abuse fighting, one of the most dynamic and challenging fields at Google. This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the safety and trustworthiness of groundbreaking AI products used by millions, develop innovative solutions to novel abuse vectors specific to GenAI, and contribute to a safer online environment and ensure AI is used responsibly.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

### Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain components of our account-centric abuse detection systems on the GenAI Safety Platform.
* Develop and implement classifiers to identify policy-violation and abusive behavior in near real-time, leveraging account-level signals.
* Collaborate with other engineers to integrate detection systems with enforcement mechanisms like strikes and limited disabilities.
* Analyze data to understand abuse patterns and improve the effectiveness of our detection methods.
* Write and test production-quality code, and participate in code reviews.

_\_bar\\_chart\___Mitte

Mittel

Erfahrung mit treibenden Fortschritten, Problemlösungen und Mentoring von mehr Nachwuchsteammitgliedern; tieferes Fachwissen und angewandtes Wissen in relevanten Bereichen.

Anwenden

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen (Python, C++, Go oder Java) oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss in einem Branchen-Setting. * Erfahrung in Machine Learning oder Künstliche Intelligenz.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Erfahrung mit großen Datenverarbeitungspipelines und -tools (z.B. Flume, SQL). * Erfahrung mit Anti-Missbrauch-Systemen, Betrugserkennung oder Sicherheit. * Erfahrung mit KI-getriebener Entwicklung und Agentic-Workflows.

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion mit Informationen und anderen Menschen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Als Software-Ingenieur des Google DeepMind-Missbrauchs-Teams sind Sie an der Spitze des Schutzes der Generativen KI-Produkte von Google DeepMind vor Missbrauch. Sie werden kontozentrierte Erkennungssysteme innerhalb der GenAI Safety Platform entwerfen, bauen und skalieren, um Millionen von Nutzern ein sicheres Erlebnis zu bieten und gleichzeitig das volle Potenzial unserer KI-Modelle zu ermöglichen.

Sie arbeiten an einem geschäftskritischen Team an der Schnittstelle zwischen Generativer KI und Missbrauchsbekämpfung, einem der dynamischsten und anspruchsvollsten Bereiche bei Google. Diese Rolle bietet die einzigartige Möglichkeit, die Sicherheit und Vertrauenswürdigkeit von bahnbrechenden KI-Produkten zu gestalten, die von Millionen eingesetzt werden, innovative Lösungen für neuartige GenAI-spezifische Missbrauchsvektoren zu entwickeln und zu einer sichereren Online-Umgebung beizutragen und dafür zu sorgen, dass KI verantwortungsvoll eingesetzt wird.

Das Core-Team baut die technische Grundlage hinter Google, seinen Flaggschiff-Produkten. Wir sind Eigentümer und Befürworter der zugrunde liegenden Designelemente, Entwicklerplattformen, Produktkomponenten und Infrastruktur bei Google. Dies sind die wesentlichen Bausteine für hervorragende, sichere und kohärente Erfahrungen für unsere Nutzer und treiben das Innovationstempo für jeden Entwickler. Wir suchen über Google, Produkte, um zentrale Lösungen zu bauen, technische Barrieren zu brechen und bestehende Systeme zu stärken.

Als Core-Team haben wir ein Mandat und eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, wichtige technische Entscheidungen im Unternehmen zu beeinflussen.

Zuständigkeiten

* Entwickeln, bauen und pflegen Sie Komponenten unserer kontozentrierten Missbrauchserkennungssysteme auf der GenAI Safety Platform. * Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Klassifikatoren, um politische Verleumdung und missbräuchliches Verhalten in Echtzeit zu identifizieren, indem Sie Kontosignale nutzen. * Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Ingenieuren, um Erkennungssysteme mit Durchsetzungsmechanismen wie Streiks und eingeschränkten Behinderungen zu integrieren. * Analysieren Sie Daten, um Missbrauchsmuster zu verstehen und die Wirksamkeit unserer Erkennungsmethoden zu verbessern. * Schreiben und testen Sie Produktionsqualitätscode und nehmen Sie an Code-Bewertungen teil.

Moyenne

Expérience de la conduite des progrès, de la résolution des problèmes et du mentorat de membres d'équipes juniors; expertise approfondie et connaissances appliquées dans le domaine pertinent.

Appliquer

Titres minimums:

* Licence en informatique ou domaine technique connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 2 ans d'expérience avec le développement de logiciels dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation (Python, C++, Go ou Java), ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé dans un contexte industriel. * Expérience en apprentissage automatique ou intelligence artificielle.

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* Expérience avec les pipelines et les outils de traitement de données à grande échelle (p. ex. Flume, SQL). * Expérience avec les systèmes anti-abus, la détection de fraude ou la sécurité. * Expérience avec le développement d'IA et les workflows Agentic.

Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les uns avec les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel de l'équipe Google DeepMind Abuse, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la protection des produits AI Generative de Google DeepMind contre les abus. Vous concevrez, construisez et échafaudez des systèmes de détection centrés sur les comptes au sein de la plateforme de sécurité GenAI, assurant une expérience sécuritaire pour des millions d'utilisateurs tout en permettant le plein potentiel de nos modèles AI

Vous travaillerez sur une équipe critique de mission à l'intersection de l'IA Generative et de la lutte contre les abus, l'un des domaines les plus dynamiques et les plus stimulants chez Google. Ce rôle offre l'occasion unique de façonner la sécurité et la fiabilité des produits d'IA révolutionnaires utilisés par des millions, de développer des solutions innovantes aux nouveaux vecteurs d'abus spécifiques à GenAI, et de contribuer à un environnement en ligne plus sûr et de garantir que l'IA est utilisée de façon responsable.

L'équipe Core construit la base technique derrière Google, les produits phares. Nous sommes propriétaires et défenseurs des éléments de conception sous-jacents, plates-formes de développement, composants de produits, et l'infrastructure de Google. Ce sont les éléments de construction essentiels pour des expériences excellentes, sûres et cohérentes pour nos utilisateurs et de conduire le rythme de l'innovation pour chaque développeur.

En tant qu'équipe de base, nous avons un mandat et une occasion unique d'influencer les décisions techniques importantes dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

Responsabilités

* Concevoir, construire et maintenir les composants de nos systèmes de détection d'abus centrés sur les comptes sur la plateforme de sécurité GenAI. * Développer et mettre en œuvre des classificateurs pour identifier les comportements de violation de politique et de comportement abusif en temps quasi réel, en tirant parti des signaux de niveau de compte. * Collaborer avec d'autres ingénieurs pour intégrer des systèmes de détection avec des mécanismes d'application comme les grèves et les handicaps limités. * Analyser les données pour comprendre les modèles d'abus et améliorer l'efficacité de nos méthodes de détection. * Ecrire et tester le code de qualité de production, et participer à des revues de code.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

_info\_outline_

X Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; New York, NY, USA.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in a technical security role (e.g., security engineering, security research, DevSecOps, or incident response).
* Experience with vulnerability assessments and vulnerability exploitation.

* Experience in security and ethical hacking.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of offensive security experience (red teaming, vulnerability research, pen testing, etc - not just running tools) in Cloud environment.
* Experience with Artificial Intelligence.
* Ability to develop custom exploits, modify existing exploits, and bypass security controls.
* Fluency in programming languages relevant to security and cloud automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).
* Being able to clearly and concisely articulate complex technical findings, risks, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a part of the Product Security Engineering team within the Cloud CISO organization, you will be responsible for helping ensure every product in Cloud is as secure as it can be, and increasing the security in the infrastructure underlying all our products.

As a part of the Cloud Red Team, your mission is to evaluate our ability to detect and respond to known and unknown threats by simulating real-world adversaries that aim to compromise and persist in Cloud’s infrastructure. In short: Hack Cloud to make hacking Cloud harder.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $211000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

### Responsibilities

* Collaborate within a highly-skilled team to plan and execute attacks against Cloud’s products, services, and infrastructure, while building tools and infrastructure to support attacker goals.
* Identify vulnerabilities and attack vectors proactively within Cloud services, configurations, and related technologies.
* Engage in threat modeling exercises to identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in Cloud architectures and deployments.
* Develop realistic and relevant attack scenarios based on current threat intelligence and the specific Cloud environment being assessed.
* Create reports that capture the insights gained during an attack and present them to a variety of audiences

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

_info\_outline_

X Nota: Applicandovi a questa posizione avrete la possibilità di condividere la vostra posizione di lavoro preferita da: Zürich, Svizzera; New York, NY, USA.

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di sicurezza tecnica (ad esempio, ingegneria della sicurezza, ricerca sulla sicurezza, DevSecOps, o risposta agli incidenti). * Esperienza con valutazioni della vulnerabilità e sfruttamento della vulnerabilità.

* Esperienza in sicurezza e hacking etico.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* 3 anni di esperienza di sicurezza offensiva (rosso tearing, ricerca sulla vulnerabilità, test della penna, ecc. - non solo strumenti in esecuzione) in ambiente Cloud. * Esperienza con l'intelligenza artificiale. * Capacità di sviluppare exploit personalizzati, modificare exploit esistenti e bypassare i controlli di sicurezza. * Fluenza nei linguaggi di programmazione rilevanti per la sicurezza e l'automazione cloud (ad esempio, Python, Go, Bash). * Essere in grado di articolare in modo chiaro e conciso complessi risultati tecnici, rischi e strategie di bonifica sia per il pubblico tecnico che non tecnico, sia per iscritto.

Riguardo il lavoro

Il nostro team di Sicurezza lavora per creare e mantenere l'ambiente operativo più sicuro per gli utenti e gli sviluppatori di Google. Gli ingegneri di sicurezza lavorano con apparecchiature di rete e monitorano attivamente i nostri sistemi per attacchi e intrusioni. In questo ruolo, si lavorerà anche con gli ingegneri del software per identificare e correggere in modo proattivo difetti di sicurezza e vulnerabilità.

Come parte del team di Product Security Engineering dell'organizzazione CISO Cloud, sarà responsabile dell'assistenza per garantire che ogni prodotto in Cloud sia sicuro quanto può essere e per aumentare la sicurezza nell'infrastruttura che sta alla base di tutti i nostri prodotti.

Come parte del Cloud Red Team, la vostra missione è valutare la nostra capacità di rilevare e rispondere a minacce conosciute e sconosciute simulando adversari del mondo reale che mirano a compromettere e persistere nell'infrastruttura Cloud. In breve: Hack Cloud per rendere più difficile la condivisione del cloud.La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori quali le competenze, l'esperienza e l'istruzione o formazione pertinenti.

USA: $147000 - $211000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefit

Learn più sui benefici a Google.

Responsabilità

* Il team altamente qualificato organizza ed esegue attacchi contro prodotti, servizi e infrastrutture Cloud.s, mentre costruisce strumenti e infrastrutture per supportare gli obiettivi degli attacchi. * Identificare vulnerabilità e vettori di attacco proattivamente all'interno dei servizi Cloud, delle configurazioni e delle tecnologie correlate. * Impegnarsi in esercizi di modellazione delle minacce per identificare potenziali percorsi di attacco e debolezze nelle architetture e nelle implementazioni Cloud. * Sviluppare scenari di attacco realistici e pertinenti basati sull'intelligenza delle minacce attuali e sull'ambiente specifico Cloud in fase di valutazione.

* Creare report che catturano le intuizioni acquisite durante un attacco e presentarle a una varietà di pubblico

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer technischen Sicherheitsfunktion (z.B. Sicherheitstechnik, Sicherheitsforschung, DevSecOps oder Incident Response). * Erfahrung mit Sicherheitsbewertungen und Vulnerabilitätsauswertungen.

* Erfahrung in Sicherheit und ethischen Hacking.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* 3 Jahre offensive Sicherheitserfahrung (rote Teaming, Sicherheitsforschung, Pen-Testing, etc. - nicht nur laufende Tools) in der Cloud-Umgebung. * Erfahrung mit Künstlicher Intelligenz. * Fähigkeit, eigene Exploits zu entwickeln, bestehende Exploits zu ändern und Sicherheitskontrollen zu umgehen. * Fluency in Programmiersprachen, die für Sicherheit und Cloud-Automatisierung relevant sind (z.B. Python, Go, Bash). * Die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Erkenntnisse, Risiken und Sanierungsstrategien sowohl für technische als auch nicht-technische Zielgruppen sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich klar und prägnant zu artikulieren.

Über den Job

Unser Security-Team arbeitet daran, die sicherste Betriebsumgebung für die Nutzer und Entwickler von Google zu schaffen und zu erhalten. Security Engineers arbeitet mit Netzwerkausrüstungen zusammen und überwacht aktiv unsere Systeme auf Angriffe und Eindringlinge. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie auch mit Software-Ingenieuren zusammen, um Sicherheitsmängel und Schwachstellen proaktiv zu identifizieren und zu beheben.

Als Teil des Product Security Engineering Teams innerhalb der Cloud CISO Organisation sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, dass jedes Produkt in Cloud so sicher wie möglich ist und die Sicherheit in der Infrastruktur, die allen unseren Produkten zugrunde liegt, erhöht wird.

Als Teil des Cloud Red Teams ist es Ihre Aufgabe, unsere Fähigkeit zu bewerten, bekannte und unbekannte Bedrohungen zu erkennen und zu reagieren, indem wir echte Gegner simulieren, die Kompromisse eingehen und in der Cloud,s-Infrastruktur bestehen bleiben.Kurzum: Hack Cloud, um Hacking Cloud zu erschweren.Individuelle Bezahlung wird durch Faktoren wie jobbezogene Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und relevante Ausbildung oder Ausbildung bestimmt.

US: $147.000 - $211000 (USD) + 15% Bonusziel + Eigenkapital + Leistungen

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Vorteile bei Google.

Zuständigkeiten

* In einem hochqualifizierten Team zusammenarbeiten, um Angriffe auf Cloud-Produkte, -Dienste und -Infrastrukturen zu planen und durchzuführen, während Tools und -infrastrukturen zur Unterstützung von Angriffszielen erstellt werden. * Schwachstellen und Angriffsvektoren proaktiv innerhalb von Cloud-Diensten, -Konfigurationen und verwandten Technologien identifizieren. * In Bedrohungsmodellierungsübungen eingreifen, um potenzielle Angriffspfade und -schwächen in Cloud-Architekturen und -Bereitstellungen zu identifizieren. * Realistische und relevante Angriffsszenarien entwickeln, die auf der aktuellen Bedrohungsintelligenz und der spezifischen Cloud-Umgebung basieren, die bewertet werden.

* Erstellen Sie Berichte, die die während eines Angriffs gewonnenen Erkenntnisse erfassen und präsentieren Sie sie einer Vielzahl von Zielgruppen

Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de sécurité technique (p. ex., ingénierie de la sécurité, recherche sur la sécurité, DevSecOps, ou intervention d'incident). * Expérience en évaluation de la vulnérabilité et en exploitation de la vulnérabilité.

* Expérience en sécurité et en piratage éthique.

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* 3 ans d'expérience en sécurité offensive (équipe rouge, recherche sur la vulnérabilité, tests de stylo, etc. - pas seulement des outils de fonctionnement) dans l'environnement Cloud. * Expérience en intelligence artificielle. * Capacité de développer des exploits personnalisés, de modifier les exploits existants et de contourner les contrôles de sécurité. * Fluence dans les langages de programmation relatifs à la sécurité et à l'automatisation du cloud (p. ex., Python, Go, Bash). * Être capable d'articuler clairement et de façon concise des constatations techniques complexes, des risques et des stratégies d'assainissement pour les publics techniques et non techniques, tant verbalement que par écrit.

Sur le travail

Notre équipe de sécurité travaille à créer et maintenir l'environnement d'exploitation le plus sûr pour les utilisateurs et les développeurs de Google. Ingénieurs de sécurité travaillent avec des équipements de réseau et surveillent activement nos systèmes pour les attaques et les intrusions.

En tant que membre de l'équipe de la sécurité des produits de l'organisation Cloud CISO, vous serez responsable de la sécurité de chaque produit dans Cloud et de l'amélioration de la sécurité dans l'infrastructure sous-jacente à tous nos produits.

En tant que membre de l'équipe Cloud Red, votre mission est d'évaluer notre capacité à détecter et à répondre aux menaces connues et inconnues en simulant des adversaires du monde réel qui visent à compromettre et à persister dans l'infrastructure Cloud.En bref: Hack Cloud pour rendre le piratage Cloud plus difficile.Paiement individuel est déterminé par des facteurs tels que les compétences liées à l'emploi, l'expérience, et l'éducation ou la formation pertinente.

US: 147000 $ - 211000 $ (USD) + 15% de bonus + capitaux propres + avantages

En savoir plus sur les avantages chez Google.

Responsabilités

* Collaborer au sein d'une équipe hautement qualifiée pour planifier et exécuter des attaques contre Cloud, ses produits, ses services et ses infrastructures, tout en construisant des outils et des infrastructures pour soutenir les objectifs des attaquants. * Identifier les vulnérabilités et les vecteurs d'attaque proactives au sein des services, configurations et technologies Cloud. * Activer des exercices de modélisation des menaces pour identifier les trajectoires et les faiblesses potentielles des architectures et déploiements Cloud. * Élaborer des scénarios d'attaque réalistes et pertinents basés sur les informations actuelles sur les menaces et l'environnement Cloud en cours d'évaluation.

* Créer des rapports qui saisissent les idées acquises lors d'une attaque et les présentent à divers publics

Apply

_info\_outline_

Google welcomes people with disabilities.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; Paris, France.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud-native architecture in technical delivery, customer engineering, or enterprise architecture and in a customer-facing or enterprise support role.
* Experience in technical deployment planning, architecture orchestration, or technical delivery management.
* Experience with enterprise integrations (APIs, ECMs, identity), Cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience with programming languages, API integration, debugging, or enterprise systems design.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.

### Preferred qualifications:

* L300/L400 level technical proficiency or relevant AI/ML and Cloud architecture certifications.
* Experience guiding customers through the architectural and organizational transformations needed to deploy production-grade AI models or agents in enterprise environments.
* Technical experience in one or more of the following: Cloud AI solutions, Enterprise Data Management, Data Analytics, Infrastructure Modernization, Security, or Cloud Networking.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solution.
* Proven track record interfacing directly with core product and engineering organizations to escalate product bugs, advocate for feature gaps, and unblock systemic deployments.

### About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer (AI OCE), you will drive initial and ongoing revenue ramp for our enterprise customers, clearing complex blockers and ensuring they realize maximum business value from their Cloud AI investments faster. You will manage and execute the technical deployment plan, transitioning scoped license agreements into robust production deployments by providing authoritative technical leadership to customers and partners.

You will have a direct impact on the velocity and incremental consumption of customer agreements, leading to accelerated value realization, higher adoption, and future expansion opportunities. You will blend sales acumen, enterprise architecture knowledge, technical engagement, and technical delivery management to prove and scale the value of Google's premier Cloud AI solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

France: €100000 - €103000 (EUR) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

### Responsibilities

* Develop and orchestrate a structured, end-to-end technical deployment plan across customer and partner teams. Lead upfront architectural validation to ensure integration readiness before execution begins.
* Dive into complex technical workflows to diagnose, debug, and resolve implementation roadblocks. Act as a technical bridge to core product and support engineering teams to eliminate systemic friction and accelerate customer delivery.
* Drive and track the progress of the initial and ongoing ramp of Cloud AI license agreements, guiding enterprise workloads from agreement to active consumption as rapidly and securely as possible.
* Partner collaboratively with Account an CEs team during the technical evaluation phase of key deals to ensure proposed Cloud AI solutions are architected for viable, scalable long-term adoption.
* Drive sustainable, secure Cloud AI product usage to help customers continuously realize quantifiable business outcomes and secure future contract renewals.

Nota: Applicando a questa posizione avrai l'opportunità di condividere la tua posizione di lavoro preferita da: Zürich, Switzerland; Paris, France. ### Titolo minimo: * Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 6 anni di esperienza con l'architettura cloud-native nella fornitura tecnica, nell'ingegneria dei clienti o nell'architettura aziendale e in un ruolo di supporto per il cliente o aziendale. * Esperienza nella pianificazione di distribuzione tecnica, orchestrazione di architettura, o gestione della consegna tecnica. * Esperienza con le integrazioni aziendali (API, ECM, identità), infrastrutture cloud e implementazioni di modelli AI/ML. * Esperienza con linguaggi di programmazione, integrazione API, debugging o progettazione di sistemi aziendali. * Scopri le principali strategie di consegna tecnica, i sistemi di debug e l'interazione con le organizzazioni di prodotto/ingegneria. ### Qualifiche preferenziali: * La competenza tecnica di livello L300/L400 o le relative certificazioni di architettura AI/ML e Cloud. * Esperienza che guida i clienti attraverso le trasformazioni architettoniche e organizzative necessarie per implementare modelli AI di livello di produzione o agenti in ambienti aziendali. * Esperienza tecnica in una o più delle seguenti soluzioni: Cloud AI, Enterprise Data Management, Data Analytics, Modernizzazione delle infrastrutture, Sicurezza o Cloud Networking. * Capacità di immergersi profondamente in nuovi problemi tecnici, decifrare ambiguità estrema, diagnosticare bug, ed emergere con soluzione architettonica credibile. * Provato record di traccia che si confronta direttamente con le organizzazioni core del prodotto e dell'ingegneria per escalare i bug dei prodotti, sostenere le lacune di funzionalità e sbloccare le implementazioni sistemiche. ### Riguardo al lavoro Il team di Google Cloud Platform aiuta i clienti a trasformare e costruire ciò che è prossimo per il loro business - tutto con la tecnologia costruita nel cloud. I nostri prodotti sono sviluppati per la sicurezza, l'affidabilità e la scalabilità, eseguendo lo stack completo dall'infrastruttura alle applicazioni ai dispositivi e all'hardware. I nostri team sono dedicati ad aiutare i nostri clienti - sviluppatori, piccole e grandi imprese, istituzioni educative e agenzie governative - vedere i benefici della nostra tecnologia prendono vita. Come parte di un team imprenditoriale in questo business in rapida crescita, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella comprensione delle esigenze dei nostri clienti e contribuire a plasmare il futuro delle imprese di tutte le dimensioni utilizzare la tecnologia per connettersi con clienti, dipendenti e partner. In qualità di AI Outcome Customer Engineer (AI OCE), guiderai la rampa di ricavi iniziale e continuativa per i nostri clienti aziendali, sgomberando blocchi complessi e assicurando loro di realizzare il massimo valore commerciale dai loro investimenti Cloud AI più velocemente. Potrai gestire ed eseguire il piano di implementazione tecnica, transizione accordi di licenza di portata in robuste implementazioni di produzione, fornendo una leadership tecnica autorevole a clienti e partner. Avrete un impatto diretto sulla velocità e il consumo incrementale degli accordi con i clienti, portando ad una maggiore realizzazione del valore, ad una maggiore adozione e a future opportunità di espansione. Si fonderà acume di vendita, conoscenza dell'architettura aziendale, impegno tecnico e gestione della consegna tecnica per dimostrare e scalare il valore delle soluzioni Cloud AI leader di Google. Google Cloud accelera la capacità di ogni organizzazione di trasformare digitalmente il suo business e l'industria.
• Offriamo soluzioni di livello enterprise che sfruttano la tecnologia all'avanguardia di Google e gli strumenti che aiutano gli sviluppatori a costruire in modo più sostenibile. I clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori si rivolgono a Google Cloud come partner affidabile per consentire la crescita e risolvere i loro problemi aziendali più critici. La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti. Francia: €100000 - €103000 (EUR) + 42,86% target bonus + equità + prestazioni Ulteriori informazioni sui benefici a Google. ### responsabilità * Sviluppare e orchestrare un piano di distribuzione tecnico strutturato e end-to-end tra i team di clienti e partner. Condurre una validazione architettonica avanzata per garantire la disponibilità di integrazione prima dell'inizio dell'esecuzione. * Immergiti in complessi flussi di lavoro tecnici per diagnosticare, debug e risolvere i blocchi stradali di implementazione. Agire come un ponte tecnico per il core del prodotto e sostenere i team di ingegneria per eliminare l'attrito sistemico e accelerare la consegna del cliente. * Guidare e monitorare il progresso della rampa iniziale e continua degli accordi di licenza Cloud AI, guidando carichi di lavoro aziendali dall'accordo al consumo attivo il più rapidamente e in modo sicuro possibile. * Partner collaborativo con Account un team CEs durante la fase di valutazione tecnica delle principali offerte per garantire che le soluzioni proposte Cloud AI siano progettate per una valida e scalabile adozione a lungo termine. * Guidare l'utilizzo sostenibile e sicuro del prodotto Cloud AI per aiutare i clienti a realizzare continuamente risultati di business quantificabili e garantire future rinnovi contrattuali.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; Paris, France.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud-native architecture in technical delivery, customer engineering, or enterprise architecture and in a customer-facing or enterprise support role.
* Experience in technical deployment planning, architecture orchestration, or technical delivery management.
* Experience with enterprise integrations (APIs, ECMs, identity), Cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience with programming languages, API integration, debugging, or enterprise systems design.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.

### Preferred qualifications:

* L300/L400 level technical proficiency or relevant AI/ML and Cloud architecture certifications.
* Experience guiding customers through the architectural and organizational transformations needed to deploy production-grade AI models or agents in enterprise environments.
* Technical experience in one or more of the following: Cloud AI solutions, Enterprise Data Management, Data Analytics, Infrastructure Modernization, Security, or Cloud Networking.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solution.
* Proven track record interfacing directly with core product and engineering organizations to escalate product bugs, advocate for feature gaps, and unblock systemic deployments.

### About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer (AI OCE), you will drive initial and ongoing revenue ramp for our enterprise customers, clearing complex blockers and ensuring they realize maximum business value from their Cloud AI investments faster. You will manage and execute the technical deployment plan, transitioning scoped license agreements into robust production deployments by providing authoritative technical leadership to customers and partners.

You will have a direct impact on the velocity and incremental consumption of customer agreements, leading to accelerated value realization, higher adoption, and future expansion opportunities. You will blend sales acumen, enterprise architecture knowledge, technical engagement, and technical delivery management to prove and scale the value of Google's premier Cloud AI solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

France: €100000 - €103000 (EUR) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

### Responsibilities

* Develop and orchestrate a structured, end-to-end technical deployment plan across customer and partner teams. Lead upfront architectural validation to ensure integration readiness before execution begins.
* Dive into complex technical workflows to diagnose, debug, and resolve implementation roadblocks. Act as a technical bridge to core product and support engineering teams to eliminate systemic friction and accelerate customer delivery.
* Drive and track the progress of the initial and ongoing ramp of Cloud AI license agreements, guiding enterprise workloads from agreement to active consumption as rapidly and securely as possible.
* Partner collaboratively with Account an CEs team during the technical evaluation phase of key deals to ensure proposed Cloud AI solutions are architected for viable, scalable long-term adoption.
* Drive sustainable, secure Cloud AI product usage to help customers continuously realize quantifiable business outcomes and secure future contract renewals.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience conducting security assessments, penetration testing, threat modeling, or vulnerability testing.
* 2 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.
* 2 years of coding experience in one or more general purpose languages (e.g., C++, Go, or Python).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Relevant work experience in penetration testing or red teaming.
* Software development experience in C++, Go, or Python.
* Foundation in, and in-depth technical knowledge of, security engineering, computer and network security, authentication, security protocols and applied cryptography.
* Hands-on operational experience detecting and responding to facing top-tier adversaries in defense of an international enterprise environment.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

In this role, you will think and act like an attacker to improve Alphabet's ability to detect, respond to and thwart real-world attackers. As a part of the growing Red Team, we are looking for engineers who can perform realistic offensive security exercises to simulate real attacks and to test and improve our detection and response capabilities.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

### Responsibilities

* Identify security issues and implement and design security controls, tools, and services to improve security systems and processes.
* Collaborate with a team of highly skilled hackers to plan and lead realistic offensive security exercises.
* Build tools and infrastructure to support our exercises.
* Design controls and improvements to sharpen capabilities to defend against attackers in close co-operation with the teams responsible for implementing them.
* Document and present results to a variety of target audiences, ranging from highly technical engineers over non-technical subject matter experts to executive leadership.

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* 2 anni di esperienza nella valutazione della sicurezza, nella valutazione della penetrazione, nella modellazione delle minacce o nella verifica della vulnerabilità. * 2 anni di esperienza con i protocolli di sicurezza, sicurezza informatica e di rete. * 2 anni di esperienza di codifica in uno o più linguaggi a scopo generale (ad esempio, C++, Go, o Python).

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Esperienza lavorativa rilevante in test di penetrazione o in team rosso. * Esperienza di sviluppo software in C++, Go, o Python. * Fondamento e conoscenza tecnica approfondita di, ingegneria di sicurezza, sicurezza di computer e rete, autenticazione, protocolli di sicurezza e crittografia applicata. * Esperienza operativa Hands-on che rileva e risponde a fronte di adversari di alto livello in difesa di un ambiente imprenditoriale internazionale.

Riguardo il lavoro

Il nostro team di Sicurezza lavora per creare e mantenere l'ambiente operativo più sicuro per gli utenti e gli sviluppatori di Google. Gli ingegneri di sicurezza lavorano con apparecchiature di rete e monitorano attivamente i nostri sistemi per attacchi e intrusioni. In questo ruolo, si lavorerà anche con gli ingegneri del software per identificare e correggere in modo proattivo difetti di sicurezza e vulnerabilità.

In questo ruolo, penserete e agirete come un attaccante per migliorare la capacità di Alfabeto di rilevare, rispondere e contrastare gli attaccanti del mondo reale. Come parte del team rosso in crescita, siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che possono eseguire esercizi di sicurezza offensivi realistici per simulare attacchi reali e per testare e migliorare le nostre capacità di rilevamento e risposta.Il team di base costruisce la base tecnica dietro i prodotti di punta di Google.s. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori per gli elementi di progettazione, piattaforme di sviluppatori, componenti dei prodotti e l'infrastruttura di Google.

Questi sono i punti di partenza essenziali per esperienze eccellenti, sicure e coerenti per i nostri utenti e guidare il ritmo dell'innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso Google.s prodotti per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti. Come il team di core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda.

Responsabilità

* Identificare problemi di sicurezza e implementare e progettare controlli di sicurezza, strumenti e servizi per migliorare i sistemi e i processi di sicurezza. * 21a con un team di hacker altamente qualificati per pianificare e condurre esercizi di sicurezza offensivi realistici. * Costruire strumenti e infrastrutture per supportare i nostri esercizi. * Progettare controlli e miglioramenti per affinare le capacità di difesa contro gli attaccanti in stretta collaborazione con i team responsabili per l'implementazione di loro.

* Documentare e presentare i risultati a una varietà di destinatari, che vanno da ingegneri altamente tecnici su esperti non tecnici materia materia alla leadership esecutiva.

Mittel

Anwenden

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Sicherheitsbewertungen, Penetrationstests, Bedrohungsmodellierung oder Vulnerabilitätstests. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Sicherheitstechnik, Computer- und Netzwerksicherheits- und Sicherheitsprotokollen. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Codierung in einer oder mehreren allgemeinen Zwecksprachen (z.B. C++, Go oder Python).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Relevante Arbeitserfahrung in Penetrationstests oder rotem Teaming. * Software-Entwicklungserfahrung in C++, Go oder Python. * Grundlagen und fundierte technische Kenntnisse in Sicherheitstechnik, Computer- und Netzwerksicherheit, Authentifizierung, Sicherheitsprotokolle und angewandte Kryptographie. * Hands-on-Betriebserfahrung, die auf die Bewältigung von Top-Antworten zur Verteidigung eines internationalen Unternehmensumfelds reagiert.

Über den Job

Unser Security-Team arbeitet daran, die sicherste Betriebsumgebung für die Nutzer und Entwickler von Google zu schaffen und zu erhalten. Security Engineers arbeitet mit Netzwerkausrüstungen zusammen und überwacht aktiv unsere Systeme auf Angriffe und Eindringlinge. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie auch mit Software-Ingenieuren zusammen, um Sicherheitsmängel und Schwachstellen proaktiv zu identifizieren und zu beheben.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie denken und wie ein Angreifer zu handeln, um Alphabets Fähigkeit zu verbessern, zu erkennen, reagieren und zu vereiteln real-world Angreifer. Als Teil des wachsenden Red Team, suchen wir nach Ingenieuren, die realistische Offensive Sicherheitsübungen durchführen können, um reale Angriffe zu simulieren und zu testen und unsere Erkennungs-und Reaktionsfähigkeiten zu verbessern.Das Core Team baut die technische Grundlage hinter Google, s Flaggschiff-Produkte. Wir sind Eigentümer und Befürworter für die zugrunde liegenden Design-Elemente, Entwickler-Plattformen, Produktkomponenten und Infrastruktur bei Google.

Dies sind die wesentlichen Bausteine für hervorragende, sichere und kohärente Erfahrungen für unsere Nutzer und treiben das Innovationstempo für jeden Entwickler. Wir suchen über Google hinweg, Produkte, um zentrale Lösungen zu entwickeln, technische Barrieren zu überwinden und bestehende Systeme zu stärken. Als Core-Team haben wir ein Mandat und eine einzigartige Möglichkeit, wichtige technische Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen zu beeinflussen.

Zuständigkeiten

* Identifizieren Sie Sicherheitsprobleme und implementieren und entwerfen Sie Sicherheitskontrollen, Werkzeuge und Dienstleistungen, um Sicherheitssysteme und -prozesse zu verbessern. * Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team von hoch qualifizierten Hackern, um realistische Offensive Sicherheitsübungen zu planen und zu führen. * Bauen Sie Werkzeuge und Infrastruktur, um unsere Übungen zu unterstützen. * Design-Steuerungen und Verbesserungen, um Fähigkeiten zu schärfen, um Angreifer in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams, die für ihre Umsetzung verantwortlich sind, zu verteidigen.

* Dokumentieren und präsentieren Sie Ergebnisse für eine Vielzahl von Zielgruppen, von hochtechnischen Ingenieuren über nicht-technische Fachexperten bis zur Führungsführung.

Titres minimums:

C++, Go ou Python).

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* Expérience professionnelle pertinente dans les tests de pénétration ou l'équipement rouge. * Expérience de développement logiciel en C++, Go ou Python. * Fondation et connaissances techniques approfondies de, ingénierie de la sécurité, sécurité informatique et réseau, authentification, protocoles de sécurité et cryptographie appliquée. * Expérience opérationnelle pratique de détection et de réponse face aux adversaires de premier niveau dans la défense d'un environnement d'entreprise international.

Sur le travail

Notre équipe de sécurité travaille à créer et maintenir l'environnement d'exploitation le plus sûr pour les utilisateurs et les développeurs de Google. Ingénieurs de sécurité travaillent avec des équipements de réseau et surveillent activement nos systèmes pour les attaques et les intrusions.

Dans ce rôle, vous penserez et agirez comme un attaquant pour améliorer la capacité d'Alphabet à détecter, répondre et contrecarrer les attaquants du monde réel.Dans le cadre de l'équipe rouge en pleine croissance, nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui peuvent effectuer des exercices de sécurité offensive réalistes pour simuler les attaques réelles et tester et améliorer nos capacités de détection et de réponse.L'équipe Core construit la base technique derrière Google, les produits phares.

Nous regardons les produits Google pour construire des solutions centrales, éliminer les obstacles techniques et renforcer les systèmes existants. En tant qu'équipe de base, nous avons un mandat et une occasion unique d'influer sur les décisions techniques importantes dans l'entreprise.

Responsabilités

* Identifier les problèmes de sécurité et mettre en œuvre et concevoir des contrôles, des outils et des services de sécurité pour améliorer les systèmes et les processus de sécurité. * Collaborer avec une équipe de pirates hautement qualifiés pour planifier et diriger des exercices de sécurité offensive réalistes. * Construire des outils et une infrastructure pour soutenir nos exercices. * Concevoir des contrôles et des améliorations pour aiguiser les capacités de défense contre les agresseurs en étroite collaboration avec les équipes responsables de leur mise en oeuvre.

* Documenter et présenter les résultats à divers publics cibles, allant des ingénieurs hautement techniques aux experts non techniques en matière de matière jusqu'au leadership exécutif.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
* 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

### About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.

### Responsibilities

* Work with partner teams (e.g., Engineers, Program Managers, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) into Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for one or more teams.
* Define product roadmaps by operationalizing strategy.
* Develop and secure buy-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
* Validate the market size and opportunity (e.g., user-based, strategic opportunity, business).
* Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti o ruolo tecnico connesso. * 2 anni di esperienza che prendono prodotti tecnici dal concepimento al lancio (ad esempio, ideazione all'esecuzione, end-to-end, 0 a 1, ecc.).

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Laurea magistrale in un campo tecnologico o di business related. * 3 anni di esperienza in una funzione o ruolo aziendale (ad esempio, marketing strategico, operazioni aziendali, consulenza). * 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di preparazione e presentazione tecnica alla leadership esecutiva. * 2 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software o ingegneria. * 2 anni di esperienza lavorando in modo interfunzionale con ingegneria, UX / UI, finanza commerciale, e altri stakeholder. * 1 anno di esperienza in leadership tecnica.

Riguardo il lavoro

A Google, mettiamo i nostri utenti al primo posto. Il mondo è sempre in continua evoluzione, quindi abbiamo bisogno di Product Manager che si adattino continuamente ed eccitati per lavorare su prodotti che colpiscono milioni di persone ogni giorno.

In questo ruolo, lavorerete in modo cross-funzionale per guidare i prodotti dal concepimento al lancio collegando i mondi tecnici e aziendali. Si possono abbattere problemi complessi in fasi che guidano lo sviluppo dei prodotti.

Una delle tante ragioni per cui Google porta costantemente prodotti innovativi e in continua evoluzione sul mercato è il lavoro collaborativo che facciamo nella Gestione dei Prodotti. Il nostro team lavora a stretto contatto con ingegneri creativi, designer, marketer, ecc. per aiutare a progettare e sviluppare tecnologie che migliorino l'accesso alle informazioni del mondo. Siamo responsabili della guida dei prodotti durante tutto il ciclo di esecuzione, concentrandosi in particolare sull'analisi, posizionamento, packaging, promozione e sartoria delle nostre soluzioni ai nostri utenti.

Gli utenti vengono prima a Google. In nessun luogo è questo più importante che sul nostro team di pubblicità e commercio: riteniamo che gli annunci e le informazioni commerciali possono essere molto utili per i nostri utenti se queste informazioni sono pertinenti a ciò che i nostri utenti desiderano trovare o fare. Advertisers in tutto il mondo utilizzano Google Ads per promuovere i loro prodotti; editori utilizzano AdSense per servire annunci pertinenti sul loro sito web; e le imprese di tutto il mondo utilizzano i nostri prodotti (come Google Shopping, e Google Wallet) per supportare le loro aziende online e portare gli utenti nei loro negozi offline.

Stiamo costantemente innovando per offrire le opportunità più efficaci di pubblicità e commercio di domani.

Responsabilità

* Lavorare con i team partner (ad esempio, ingegneri, Program Manager, UX) durante la progettazione e lo sviluppo del prodotto per implementare i requisiti per trasformare i documenti di requisiti di prodotto (PRD) in obiettivi e risultati chiave (OKR) per uno o più team. * Definire le tabelle di marcia del prodotto tramite strategia operativa. * Sviluppare e garantire il buy-in per un obiettivo di prodotto che identifica, definisce e supporta la narrazione e la direzione del prodotto globale, ottenendo un risultato superiore alla somma delle sue parti. * Convalidare le dimensioni del mercato e opportunità (ad esempio, user-based, opportunità strategica, business).

* Guidare lancia, manutenzione e pensionamento in collaborazione con altri team e stakeholder interfunzionali.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
* 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

### About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.

### Responsibilities

* Work with partner teams (e.g., Engineers, Program Managers, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) into Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for one or more teams.
* Define product roadmaps by operationalizing strategy.
* Develop and secure buy-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
* Validate the market size and opportunity (e.g., user-based, strategic opportunity, business).
* Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Mittel

Erfahrung mit treibenden Fortschritten, Problemlösungen und Mentoring von mehr Nachwuchsteammitgliedern; tieferes Fachwissen und angewandtes Wissen in relevanten Bereichen.

Anwenden

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder damit zusammenhängende technische Rolle. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten von der Konzeption bis zur Markteinführung (z.B. Ideen bis zur Ausführung, Ende bis Ende, 0 bis 1, etc.).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss in einem Technologie- oder geschäftsbezogenen Bereich. * 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Geschäftsfunktion oder Rolle (z.B. strategisches Marketing, Geschäftsbetrieb, Beratung). * 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Rolle, die technische Präsentationen an die Führungsspitze vorbereitet und liefert. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung oder -technik. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung, die funktionsübergreifend mit Engineering, UX/UI, Vertriebsfinanzierung und anderen Stakeholdern arbeitet. * 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der technischen Führung.

Über den Job

Bei Google setzen wir unsere Nutzer an die erste Stelle. Die Welt verändert sich ständig, deshalb brauchen wir Produktmanager, die sich ständig anpassen und begeistert sind, an Produkten zu arbeiten, die jeden Tag Millionen Menschen betreffen.

In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend, um Produkte von der Konzeption bis zum Launch zu führen, indem Sie die technische und geschäftliche Welt miteinander verbinden.

Einer der vielen Gründe, warum Google konsequent innovative, weltweit wechselnde Produkte auf den Markt bringt, ist die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team im Produktmanagement. Unser Team arbeitet eng mit kreativen Ingenieuren, Designern, Vermarktern usw. zusammen, um Technologien zu entwickeln, die den Zugang zu den Informationen der Welt verbessern. Wir sind verantwortlich für die Produktführung während des gesamten Ausführungszyklus, wobei wir uns speziell auf die Analyse, Positionierung, Verpackung, Förderung und Anpassung unserer Lösungen an unsere Nutzer konzentrieren.

Die Nutzer kommen zuerst bei Google. Nirgendwo ist dies wichtiger als bei unserem Werbe- und Commerce-Team: Wir glauben, dass Werbung und kommerzielle Informationen für unsere Nutzer sehr nützlich sein können, wenn diese Informationen relevant für das, was unsere Nutzer finden oder tun möchten. Inserenter weltweit verwenden Google Ads, um ihre Produkte zu fördern; Verlage verwenden AdSense, um relevante Anzeigen auf ihrer Website zu bedienen; und Unternehmen auf der ganzen Welt nutzen unsere Produkte (wie Google Shopping und Google Wallet), um ihre Online-Unternehmen zu unterstützen und Benutzer in ihre Offline-Shops zu bringen.

Wir sind ständig innovativ, um die effektivsten Werbe- und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten von morgen zu bieten.

Zuständigkeiten

* Arbeiten Sie mit Partnerteams (z.B. Ingenieuren, Programmmanagern, UX) während des Produktdesigns und der Entwicklung, um die Anforderungen umzusetzen, um Produktanforderungen Dokumente (PRDs) in Ziele und Schlüsselergebnisse (OKRs) für ein oder mehrere Teams zu verwandeln. * Definieren Sie Produktfahrpläne durch operative Strategie. * Entwickeln und sichern Sie Buy-In für ein Produktziel, das die gesamte Produktnarrative und -richtung identifiziert, definiert und unterstützt, und ein Ergebnis erzielen, das größer ist als die Summe seiner Teile. * Validieren Sie die Marktgröße und -möglichkeit (z.B. benutzerbasierte, strategische Chance, Geschäft).

* Drive startet, Wartung und Ruhestand in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen cross-funktionalen Teams und Stakeholdern.

Appliquer

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de produits ou le rôle technique connexe. * 2 ans d'expérience en prenant des produits techniques de la conception au lancement (par exemple, idée à l'exécution, bout à bout, 0 à 1, etc.).

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* Maîtrise en technologie ou en commerce. * 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction ou un rôle d'entreprise (p. ex. marketing stratégique, opérations commerciales, conseil). * 3 ans d'expérience dans la préparation et la prestation de présentations techniques au leadership exécutif. * 2 ans d'expérience en développement ou en ingénierie de logiciels. * 2 ans d'expérience en ingénierie, UX/UI, financement des ventes et autres parties prenantes. * 1 an d'expérience en leadership technique.

Sur le travail

Chez Google, nous mettons nos utilisateurs en premier. Le monde est toujours en train de changer, donc nous avons besoin de Gestionnaires de produits qui s'adaptent continuellement et sont excités de travailler sur des produits qui affectent des millions de personnes chaque jour.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez de façon interfonctionnelle pour guider les produits de la conception au lancement en reliant les mondes technique et commercial. Vous pouvez décomposer les problèmes complexes en étapes qui conduisent au développement de produits.

Google apporte constamment des produits innovants et changeants sur le marché en raison du travail collaboratif que nous faisons dans la gestion des produits. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs créatifs, des concepteurs, des marketeurs, etc. pour aider à concevoir et développer des technologies qui améliorent l'accès aux informations du monde. Nous sommes responsables de guider les produits tout au long du cycle d'exécution, en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse, le positionnement, l'emballage, la promotion et la adaptation de nos solutions à nos utilisateurs.

Les utilisateurs viennent en premier chez Google. Nulle part n'est plus important que dans notre équipe Publicité et Commerce : nous croyons que les annonces et les informations commerciales peuvent être très utiles pour nos utilisateurs si ces informations sont pertinentes à ce que nos utilisateurs souhaitent trouver ou faire. Les annonceurs utilisent Google Ads dans le monde entier pour promouvoir leurs produits; les éditeurs utilisent AdSense pour diffuser des annonces pertinentes sur leur site Web; et les entreprises du monde entier utilisent nos produits (comme Google Shopping, et Google Wallet) pour soutenir leurs entreprises en ligne et amener les utilisateurs dans leurs magasins hors ligne.

## Software Engineer III, AI/ML, Sensor Fusion, XR

_share_
