* _email_ Email a friend

_corporate\_fare_ Google _place_ Zürich, Switzerland

_\_bar\\_chart\__ Mid

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

* 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

* Experience with sensor fusion, C++, or computer vision.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
We work in the research-to-product space, going 0-to-1 on foundational visual-inertial fusion for odometry, localization, mapping, along with calibration, image processing for head tracking. This work powers AndroidXR devices, including GalaxyXR and upcoming devices such as Aura.

Furthermore, working alongside a group of Perception researchers and engineers, we push the boundaries of how these technologies can support delightful AR experiences, driving ideation and development cross-functionally to chart the future capabilities needed by our AR devices.

For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Write product or system development code.

* Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

* Implement solutions in one or more specialized ML areas, utilize ML infrastructure, and contribute to model optimization and data processing.

Riguardo il lavoro I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web.
• Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno. Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s ha bisogno di opportunità per cambiare team e progetti come voi e il nostro business veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri di essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di assumere nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia in avanti. Lavoriamo nello spazio ricerca-prodotto, andando 0-to-1 sulla fusione visuale-inerziale fondamentale per odometria, localizzazione, mappatura, insieme con la calibrazione, elaborazione delle immagini per il head tracking. Questo lavoro alimenta i dispositivi AndroidXR, tra cui GalaxyXR e i dispositivi imminenti come Aura. Inoltre, lavorando insieme a un gruppo di ricercatori e ingegneri Perception, mettiamo i limiti di come queste tecnologie possano supportare esperienze AR deliziose, guidando ideazione e sviluppo in modo cross-funzionale per tracciare le capacità future necessarie dai nostri dispositivi AR. Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da I progressi nel calcolo, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. Il team XR di Google è in prima linea nel prossimo grande salto. la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di nuovi dispositivi. Si tratta di reimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo intorno a noi. Stiamo costruendo un futuro dove dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali intelligenti e cuffie abbinano con AI utile per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversative e contestuali. Responsabilità * Scrivi il codice di sviluppo del prodotto o del sistema. * Il gruppo ha inoltre fornito un'analisi dei risultati ottenuti con il progetto e il codice per garantire le migliori pratiche tra le tecnologie disponibili (ad esempio, linee guida sullo stile, codici di controllo, accuratezza, verificabilità ed efficienza). * Contribuire alla documentazione esistente o contenuti didattici e adattare i contenuti sulla base di aggiornamenti di prodotto/programma e feedback degli utenti. * Problemi di prodotto o sistema di triage e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete o operazioni di servizio e qualità. * Implementa soluzioni in una o più aree ML specializzate, utilizza l'infrastruttura ML, e contribuisce all'ottimizzazione dei modelli e all'elaborazione dei dati.

Über den Job Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion mit Informationen und anderen Menschen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Wechseln von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Vollstapel zu übernehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. Wir arbeiten im Forschungs-to-Product-Raum, gehen 0-to-1 auf die grundlegende visuelle-inertial Fusion für die Odimetrie, Lokalisierung, Mapping, zusammen mit Kalibrierung, Bildbearbeitung für Kopfverfolgung. Diese Arbeit macht AndroidXR-Geräte, einschließlich GalaxyXR und kommenden Geräten wie Aura. Darüber hinaus schieben wir gemeinsam mit einer Gruppe von Perception-Forschern und Ingenieuren die Grenzen, wie diese Technologien reizvolle AR-Erlebnisse, Antriebsideen und Entwicklung funktionsübergreifend unterstützen können, um die zukünftigen Fähigkeiten unserer AR-Geräte zu erfassen. Seit Jahrzehnten hat die Revolution der Computern unsere Welt neu geprägt, angetrieben von Durchbrüche in Computing, Konnektivität, Mobil, und jetzt, KI. Googles XR-Team ist an der Spitze des nächsten großen Sprungs – die Konvergenz von KI und XR. Dies ist mehr als nur neue Geräte – es geht darum, neu zu denken, wie wir mit der Welt um uns herum interagieren. leichte XR-Geräte wie Smart-Brillen und Headsets verbinden sich mit hilfreicher KI, um menschliche Intelligenz zu erweitern und personalisierte, gesprächs- und kontextbezogene Erlebnisse zu bieten. Zuständigkeiten * Schreiben Sie Produkt- oder Systementwicklungscode. * Zusammenarbeit mit Gleichaltrigen und Stakeholdern durch Design- und Code-Reviews, um bewährte Verfahren unter den verfügbaren Technologien zu gewährleisten (z.B. Stilrichtlinien, Code-Checking, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz). * Tragen Sie zu bestehenden Dokumentation oder Bildungsinhalten bei und passen Sie Inhalte auf der Grundlage von Produkt/Programm-Updates und Benutzerfeedback an. * Triage Produkt- oder Systemprobleme und Debug/Track/Resolve durch Analyse der Quellen von Problemen und der Auswirkungen auf Hardware, Netzwerk oder Service-Betriebe und Qualität. * Implementierung von Lösungen in einem oder mehreren spezialisierten ML-Bereichen, Nutzung der ML-Infrastruktur und Beitrag zur Modelloptimierung und Datenverarbeitung.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience programming in Python.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, or a related field with a focus on machine learning.
* Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX) and edge frameworks (e.g. LiteRT).
* Experience with polygonal mesh representations and skeletal animation pipelines.
* Proficiency with Python/C++ .

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. In this role, you will be building a future where lightweight XR devices pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Research and develop algorithms and models for tracking and synthesizing facial motion from multimodal inputs.
* Work with data collection and synthesis teams to gather high-quality training data.
* Optimize models and algorithms to run on low-power XR devices in real time.
* Propose KPIs and metrics, and incorporate user feedback into the algorithm and model design.
* Be able to work alongside other software engineers and research scientists to deliver production-ready models and pipelines.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience programming in Python.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, or a related field with a focus on machine learning.
* Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX) and edge frameworks (e.g. LiteRT).
* Experience with polygonal mesh representations and skeletal animation pipelines.
* Proficiency with Python/C++ .

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. In this role, you will be building a future where lightweight XR devices pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

## Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience building and shipping production-grade AI-driven solutions to external or internal customers using Python, TypeScript or comparable languages.
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions with business stakeholders and engineering teams to define AI and hardware infrastructure requirements.
* Experience designing and building AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Experience building pipelines for structured, unstructured data, incorporating vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise-grade AI solutions.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.
* Knowledge of large language model native metrics (tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

### About the job

As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder bridging the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality for our customers. You will function as a builder-consultant, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment.

In this role, you will manage blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white-glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as the lead developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.
* Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and technical friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
* Drive engineering excellence by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

Sur le travail En tant qu'ingénieur de GenAI Forward Deployed chez Google Cloud, vous serez un constructeur intégré qui comblera l'écart entre les produits IA frontière et la réalité de production pour nos clients. C'est un moment passionnant pour rejoindre Google Cloud, l'équipe Go-To-Market, qui mène la révolution de l'IA pour les entreprises dans le monde entier. Vous excellerez en tirant parti de la crédibilité de Google, un héritage basé sur l'invention de technologies fondamentales et éprouvée à l'échelle. Nous vous fournirons le portefeuille d'IA le plus avancé au monde, y compris les modèles de Gemini frontière, et la plateforme complète de l'IA Vertex, vous aidant à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires. Rejoignez-nous pour être le catalyseur de notre mission, stimuler la réussite client et définir la nouvelle ère du cloud – le marché est à vous. ## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience building and shipping production-grade AI-driven solutions to external or internal customers using Python, TypeScript or comparable languages.
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions with business stakeholders and engineering teams to define AI and hardware infrastructure requirements.
* Experience designing and building AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Experience building pipelines for structured, unstructured data, incorporating vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise-grade AI solutions.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.
* Knowledge of large language model native metrics (tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

### About the job

As a Senior GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder bridging the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality for our customers. You will function as a builder-consultant, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment.

In this role, you will manage blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white-glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as the lead developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.
* Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and technical friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for engineering teams.
* Drive engineering excellence by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

# Mezzogiorno

Provate i progressi di guida, risolvendo i problemi, e guidando più membri del team junior; competenze più profonde e conoscenze applicate all'interno di area rilevante.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Laurea in Ingegneria, Informatica, un campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza pratica.
* 5 anni di esperienza costruzione e spedizione di produzione-grade AI-driven soluzioni a clienti esterni o interni utilizzando Python, TypeScript o lingue comparabili.
* Esperienza di sessioni di scoperta tecnica leader con gli stakeholder aziendali e i team di ingegneria per definire i requisiti di infrastruttura AI e hardware.
* Scopri la progettazione e la costruzione di sistemi AI su piattaforme cloud (ad esempio Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Condutture costruttive per dati strutturati e non strutturati, che incorporano database vettoriali e architetture di tipo Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) per alimentare soluzioni AI di livello enterprise.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in AI, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
* Esperienza nell'implementazione di sistemi multi-agenti utilizzando framework (ad esempio, LangGraph, CrewAI, o il Kit di sviluppo agente di Google (ADK)) e modelli come ReAct, auto-riflessione e delegazione gerarchica.
* Conoscenza delle metriche native del modello di lingua grande (tokens/sec, cost-per-request) e tecniche per ottimizzare la gestione dello stato e il tracciamento granulare.

### Riguardo al lavoro

In qualità di Senior GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer presso Google Cloud, sarai un costruttore incorporato che corrode il divario tra i prodotti AI di frontiera e la realtà di produzione per i nostri clienti. Potrai funzionare come costruttore-consulente, spostando oltre l'architettura di alto livello al codice, debug, e nave congiuntamente soluzioni agentic su misura direttamente all'interno dell'ambiente del cliente.

In questo ruolo, gestirete i bloccanti alla produzione, tra cui risolvere le complessità di integrazione, problemi di disponibilità dei dati e problemi di gestione dello stato che impediscono all'IA di raggiungere la maturità di livello enterprise. Con l'integrazione con i conti, servirai un duplice scopo: fornire lo spiegamento di sistemi AI e agire come un loop di feedback critico, trasformando le intuizioni sul campo del mondo reale nella futura roadmap di prodotto di Google Cloud.

E 'un momento emozionante per unire il team Go-To-Market di Google Cloud, leader la rivoluzione AI per le aziende in tutto il mondo. Potrai eccellere sfruttando la credibilità del marchio di Google, un'eredità costruita sull'invenzione delle tecnologie di base e provata in scala. Vi forniremo il portafoglio AI più avanzato al mondo, compresi i modelli di frontiera Gemini, e la piattaforma completa Vertex AI, aiutandovi a risolvere i problemi aziendali. Siamo una cultura collaborativa che offre accesso diretto alle menti ingegneristiche e di ricerca di DeepMind, consentendoti di risolvere le sfide dei clienti. Unisciti a noi per essere il catalizzatore per la nostra missione, guidare il successo del cliente e definire la nuova era cloud - il mercato è tuo.

### responsabilità

* Servire come sviluppatore principale per applicazioni AI, passando da prototipi rapidi ai flussi di lavoro agentici di qualità produttiva (ad esempio, sistemi multi-agenti, server di protocollo di contesto modello) che guidano il ritorno misurabile sugli investimenti.
* Architetto e codifica il tessuto connettivo tra i prodotti AI di Google e l'infrastruttura live del cliente, tra cui API, data silos legacy e perimetro di sicurezza.
* Costruire condotte di valutazione ad alte prestazioni e quadri di osservabilità per garantire che i sistemi agentici soddisfino requisiti rigorosi per l'accuratezza, la sicurezza e la latenza.
* Identificare modelli di campo ripetibili e punti di attrito tecnico nello stack AI di Google, convertirli in moduli riutilizzabili o richieste di funzionalità di prodotto per team di ingegneria.
* Guidare l'eccellenza dell'ingegneria da mentoring talento, co-costruire con i team del cliente, e influenzare le strategie interfunzionali per migliorare le capacità tecniche organizzative.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience building and shipping production-grade AI-driven solutions to external or internal customers using Python, TypeScript or comparable languages.
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions with business stakeholders and engineering teams to define AI and hardware infrastructure requirements.
* Experience designing and building AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Experience building pipelines for structured, unstructured data, incorporating vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise-grade AI solutions.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.
* Knowledge of large language model native metrics (tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

### About the job

As a Senior GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder bridging the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality for our customers. You will function as a builder-consultant, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment.

In this role, you will manage blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white-glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as the lead developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.
* Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and technical friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for engineering teams.
* Drive engineering excellence by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

Beantragen

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik, einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
* 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau und Versand von produktionsorientierten KI-basierten Lösungen für externe oder interne Kunden mit Python, TypeScript oder vergleichbaren Sprachen.
* Erleben Sie führende technische Entdeckungssitzungen mit Geschäftsbeteiligten und Engineering-Teams, um AI- und Hardware-Infrastrukturanforderungen zu definieren.
* Erleben Sie das Entwerfen und Erstellen von KI-Systemen auf Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Erleben Sie Pipelines für strukturierte, unstrukturierte Daten, die Vektordatenbanken und Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-ähnliche Architekturen zur Unterstützung von KI-Lösungen für Unternehmen integrieren.

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss oder PhD in AI, Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
* Erleben Sie die Implementierung von Multiagentensystemen mit Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, CrewAI oder Googles Agent Development Kit (ADK)) und Mustern wie ReAct, Selbstreflexion und hierarchische Delegation.
* Kenntnisse über native Metriken für große Sprachmodelle (Tokens/Sec, Cost-per-Request) und Techniken zur Optimierung des Zustandsmanagements und des granularen Tracing.

### Über den Job

Als Senior GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer bei Google Cloud sind Sie ein Embedded Builder, der die Lücke zwischen bahnbrechenden KI-Produkten und produktionsorientierter Realität für unsere Kunden schließt. Sie fungieren als Builder-Consultant und gehen über die High-Level-Architektur hinaus, um maßgeschneiderte agentische Lösungen direkt in der Kundenumgebung zu kodieren, zu debuggen und gemeinsam zu versenden.

In dieser Rolle verwalten Sie Blocker für die Produktion, einschließlich der Lösung von Integrationskomplexitäten, Datenbereitschaftsproblemen und Problemen des Zustandsmanagements, die verhindern, dass KI die Reife erreicht. Durch die Einbettung in Konten erfüllen Sie einen doppelten Zweck: Die Bereitstellung von KI-Systemen mit weißen Handschuhen und als kritische Feedbackschleife, die reale Einblicke in die zukünftige Produkt-Roadmap von Google Cloud umwandelt.

Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, dem Go-To-Market-Team von Google Cloud beizutreten, das die KI-Revolution für Unternehmen weltweit anführt. Sie werden sich auszeichnen, indem Sie die Glaubwürdigkeit der Marke von Google nutzen - ein Vermächtnis, das auf der Erfindung grundlegender Technologien basiert und sich in großem Maßstab bewährt hat. Wir bieten Ihnen das weltweit fortschrittlichste KI-Portfolio, einschließlich Frontier Gemini-Modelle, und die komplette Vertex AI-Plattform, die Ihnen hilft, Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen. Wir sind eine kollaborative Kultur, die direkten Zugang zu DeepMinds Engineering- und Forschungsteams bietet und Sie in die Lage versetzt, Kundenherausforderungen zu lösen. Seien Sie mit uns der Katalysator für unsere Mission, treiben Sie den Kundenerfolg voran und definieren Sie die neue Cloud-Ära – der Markt gehört Ihnen.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Dienen Sie als führender Entwickler für KI-Anwendungen und wechseln Sie von schnellen Prototypen zu agentischen Workflows (z. B. Multiagentensysteme, Modellkontextprotokollserver), die einen messbaren Return on Investment erzielen.
* Erstellen und codieren Sie das Bindegewebe zwischen den KI-Produkten von Google und der Live-Infrastruktur des Kunden, einschließlich APIs, Legacy-Datensilos und Sicherheitsperimetern.
* Erstellen Sie leistungsstarke Bewertungspipelines und Beobachtbarkeits-Frameworks, um sicherzustellen, dass Agentensysteme strenge Anforderungen an Genauigkeit, Sicherheit und Latenz erfüllen.
* Identifizieren Sie wiederholbare Feldmuster und technische Reibungspunkte im KI-Stack von Google und konvertieren Sie sie in wiederverwendbare Module oder Produktfunktionsanforderungen für Engineering-Teams.
* Steigern Sie die technische Exzellenz, indem Sie Talente betreuen, mit Kundenteams zusammenarbeiten und funktionsübergreifende Strategien beeinflussen, um die organisatorischen technischen Fähigkeiten zu verbessern.

* Expérimentez des séances de découverte technique avec des intervenants commerciaux et des équipes d'ingénierie pour définir les exigences en matière d'IA et d'infrastructure matérielle.
* Expérience de la conception et de la construction de systèmes d'IA sur des plateformes cloud (par exemple, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Expérimentez la construction de pipelines pour des données structurées et non structurées, intégrant des bases de données vectorielles et des architectures de génération retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) à des solutions d'IA de qualité entreprise.

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise ou doctorat en intelligence artificielle, informatique ou domaine technique connexe.
* Expérience de la mise en œuvre de systèmes multi-agents à l'aide de cadres (p. ex. LangGraph, CrewAI ou GoogleS Agent Development Kit (ADK)) et de modèles comme ReAct, auto-réflexion et délégation hiérarchique.
* Connaissance des paramètres natifs du modèle de grande langue (tokens/sec, coût par demande) et des techniques d'optimisation de la gestion de l'état et du traçage granulaire.

### Sur le travail

En tant qu'ingénieur senior GenAI Forward déployé chez Google Cloud, vous serez un constructeur intégré qui comblera l'écart entre les produits d'IA frontière et la réalité de qualité de production pour nos clients. Vous fonctionnerez comme un constructeur-consultant, allant au-delà de l'architecture de haut niveau pour coder, déboguer et expédier conjointement des solutions agentiques sur mesure directement dans l'environnement du client.

Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez les bloqueurs à la production, y compris résoudre les complexités d'intégration, les problèmes de préparation aux données, et les problèmes de gestion d'État qui empêchent l'IA d'atteindre la maturité de l'entreprise. En vous inscrivant dans des comptes, vous aurez un double objectif : fournir un déploiement blanc de systèmes d'IA et agir comme une boucle de rétroaction critique, transformant les informations réelles sur le terrain en Google Cloud.

C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre l'équipe Go-To-Market de Google Cloud, qui mène la révolution de l'IA pour les entreprises du monde entier. Vous excellerez en tirant parti de la crédibilité de la marque de Google – un héritage fondé sur l'invention de technologies fondamentales et prouvé à l'échelle. Nous vous fournissons le portefeuille AI le plus avancé au monde, y compris les modèles frontière Gemini, et la plateforme Altex AI complète, vous aidant à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires. Nous sommes une culture collaborative offrant un accès direct aux esprits d'ingénierie et de recherche de DeepMind, vous permettant de résoudre les défis des clients. Rejoignez-nous pour être le catalyseur de notre mission, stimuler le succès client et définir la nouvelle ère du cloud – le marché est à vous.

### Responsabilités

* Servir de développeur principal pour les applications d'IA, passant de prototypes rapides à des workflows d'agents de production (p. ex. systèmes multi-agents, serveurs de protocole de contexte de modèle) qui permettent un retour sur investissement mesurable.
* Architecte et code le tissu conjonctif entre les produits d'IA de Google et l'infrastructure en direct du client, y compris les API, les silos de données hérités, et les périmètres de sécurité.
* Bâtir des pipelines d'évaluation de haute performance et des cadres d'observation pour s'assurer que les systèmes d'agents répondent à des exigences rigoureuses en matière de précision, de sécurité et de latence.
* Identifier les motifs de terrain répétables et les points de friction technique dans la pile d'IA de Google, les convertir en modules réutilisables ou en demandes de fonctionnalités de produits pour les équipes d'ingénierie.
* Favoriser l'excellence en génie en mentorant les talents, en collaborant avec les équipes clientes et en influant sur les stratégies interfonctionnelles pour améliorer les capacités techniques de l'organisation.

## Early

Experience completing work as directed, and collaborating with teammates; developing knowledge of relevant concepts and processes.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
* 1 year of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience with Information Retrieval, Ad Quality and Search Quality.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

### Responsibilities

* Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.
* Understand production systems, visualize, monitor, and optimize performance.
* Stay up-to-date with respect to latest tools and developments in infrastructure.

# Presto

Esperienza completando il lavoro come diretto e collaborando con i compagni di squadra; sviluppare la conoscenza di concetti e processi rilevanti.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.
* 1 anno di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio, Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
* 1 anno di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.
* 1 anno di esperienza costruzione e sviluppo di infrastrutture su larga scala o sistemi distribuiti.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Esperienza con Retrival delle informazioni, Qualità degli annunci e qualità della ricerca.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Google Google Ads sta aiutando il potere Internet aperto con la migliore tecnologia che collega e crea valore per le persone, editori, inserzionisti, e Google. Siamo costituiti da più team, la costruzione di prodotti pubblicitari di Google, tra cui ricerca, display, shopping, viaggi e pubblicità video, nonché analisi. I nostri team creano esperienze fidate tra persone e aziende con annunci utili. Aiutiamo a crescere le aziende di tutte le dimensioni da piccole imprese, a grandi marchi, ai creatori di YouTube, con efficaci strumenti di inserzionista che forniscono risultati misurabili. Permettiamo anche a Google di interagire con i clienti in scala.

### responsabilità

* Progetti propri end-to-end dall'idea iniziale alla progettazione, all'analisi e all'implementazione.
* Comprendere i sistemi di produzione, visualizzare, monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni.
* Resta aggiornato rispetto agli ultimi strumenti e sviluppi delle infrastrutture.

* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen (z.B. Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.
* 1 Jahr Erfahrung beim Aufbau und der Entwicklung großer Infrastrukturen oder verteilter Systeme.

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Erfahrung mit Information Retrieval, Anzeigenqualität und Suchqualität.

### Über den Job

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Google Ads unterstützt das offene Internet mit der besten Technologie, die Menschen, Publisher, Werbetreibende und Google verbindet und Mehrwert schafft. Wir bestehen aus mehreren Teams, die Google-Werbeprodukte entwickeln, einschließlich Such-, Anzeige-, Einkaufs-, Reise- und Videowerbung sowie Analysen. Unsere Teams schaffen vertrauenswürdige Erfahrungen zwischen Menschen und Unternehmen mit nützlichen Anzeigen. Wir helfen Unternehmen jeder Größe, von kleinen Unternehmen über große Marken bis hin zu YouTube-Erstellern, mit effektiven Werbetreibenden-Tools, die messbare Ergebnisse liefern. Wir ermöglichen es Google auch, mit Kunden in großem Maßstab zu interagieren.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Eigene Projekte end-to-end von der ersten Idee über Design, Analyse und Umsetzung.
* Verstehen Sie Produktionssysteme, visualisieren, überwachen und optimieren Sie die Leistung.
* Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über die neuesten Tools und Entwicklungen in der Infrastruktur.

## Début

Expérience de l'achèvement du travail selon les directives et collaboration avec les coéquipiers; connaissance des concepts et des processus pertinents.

Appliquer

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.
* 1 an d'expérience en développement logiciel dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation (p. ex. Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
* 1 an d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.
* 1 an d'expérience dans la construction et le développement d'infrastructures à grande échelle ou de systèmes distribués.

### Titres préférés:

* Expérience avec la récupération d'information, la qualité de la publicité et la qualité de la recherche.

### Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Google Ads aide à alimenter Internet ouvert avec la meilleure technologie qui connecte et crée de la valeur pour les gens, éditeurs, annonceurs, et Google. Nous sommes constitués de plusieurs équipes, la construction de Google de produits publicitaires, y compris la recherche, l'affichage, les achats, les voyages et la publicité vidéo, ainsi que l'analyse. Nos équipes créent des expériences de confiance entre les gens et les entreprises avec des annonces utiles. Nous aidons à faire croître les entreprises de toutes tailles, des petites entreprises aux grandes marques aux créateurs YouTube, avec des outils d'annonceurs efficaces qui fournissent des résultats mesurables. Nous permettons également à Google de dialoguer avec les clients à l'échelle.

### Responsabilités

* Les propres projets se terminent de l'idée initiale à la conception, l'analyse et la mise en oeuvre.
* Comprendre les systèmes de production, visualiser, surveiller et optimiser les performances.
* Restez informé des derniers outils et des derniers développements en matière d'infrastructure.

## Advanced

Apply

_info\_outline_

X Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: London, UK; Zürich, Switzerland.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in an analytical field (Engineering, Finance, Business) or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience in sales, consulting, or engineering within the financial services industry.
* 5 years of experience managing projects or accounts.
* Experience developing and executing multi-year business plans.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience with blockchain, DLT, or digital asset infrastructure in a financial services context.
* Experience with payments in a banking context.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding revenue or adoption targets.
* Expertise in commercial structuring, including pricing models and subscription-based revenue agreements.
* Demonstrated success in launching new products or entering new markets.
* Proven ability to manage partnerships with external financial institutions and "market makers".

### About the job

The Google Cloud Universal Ledger (GCUL) GTM team leads the early-stage rollout of our blockchain built for financial services. We aim to modernize global financial systems by providing a compliant, 24/7, programmable network that replaces inefficient legacy rails to boost capital efficiency, unlock faster cross-border payments, and power agentic finance workflows.

As a senior-level "playmaker," you will serve as the engine for GCUL adoption, identifying and supercharging opportunities within the financial services Industry. Operating under a specialist-led sales model, your bjective is to land initial transacting parties using three currencies to generate network density. You will translate your vision into "first-of-a-kind" agreements, leveraging "market makers" to pull financial ecosystems onto our platform. By providing a "credibly neutral" infrastructure, you will help institutions streamline multi-currency transfers without the compliance issues of public chains, establishing GCUL as the global standard for financial interoperability.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as a subject matter expert in financial infrastructure (payments, banking, capital markets) to guide infrastructure modernization and address friction points.
* Engage and influence C-level stakeholders across treasury, CTO, strategy, and payments functions to secure complex organizational decisions.
* Drive sales momentum from initial prospect interest to contract commitment, managing the full lifecycle from pilot to commercial rollout.
* Lead and close large, complex, Google Cloud-led FSI accounts, establishing long-term digital transformation partnerships.
* Build trust with executive teams at "market makers" and settlement banks to catalyze GCUL network adoption, collaborating with internal leadership to align deal structures.

X Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: London, UK; Zürich, Switzerland.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in an analytical field (Engineering, Finance, Business) or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience in sales, consulting, or engineering within the financial services industry.
* 5 years of experience managing projects or accounts.
* Experience developing and executing multi-year business plans.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience with blockchain, DLT, or digital asset infrastructure in a financial services context.
* Experience with payments in a banking context.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding revenue or adoption targets.
* Expertise in commercial structuring, including pricing models and subscription-based revenue agreements.
* Demonstrated success in launching new products or entering new markets.
* Proven ability to manage partnerships with external financial institutions and "market makers".

### About the job

The Google Cloud Universal Ledger (GCUL) GTM team leads the early-stage rollout of our blockchain built for financial services. We aim to modernize global financial systems by providing a compliant, 24/7, programmable network that replaces inefficient legacy rails to boost capital efficiency, unlock faster cross-border payments, and power agentic finance workflows.

As a senior-level "playmaker," you will serve as the engine for GCUL adoption, identifying and supercharging opportunities within the financial services Industry. Operating under a specialist-led sales model, your bjective is to land initial transacting parties using three currencies to generate network density. You will translate your vision into "first-of-a-kind" agreements, leveraging "market makers" to pull financial ecosystems onto our platform. By providing a "credibly neutral" infrastructure, you will help institutions streamline multi-currency transfers without the compliance issues of public chains, establishing GCUL as the global standard for financial interoperability.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as a subject matter expert in financial infrastructure (payments, banking, capital markets) to guide infrastructure modernization and address friction points.
* Engage and influence C-level stakeholders across treasury, CTO, strategy, and payments functions to secure complex organizational decisions.
* Drive sales momentum from initial prospect interest to contract commitment, managing the full lifecycle from pilot to commercial rollout.
* Lead and close large, complex, Google Cloud-led FSI accounts, establishing long-term digital transformation partnerships.
* Build trust with executive teams at "market makers" and settlement banks to catalyze GCUL network adoption, collaborating with internal leadership to align deal structures.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in security assessments.
* Experience with security.
* Experience with vulnerability assessment.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience in the AI security space, including research, exploits, and mitigations.
* Experience with threat modeling, data analytics, web applications.
* Experience mentoring junior researchers or leading technical security projects.
* Proficiency in programming for security research tasks such as scripting, tool development, and data analysis.
* Understanding of threat modeling, risk assessments or security assessments of products.
* Ability to read, understand, and analyze code as well as write small tools and scripts and excellent communication skills.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

The Information Security Engineering (ISE) team is dedicated to safeguarding Google's products and the data of billions of users. Security Engineers within ISE partner with engineering teams across Google to conduct in-depth security reviews throughout the product lifecycle.

The AI Product Security team (ISE PAIRS) is dedicated to ensuring the safe and secure development and deployment of Google's Artificial Intelligence products and features. Our mission is to protect our users and their data by identifying, mitigating, and preventing security vulnerabilities within Google's AI technologies. We embed security into the entire product lifecycle, from initial design and research through launch and beyond. We work on AI security, addressing novel threats and shaping best practices for the industry.

### Responsibilities

* Analyze AI products to uncover vulnerabilities and pinpoint opportunities for hardening, reporting findings to stakeholders for mitigation.
* Promote quality security practices across the organization, influencing software engineers, immediate colleagues, and beyond Google.
* Perform threat modeling of large and complex systems to quickly determine areas that warrant further investigation and direct security review.
* Conduct research to identify and mitigate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
* Leverage AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work to scale your own capabilities.

Qualificazioni preferite: * Esperienza nello spazio di sicurezza AI, tra cui ricerca, exploit e mitigazione. * Esperienza con modellistica delle minacce, analisi dei dati, applicazioni web. * Esperienza di mentoring giovani ricercatori o progetti di sicurezza tecnica leader. * Proficienza nella programmazione per attività di ricerca di sicurezza come scripting, sviluppo di strumenti, e l'analisi dei dati. * Comprensione di modellizzazione delle minacce, valutazioni dei rischi o valutazioni di sicurezza dei prodotti. * Capacità di leggere, capire e analizzare il codice, nonché scrivere piccoli strumenti e script e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione. Riguardo il lavoro Il nostro team di Sicurezza lavora per creare e mantenere l'ambiente operativo più sicuro per gli utenti e gli sviluppatori di Google. Gli ingegneri di sicurezza lavorano con apparecchiature di rete e monitorano attivamente i nostri sistemi per attacchi e intrusioni. In questo ruolo, si lavorerà anche con gli ingegneri del software per identificare e correggere in modo proattivo difetti di sicurezza e vulnerabilità. Il team di Information Security Engineering (ISE) è dedicato alla salvaguardia dei prodotti di Google e dei dati di miliardi di utenti. Gli ingegneri della sicurezza all'interno di ISE collaborano con team ingegneristici di Google per condurre approfondite revisioni della sicurezza durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Il team di sicurezza dei prodotti AI (ISE PAIRS) è dedicato a garantire lo sviluppo e la distribuzione sicuri e sicuri dei prodotti e delle funzionalità di Intelligenza Artificiale di Google. La nostra missione è proteggere i nostri utenti e i loro dati identificando, attenuando e prevenendo vulnerabilità di sicurezza all'interno delle tecnologie AI di Google. Abbiamo messo la sicurezza nell'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla progettazione iniziale e dalla ricerca attraverso il lancio e oltre. Responsabilità * Analizzare i prodotti AI per scoprire le vulnerabilità e individuare le opportunità per indurire, segnalare i risultati alle parti interessate per la mitigazione. * Promuovere pratiche di sicurezza di qualità in tutta l'organizzazione, influenzando ingegneri software, colleghi immediati, e oltre Google. * Eseguire modelli di minaccia di sistemi grandi e complessi per determinare rapidamente le aree che giustificano ulteriori indagini e recensione diretta della sicurezza. * Condurre ricerca per identificare e mitigare intere classi di vulnerabilità. * Leva strumenti AI e agenti nel vostro lavoro quotidiano per scalare le proprie capacità.

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 8 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.

* 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

* 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.

* Experience with data collection for Search/Geo-related usecases.
* Experience with leadership: nudging of team culture; coaching; team motivation.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.

### Responsibilities

* Provide technical leadership on high-impact projects.

* Own software components, systems, and features with significant impact, from initial brainstorming of project ideas to design, implementation, testing, launch and beyond.
* Manage the issues of scaling systems to support larger user bases.
* Help build and maintain our team culture of respect, collaboration, and attention to detail.
* Work closely with our Technical Lead, Product Manager, other cross-functional partners, and other teams within Commerce, Ads, Geo, and other areas.

# Avanzato

Esperienza che possiede i risultati e il processo decisionale, risolvere problemi ambigui e influenzare le parti interessate; possedere competenze in dominio.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

* 8 anni di esperienza di programmazione in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin o Go.
* 5 anni di test di esperienza e lancio di prodotti software.

* 3 anni di esperienza con progettazione e architettura software.
* Esperienza di integrare gli strumenti generativi AI o le interfacce LLM in flussi di lavoro.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Ingegneria, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

* 8 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.
* 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica leader team di progetto e la definizione di direzione tecnica.

* Esperienza con raccolta di dati per Casi di utilizzo correlati a Search/Geo.
* Esperienza con leadership: nudging della cultura del team; coaching; motivazione del team.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

People shop su Google più di un miliardo di volte al giorno - e il team di Commercio è responsabile per la costruzione delle esperienze che servono questi utenti. La missione per il commercio di Google è di essere una parte essenziale del viaggio di shopping per i consumatori - dall'ispirazione a un'esperienza di checkout semplice e sicura - e il posto migliore per i rivenditori / commercianti di connettersi con i consumatori. Supportiamo e collaboriamo con l’ecosistema del commercio, dai grandi rivenditori ai piccoli commercianti locali, per dare loro gli strumenti, la tecnologia e la scala per prosperare nel mondo digitale di oggi.

### responsabilità

* Fornire leadership tecnica su progetti ad alto impatto.

* I propri componenti software, sistemi e caratteristiche con un impatto significativo, dal brainstorming iniziale delle idee di progetto alla progettazione, implementazione, test, lancio e oltre.
* Gestire i problemi dei sistemi di scaling per supportare le basi utente più grandi.
* Aiuta a costruire e mantenere la nostra cultura di team di rispetto, collaborazione e attenzione ai dettagli.
* Lavorare a stretto contatto con il nostro Leader Tecnico, Product Manager, altri partner interfunzionali e altri team all'interno di Commerce, Ads, Geo e altre aree.

Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.

### Responsibilities

* Provide technical leadership on high-impact projects.

* Own software components, systems, and features with significant impact, from initial brainstorming of project ideas to design, implementation, testing, launch and beyond.
* Manage the issues of scaling systems to support larger user bases.
* Help build and maintain our team culture of respect, collaboration, and attention to detail.
* Work closely with our Technical Lead, Product Manager, other cross-functional partners, and other teams within Commerce, Ads, Geo, and other areas.

Beantragen

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* 8 Jahre Programmiererfahrung in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin oder Go.

### Über den Job

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Menschen kaufen mehr als eine Milliarde Mal am Tag bei Google ein - und das Commerce-Team ist dafür verantwortlich, die Erfahrungen zu erstellen, die diesen Nutzern dienen. Die Mission von Google Commerce ist es, ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Einkaufsreise für Verbraucher zu sein - von der Inspiration bis hin zu einem einfachen und sicheren Checkout-Erlebnis - und der beste Ort für Einzelhändler / Händler, um sich mit Verbrauchern zu verbinden. Wir unterstützen und arbeiten mit dem Commerce-Ökosystem zusammen, von großen Einzelhändlern bis hin zu kleinen lokalen Händlern, um ihnen die Werkzeuge, die Technologie und den Umfang zu geben, um in der heutigen digitalen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Bieten Sie technische Führung bei Projekten mit hoher Wirkung.

* Eigene Softwarekomponenten, Systeme und Funktionen mit erheblichen Auswirkungen, vom anfänglichen Brainstorming von Projektideen bis hin zu Design, Implementierung, Test, Launch und darüber hinaus.
* Verwalten Sie die Probleme beim Skalieren von Systemen, um größere Benutzerbasen zu unterstützen.
* Helfen Sie beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege unserer Teamkultur aus Respekt, Zusammenarbeit und Liebe zum Detail.
* Arbeiten Sie eng mit unserem Technical Lead, Produktmanager, anderen funktionsübergreifenden Partnern und anderen Teams in Commerce, Ads, Geo und anderen Bereichen zusammen.

## Avancé

Expérience de la propriété des résultats et de la prise de décision, de la résolution des problèmes ambigus et de l'influence des intervenants; expertise approfondie dans le domaine.

Appliquer

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

* 8 ans d'expérience en programmation C++, Java, Python, Kotlin ou Go.
* 5 ans d'expérience et lancement de logiciels.

* 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception et l'architecture de logiciels.
* Expérimentez l'intégration d'outils d'IA génériques ou d'interfaces LLM dans les workflows.

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise ou doctorat en génie, informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

* 8 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.
* 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de leadership technique des équipes de projet et la mise en place de la direction technique.

* Expérience de la collecte de données pour les cas d'utilisation liés à la recherche/à la géo.
* Expérience du leadership : nudging de la culture d'équipe; coaching; motivation de l'équipe.

### Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Les gens magasinent sur Google plus d'un milliard de fois par jour - et l'équipe du Commerce est responsable de construire les expériences qui servent ces utilisateurs. La mission de Google Commerce est d'être un élément essentiel du voyage d'achat pour les consommateurs - de l'inspiration à une expérience de caisse simple et sécurisée - et le meilleur endroit pour les détaillants / commerçants pour se connecter avec les consommateurs. Nous soutenons et collaborons avec l'écosystème commercial, des grands détaillants aux petits marchands locaux, pour leur donner les outils, la technologie et l'échelle pour prospérer dans le monde numérique d'aujourd'hui.

### Responsabilités

* Fournir un leadership technique sur les projets à impact élevé.

* Composants, systèmes et caractéristiques logiciels propres ayant un impact significatif, de la réflexion initiale des idées de projet à la conception, la mise en œuvre, l'essai, le lancement et au-delà.
* Gérer les problèmes des systèmes d'échelle pour soutenir des bases d'utilisateurs plus grandes.
* Aidez à bâtir et maintenir notre culture d'équipe de respect, de collaboration et d'attention aux détails.
* Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable technique, notre chef de produit, d'autres partenaires interfonctionnels et d'autres équipes du commerce, des publicités, de la géo et d'autres secteurs.
