* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

* 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
* Experience with C++.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

* Experience developing accessible technologies.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

### Responsibilities

* Write and test product or system development code.

* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Applica Qualifiche minime: * Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione. * 3 anni di esperienza nel testing, manutenzione o lancio di prodotti software, e 1 anno di esperienza con il design e l'architettura software. * 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di infrastrutture su larga scala, sistemi distribuiti o reti, o esperienza con tecnologie di calcolo, archiviazione o architettura hardware. * Esperienza con C++. Qualificazioni preferite: * Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato. * 5 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi. * 1 anno di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica. * Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili. Riguardo il lavoro I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web.
• Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno. Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia avanti. Il team Core costruisce la base tecnica dietro i prodotti di punta di Google. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori degli elementi di progettazione sottostanti, piattaforme di sviluppo, componenti di prodotto e infrastrutture di Google. Questi sono i punti di partenza essenziali per esperienze eccellenti, sicure e coerenti per i nostri utenti e per guidare il ritmo di innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso i prodotti di Google.s per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti. Come team di core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda. Responsabilità * Scrivi e prova il prodotto o il codice di sviluppo del sistema. * Partecipare a, o condurre revisioni di progettazione con i pari e stakeholder per decidere tra le tecnologie disponibili. * Revisionare il codice sviluppato da altri sviluppatori e fornire feedback per garantire le migliori pratiche (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, checking code in, accuratezza, verificabilità, ed efficienza). * Contribuire alla documentazione esistente o contenuti didattici e adattare i contenuti sulla base di aggiornamenti di prodotto/programma e feedback degli utenti. * Problemi di prodotto o sistema di triage e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete o operazioni di servizio e qualità.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

* 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
* Experience with C++.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

* Experience developing accessible technologies.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

### Responsibilities

* Write and test product or system development code.

* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich. Sur le travail Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les uns avec les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie. L'équipe Core construit la base technique derrière Google, les produits phares. Nous sommes propriétaires et défenseurs des éléments de conception sous-jacents, plates-formes de développement, composants de produits, et l'infrastructure de Google. Ce sont les éléments de construction essentiels pour des expériences excellentes, sûres et cohérentes pour nos utilisateurs et de conduire le rythme de l'innovation pour chaque développeur. En tant qu'équipe de base, nous avons un mandat et une occasion unique d'influencer les décisions techniques importantes dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Responsabilités * Ecrire et tester le code de développement du produit ou du système. * Participer aux examens de conception ou diriger les examens avec les pairs et les intervenants afin de décider parmi les technologies disponibles. * Examiner le code élaboré par d'autres développeurs et fournir des commentaires pour assurer les meilleures pratiques (p. ex., lignes directrices sur le style, code de vérification, précision, testabilité et efficacité). * Contribuer à la documentation ou au contenu éducatif existants et adapter le contenu en fonction des mises à jour des produits/programmes et de la rétroaction des utilisateurs. * Triage des problèmes de produit ou de système et débogage/piste/résolve en analysant les sources des problèmes et leur impact sur les opérations de matériel, de réseau ou de service et la qualité.

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 5 years of experience in people management, with technical leadership.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience successfully incubating new 0->1 consumer products.
* Experience building AI native product experiences.
* Experiences with two sided marketplaces.
* High agency and accountability.
* Strong customer empathy.

### About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

It’s a pivotal time for Google Commerce and the industry as a whole. Commerce is going through unprecedented AI-driven changes, shifts in shopper’s expectations and there is an unbounded opportunity to innovate and enable shoppers to browse, decide and transact in new and multimodal ways. We have a strong track record of delivering great shopping experiences, and it is critical we continue to deliver on this.

As a Product Management leader for Consumer Shopping, you will drive the end-to-end product goal and strategy for key strategic priorities within Google’s consumer shopping organization.

In this role, you will serve as a foremost expert in the shopping and e-commerce industry as it leads an organization of product managers dedicated to creating seamless, innovative shopping journeys for users worldwide. Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.

### Responsibilities

* Develop and execute Shopping strategy in collaboration with other product leaders across the company, identifying key growth opportunities and driving innovation.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and emerging trends in retail, including the latest technologies and consumer behavior.
* Collaborate with other teams across Google, including product, engineering, marketing, legal, and finance, to ensure alignment and integration with the overall business objectives.
* Inspire engineering teams to innovate, invent, implement and deploy complex software solutions, especially in regards to modernizing the architecture through Machine Learning (ML) and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Cultivate leadership talent through effective mentoring, coaching, succession planning and strategies for key talent in a fast growth, highly competitive economic environment.

Qualificazioni preferite: * Esperienza con successo incubando nuovi prodotti di consumo 0->1. * Esperienza di costruzione di esperienze native di prodotti AI. * Esperienze con mercati a due lati. * Alta agenzia e responsabilità. * Forte empatia dei clienti. Riguardo il lavoro A Google, mettiamo i nostri utenti al primo posto. Il mondo è sempre in continua evoluzione, quindi abbiamo bisogno di Product Manager che si adattino continuamente ed eccitati per lavorare su prodotti che colpiscono milioni di persone ogni giorno. In questo ruolo, lavorerete in modo cross-funzionale per guidare i prodotti dal concepimento al lancio collegando i mondi tecnici e aziendali. Si possono abbattere problemi complessi in fasi che guidano lo sviluppo dei prodotti. Una delle tante ragioni per cui Google porta costantemente prodotti innovativi e in continua evoluzione sul mercato è il lavoro collaborativo che facciamo nella Gestione dei Prodotti. Il nostro team lavora a stretto contatto con ingegneri creativi, designer, marketer, ecc. per aiutare a progettare e sviluppare tecnologie che migliorino l'accesso alle informazioni del mondo. Siamo responsabili della guida dei prodotti durante tutto il ciclo di esecuzione, concentrandosi in particolare sull'analisi, posizionamento, packaging, promozione e sartoria delle nostre soluzioni ai nostri utenti. E 'un momento cruciale per Google Commerce e il settore nel suo complesso. Il commercio sta attraversando senza precedenti AI-driven cambiamenti, cambiamenti in shopper.s aspettative e vi è un'opportunità illimitata di innovare e consentire agli acquirenti di navigare, decidere e transazioni in modi nuovi e multimodali. Abbiamo un forte record di fornire grandi esperienze di shopping, ed è fondamentale continuare a fornire su questo. Come leader di Gestione del Prodotto per lo Shopping Consumer, si guiderà l'obiettivo del prodotto end-to-end e la strategia per le principali priorità strategiche all'interno di Google.s organizzazione di shopping consumer. In questo ruolo, sarà un esperto di shopping e e-commerce come guida un'organizzazione di product manager dedicata alla creazione di viaggi di shopping senza soluzione di continuità e innovativi per gli utenti di tutto il mondo. Gli utenti vengono prima a Google. In nessun luogo è questo più importante che sul nostro team di pubblicità e commercio: riteniamo che annunci e informazioni commerciali possono essere altamente utili per i nostri utenti se tali informazioni sono pertinenti a ciò che i nostri utenti desiderano trovare o fare. Advertisers in tutto il mondo utilizzano Google Ads per promuovere i loro prodotti; editori utilizzano AdSense per servire annunci pertinenti sul loro sito web; e le imprese di tutto il mondo utilizzano i nostri prodotti (come Google Shopping, e Google Wallet) per supportare le loro aziende online e portare gli utenti nei loro negozi offline. Stiamo costantemente innovando per offrire le opportunità di pubblicità e commercio più efficaci di domani. Responsabilità * Sviluppare ed eseguire la strategia di shopping in collaborazione con altri leader di prodotto in tutta l'azienda, identificare le principali opportunità di crescita e guidare l'innovazione. * Mantenere una profonda comprensione del paesaggio competitivo e tendenze emergenti nel retail, comprese le ultime tecnologie e behavior consumatori. * Collaborare con altri team in tutta Google, tra cui prodotto, ingegneria, marketing, legale e finanza, per garantire l'allineamento e l'integrazione con gli obiettivi aziendali generali. * Incorrere team di ingegneria per innovare, inventare, implementare e implementare soluzioni software complesse, soprattutto per quanto riguarda la modernizzazione dell'architettura attraverso Machine Learning (ML) e modelli di lingua larga (LLMs). * Cultitàtà di leadership talento attraverso efficace mentoring, coaching, pianificazione di successione e strategie per talenti chiave in un ambiente economico veloce e altamente competitivo.

Anwenden Mindestqualifikationen: * Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder verwandte technische Rolle. * 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung (z.B. Ideen zur Ausführung, Ende-zu-Ende, 0 bis 1, etc.). * 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Personalmanagement, mit technischer Führung. Bevorzugte Qualifikationen: * Erfahrung erfolgreich inkubieren neue 0->1 Verbraucherprodukte. * Erfahrung Bauen KI native Produkterlebnisse. * Erfahrungen mit zwei Seiten Marktplätze. * Hohe Agentur und Rechenschaftspflicht. * Starke Kunden-Empathie. Über den Job Bei Google setzen wir unsere Nutzer an die erste Stelle. Die Welt verändert sich ständig, deshalb brauchen wir Produktmanager, die sich ständig anpassen und begeistert sind, an Produkten zu arbeiten, die jeden Tag Millionen Menschen betreffen. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend, um Produkte von der Konzeption bis zum Launch zu führen, indem Sie die technische und geschäftliche Welt miteinander verbinden. Einer der vielen Gründe, warum Google konsequent innovative, weltweit wechselnde Produkte auf den Markt bringt, ist die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team im Produktmanagement. Unser Team arbeitet eng mit kreativen Ingenieuren, Designern, Vermarktern usw. zusammen, um Technologien zu entwickeln, die den Zugang zu den Informationen der Welt verbessern. Wir sind verantwortlich für die Produktführung während des gesamten Ausführungszyklus, wobei wir uns speziell auf die Analyse, Positionierung, Verpackung, Förderung und Anpassung unserer Lösungen an unsere Nutzer konzentrieren. Es ist eine entscheidende Zeit für Google Commerce und die Industrie als Ganzes. Commerce durchläuft beispiellose KI-gesteuerte Veränderungen, Verschiebungen im Käufer, Erwartungen und es gibt eine grenzenlose Gelegenheit, Innovationen und ermöglichen Käufern zu durchsuchen, entscheiden und transact in neuen und multimodalen Weisen. Wir haben eine starke Erfolgsbilanz der Bereitstellung von großen Einkaufserlebnissen, und es ist entscheidend, dass wir weiterhin auf diese liefern. Als Produktmanagement-Führer für Consumer Shopping werden Sie das End-to-End-Produktziel und die Strategie für strategische Schlüsselprioritäten innerhalb der Consumer Shopping-Organisation von Google vorantreiben. In dieser Funktion dienen Sie als führender Experte in der Einkaufs- und E-Commerce-Branche, da sie eine Organisation von Produktmanagern leitet, die sich der Schaffung nahtloser, innovativer Einkaufswege für Nutzer weltweit verschrieben hat. Nutzer kommen bei Google an erster Stelle. Nirgendwo ist dies wichtiger als bei unserem Advertising and Commerce Team: Wir glauben, dass Werbung und kommerzielle Informationen für unsere Nutzer sehr nützlich sein können, wenn diese Informationen relevant sind für das, was unsere Nutzer finden oder tun möchten. Werbetreibende weltweit nutzen Google Ads, um ihre Produkte zu fördern; Verlage verwenden AdSense, um relevante Anzeigen auf ihrer Website zu bedienen; und Unternehmen auf der ganzen Welt nutzen unsere Produkte (wie Google Shopping und Google Wallet), um ihre Online-Geschäfte zu unterstützen und Benutzer in ihre Offline-Shops zu bringen. Zuständigkeiten * Entwickeln und ausführen Shopping-Strategie in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Produktführern im gesamten Unternehmen, Identifizierung von wichtigen Wachstumsmöglichkeiten und Innovationstreiber. * Aufrechterhaltung eines tiefen Verständnisses der Wettbewerbslandschaft und aufstrebenden Trends im Einzelhandel, einschließlich der neuesten Technologien und Verbraucherverhalten. * Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Teams in Google, einschließlich Produkt, Engineering, Marketing, legal, und Finanzen, um die Ausrichtung und Integration mit den allgemeinen Geschäftszielen zu gewährleisten. * Inspire Engineering Teams, um komplexe Softwarelösungen zu entwickeln, zu entwickeln und zu implementieren, insbesondere in Bezug auf die Modernisierung der Architektur durch Machine Learning (ML) und Large Language Models (LLMs). * Cultivate Leadership Talente durch effektive Mentoring, Coaching, Nachfolgeplanung und Strategien für Schlüsseltalente in einem schnell wachsenden, stark wettbewerbsfähigen wirtschaftlichen Umfeld.

Appliquer Titres minimums: * Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 10 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits ou de rôle technique connexe. * 5 ans d'expérience en prenant des produits techniques de la conception au lancement (par exemple, idée à l'exécution, bout à bout, 0 à 1, etc.). * 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de personnes, avec leadership technique. Titres de compétence privilégiés: * Expérience de l'incubation réussie de nouveaux produits de consommation 0->1. * Expérience de la création d'expériences de produits autochtones d'IA. * Expériences avec deux marchés parallèles. * Haute agence et responsabilité. * Une forte empathie des clients. Sur le travail Chez Google, nous mettons nos utilisateurs en premier. Le monde est toujours en train de changer, donc nous avons besoin de Gestionnaires de produits qui s'adaptent continuellement et sont excités de travailler sur des produits qui affectent des millions de personnes chaque jour. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez de façon interfonctionnelle pour guider les produits de la conception au lancement en reliant les mondes technique et commercial. Vous pouvez décomposer les problèmes complexes en étapes qui conduisent au développement de produits. Google apporte constamment des produits innovants et changeants sur le marché en raison du travail collaboratif que nous faisons dans la gestion des produits. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs créatifs, des concepteurs, des marketeurs, etc. pour aider à concevoir et développer des technologies qui améliorent l'accès aux informations du monde. Nous sommes responsables de guider les produits tout au long du cycle d'exécution, en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse, le positionnement, l'emballage, la promotion et la adaptation de nos solutions à nos utilisateurs. C'est un moment crucial pour Google Commerce et l'industrie dans son ensemble. Le commerce traverse des changements sans précédent liés à l'IA, des changements dans les attentes des acheteurs et il y a une occasion illimitée d'innover et de permettre aux acheteurs de naviguer, de décider et de transagir de manière nouvelle et de manière de Δ. En tant que leader de la gestion des produits pour le commerce de consommation, vous dirigerez l'objectif et la stratégie de bout en bout des produits pour les priorités stratégiques clés de Google, l'organisation de magasinage de consommateurs. Dans ce rôle, vous serez un expert majeur dans l'industrie du shopping et du commerce électronique car il dirige une organisation de gestionnaires de produits dédiés à la création de parcours d'achats transparents et innovants pour les utilisateurs dans le monde entier. Les utilisateurs viennent en premier sur Google. Nulle part n'est plus important que sur notre équipe de publicité et de commerce: nous croyons que les annonces et les informations commerciales peuvent être très utiles pour nos utilisateurs si ces informations sont pertinentes à ce que nos utilisateurs souhaitent trouver ou faire. Les annonceurs du monde entier utilisent Google Ads pour promouvoir leurs produits; les éditeurs utilisent AdSense pour diffuser des publicités pertinentes sur leur site Web; et les entreprises du monde entier utilisent nos produits (comme Google Shopping, et Google Wallet) pour soutenir leurs entreprises en ligne et faire entrer les utilisateurs dans leurs magasins hors ligne. Responsabilités * Élaborer et exécuter une stratégie d'achat en collaboration avec d'autres chefs de file de produits dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en identifiant les principales possibilités de croissance et en stimulant l'innovation. * Maintenir une compréhension approfondie du paysage concurrentiel et des tendances émergentes dans le commerce de détail, y compris les dernières technologies et le comportement des consommateurs. * Collaborer avec d'autres équipes de Google, y compris les produits, l'ingénierie, le marketing, le droit et les finances, pour assurer l'alignement et l'intégration avec les objectifs généraux de l'entreprise. * Inspirer les équipes d'ingénierie à innover, inventer, mettre en œuvre et déployer des solutions logicielles complexes, notamment en ce qui concerne la modernisation de l'architecture par le biais de la machine Learning (ML) et des grands modèles linguistiques (LLM). * Cultivate les talents de leadership par un mentorat efficace, un encadrement, une planification de relève et des stratégies pour les talents clés dans un environnement économique en croissance rapide et hautement concurrentiel.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience managing product launch approval discussions (privacy, legal, engineering, etc.).
* Experience with agentic coding in Jetski or similar tooling.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
In this role, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.

### Responsibilities

* Write product or system development code.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience managing product launch approval discussions (privacy, legal, engineering, etc.).
* Experience with agentic coding in Jetski or similar tooling.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
In this role, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.

## Senior Software Engineer, AI/ML, LLM Modeling

_share_

* _link_ Copy link
* _email_ Email a friend

_corporate\_fare_ Google _place_ Zürich, Switzerland

_\_bar\\_chart\__ Mid

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 3 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
* 3 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).
* 3 years of experience with Large Language Models.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures or algorithms.
* Experience in Deep Machine Learning (ML), especially with Large Language Models.
* Experience with reinforcement learning.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The team works on new ways to search, with a focus on Large Language Models (LLM) modeling. Our work revolves around training LLM models, reinforcement learning, multi-step reasoning to various distillation techniques and contribute to different projects, over shorter timelines, our team is not tied to a specific user facing product.

In this role, you will be building new ways to use LLMs in search. You will develop new ways to do things and apply modeling techniques in the real world. You will come up with new ideas, run experiments, new ways to do retrieval, tool calling, or generate fresh content and test them in user-facing products. You will find new under-explored opportunities to apply LLMs, make them work in the real world, and collaborate with other teams.In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

### Responsibilities

* Propose new modeling ideas and test them in the real world.
* Collect training data, and evaluate its quality.
* Design and build evaluations.
* Deploy models to production, measure and optimize their latency.
* Run evaluations, analyze results and suggest modeling improvements.

Über den Job Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion mit Informationen und anderen Menschen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. Das Team arbeitet an neuen Suchwegen, mit Schwerpunkt auf der Modellierung von Large Language Models (LLM). Unsere Arbeit dreht sich um die Ausbildung von LLM-Modellen, Verstärkungslernen, mehrstufiges Denken zu verschiedenen Destillationstechniken und einen Beitrag zu verschiedenen Projekten, über kürzere Zeitlinien, ist unser Team nicht an ein bestimmtes Produkt gebunden, das sich mit dem Benutzer konfrontiert. In dieser Rolle werden Sie neue Wege finden, LLMs in der Suche zu nutzen. Sie entwickeln neue Wege, Dinge zu tun und Modellierungstechniken in der realen Welt anzuwenden. Sie werden neue Ideen entwickeln, Experimente durchführen, neue Wege, um Abrufen, Werkzeugaufrufe zu machen oder neue Inhalte zu generieren und sie in anwendernahen Produkten zu testen. Sie werden neue untererforschte Möglichkeiten finden, LLMs anzuwenden, sie in der realen Welt zu arbeiten und mit anderen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.In Google Search stellen wir neu vor, was es bedeutet, nach Informationen zu suchen – egal wie und überall. Dazu müssen wir komplexe technische Herausforderungen lösen und unsere Infrastruktur ausbauen, wobei wir eine universell zugängliche und nützliche Erfahrung bewahren, auf die sich Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen. Mit unserem Team für die Suche haben Sie die Möglichkeit, weltweit Milliarden Menschen zu beeinflussen. Zuständigkeiten * Neue Modellierideen vorschlagen und in der realen Welt testen. * Trainingsdaten sammeln und ihre Qualität bewerten. * Design und Baubewertungen. * Bereitstellen von Modellen zur Produktion, Messung und Optimierung ihrer Latenz. * Auswertungen durchführen, Ergebnisse analysieren und Modellverbesserungen vorschlagen.

Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie. Notre travail porte sur la formation des modèles LLM, le renforcement de l'apprentissage, le raisonnement en plusieurs étapes à diverses techniques de distillation et contribue à différents projets, sur des délais plus courts, notre équipe n'est pas liée à un produit spécifique face à l'utilisateur. Vous y trouverez de nouvelles idées, des expériences, de nouvelles façons de faire de la recherche, des appels d'outils, ou de générer du contenu frais et de les tester dans les produits orientés vers l'utilisateur. Vous trouverez de nouvelles opportunités d'application de LLMs sous-développées, les rendre efficaces dans le monde réel et collaborer avec d'autres équipes.Dans Google Search, nous repensons ce que cela signifie de rechercher des informations – de quelque façon et n'importe où. Pour cela, nous devons résoudre des défis complexes d'ingénierie et développer notre infrastructure, tout en maintenant une expérience universellement accessible et utile sur laquelle les gens du monde entier comptent. En vous joignant à l'équipe de recherche, vous aurez l'occasion de faire un impact sur des milliards de personnes dans le monde. ## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience in software development.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
* Experience in C++, Java and TypeScript.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

* Experience developing accessible technologies.

* Passionate about frontend and making user experience delightful.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

### Responsibilities

* Write and test product or system development code.

* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

Qualificazioni preferite: * Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campo tecnico correlato. * 5 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi. * 1 anno di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica. * Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili. * Appassionato di crocifisso e rendere l'esperienza utente delizioso. Riguardo il lavoro I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web.
• Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno. Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia avanti. In YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo sia un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio di tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività illimitata, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo condiviso per mostrare le persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e ci divertiamo. e lo facciamo tutti insieme. Responsabilità * Scrivi e prova il prodotto o il codice di sviluppo del sistema. * Partecipare a, o condurre revisioni di progettazione con i pari e stakeholder per decidere tra le tecnologie disponibili. * Revisionare il codice sviluppato da altri sviluppatori e fornire feedback per garantire le migliori pratiche (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, checking code in, accuratezza, verificabilità, ed efficienza). * Contribuire alla documentazione esistente o contenuti didattici e adattare i contenuti sulla base di aggiornamenti di prodotto/programma e feedback degli utenti. * Problemi di prodotto o sistema di triage e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete o operazioni di servizio e qualità.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience in software development.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
* Experience in C++, Java and TypeScript.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

* Experience developing accessible technologies.

* Passionate about frontend and making user experience delightful.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

### Responsibilities

* Write and test product or system development code.

* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen: * Master-Abschluss oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereich. * 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen. * 1 Jahr Erfahrung in einer technischen Führungsrolle. * Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien. * Leidenschaftlich über Frontend und machen Benutzererlebnis wunderbar. Über den Job Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion mit Informationen und anderen Menschen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient, und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Macht zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was sie lieben, und sich miteinander in dem Prozess zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von modernster Technologie und grenzenloser Kreativität arbeiten wir mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur, mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß – und wir tun es gemeinsam. Stilrichtlinien, Code-Checking, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz) bereitstellt. * Tragen Sie zu bestehenden Dokumentation oder Bildungsinhalten bei und passen Sie Inhalte auf der Grundlage von Produkt/Programm-Updates und Benutzerfeedback an. * Triage Produkt- oder Systemprobleme und Debug/Track/Resolve durch Analyse der Quellen von Problemen und der Auswirkungen auf Hardware, Netzwerk oder Service-Betriebe und Qualität.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in Python or C++ programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience with power profiling and performance optimization for mobile or wearable platforms.
* Experience with on-device validation and productization of AI-driven capabilities.
* Expertise in cross-functional integration and bridging data between proprietary systems.
* Proven track record in the full-stack productionization of technical features.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will be responsible for full-stack productionisation and technical integration. You will bridge data between complex systems, implement advanced object tracking pipelines, and validate technical approaches to ensure AI products are successfully deployed on-device. Your focus will be on maintaining quality threshold and optimizing core product performance.For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Drive the bring-up of critical object tracking systems, including development and power profiling.
* Lead the design and definition of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), ensuring efficient data bridging between perception modules and system-level platforms.
* Implement and integrate platform-specific optimizations to achieve significant performance gains on target platforms.
* Validate core technical approaches for enabling high-performance Artificial Intelligence (AI) products to ensure successful on-device productization.
* Lead the implementation of core product quality enhancements and performance optimization strategies.

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* 2 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software in linguaggi di programmazione Python o C++, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. * 2 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di infrastrutture su larga scala, sistemi distribuiti o reti, o esperienza con tecnologie di calcolo, archiviazione o architettura hardware.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Esperienza con il sistema di potenza di rasoio e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni per piattaforme mobili o indossabili. * Esperienza con la validazione e la produzione di funzionalità a guida di AI. * Esperti in integrazione cross-funzionale e dati di ponte tra sistemi proprietari. * Track record di Proven nella produzione a tutto punto di caratteristiche tecniche.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia avanti.

In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili della produzione a tutto campo e dell'integrazione tecnica. Ponteggerete i dati tra sistemi complessi, implementerete condotte di tracciamento di oggetti avanzati e convalidate approcci tecnici per garantire che i prodotti AI siano utilizzati con successo in-device. Il vostro obiettivo sarà quello di mantenere la soglia di qualità e ottimizzare le prestazioni dei prodotti core.Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da

scoperte in calcolo, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. XR di Google

team è in prima linea nel prossimo grande salto. la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di un semplice nuovo dispositivo. si tratta di reimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo intorno a noi. Stiamo costruendo un futuro dove

dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali intelligenti e cuffie abbinano con AI utile per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversative e contestuali.

Responsabilità

* Guidare l'introduzione di sistemi di tracciamento oggetti critici, compreso lo sviluppo e potenza di randagio. * Guidare la progettazione e la definizione di Application Programming Interfaces (API), garantendo un efficiente ponte dati tra moduli di percezione e piattaforme a livello di sistema. * Implementare e integrare le ottimizzazioni specifiche per le piattaforme per ottenere significativi guadagni di prestazioni sulle piattaforme target. * Convalidare approcci tecnici fondamentali per consentire prodotti di intelligenza artificiale ad alte prestazioni (AI) per garantire il successo in-device di produzione.

* Guidare l'implementazione di miglioramenti della qualità dei prodotti e strategie di ottimizzazione delle prestazioni.

Mittel

Erfahrung mit treibenden Fortschritten, Problemlösungen und Mentoring von mehr Nachwuchsteammitgliedern; tieferes Fachwissen und angewandtes Wissen in relevanten Bereichen.

Anwenden

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor, s Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in Python oder C++ Programmiersprachen, oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung von großräumigen Infrastruktur, verteilten Systemen oder Netzwerken, oder Erfahrung mit Computertechnologien, Speicher- oder Hardwarearchitektur.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Erfahrung mit Leistungsprofilierung und Leistungsoptimierung für mobile oder tragbare Plattformen. * Erfahrung mit On-Device-Validierung und Produktisierung von KI-getriebenen Fähigkeiten. * Kompetenz in der funktionsübergreifenden Integration und der Überbrückung von Daten zwischen proprietären Systemen. * Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz bei der Full-Stack-Produktion technischer Features.

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion mit Informationen und anderen Menschen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Funktion sind Sie für die vollständige Produktion und technische Integration verantwortlich. Sie werden Daten zwischen komplexen Systemen überbrücken, fortschrittliche Objektverfolgungspipelines implementieren und technische Ansätze validieren, um sicherzustellen, dass KI-Produkte erfolgreich auf dem Gerät eingesetzt werden. Ihr Fokus liegt auf der Aufrechterhaltung der Qualität und der Optimierung der Produktleistung.Seit Jahrzehnten hat die Computerrevolution unsere Welt geprägt durch

Durchbrüche in Computing, Konnektivität, Mobil, und jetzt, KI. Googles XR

team ist an der Spitze des nächsten großen Sprungs – die Konvergenz von KI und XR. Dies ist mehr als nur neue Geräte – es geht um die Neugestaltung, wie wir mit der Welt um uns herum interagieren.

leichte XR-Geräte wie Smart-Brillen und Headsets verbinden sich mit hilfreicher KI, um menschliche Intelligenz zu erweitern und personalisierte, gesprächs- und kontextbezogene Erlebnisse zu bieten.

Zuständigkeiten

* Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Definition von Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) durch, die eine effiziente Datenüberbrückung zwischen Wahrnehmungsmodulen und System-Level-Plattformen gewährleisten. * Implementierung und Integration plattformspezifischer Optimierungen, um signifikante Leistungsgewinne auf Zielplattformen zu erzielen. * Validierung technischer Kernansätze, um leistungsstarke Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) Produkte zu ermöglichen, um eine erfolgreiche On-Device-Produktisierung zu gewährleisten.

* Führen Sie die Umsetzung der Kern-Produktqualität Verbesserungen und Leistung Optimierungsstrategien.

Moyenne

Expérience de la conduite des progrès, de la résolution des problèmes et du mentorat de membres d'équipes juniors; expertise approfondie et connaissances appliquées dans le domaine pertinent.

Appliquer

Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 2 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels en langage de programmation Python ou C++, ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé. * 2 ans d'expérience dans le développement d'infrastructures à grande échelle, systèmes distribués ou réseaux, ou expérience avec les technologies de calcul, stockage ou architecture matérielle.

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* Expérience du profilage de puissance et de l'optimisation des performances pour les plateformes mobiles ou portables. * Expérience de la validation et de la production sur les appareils des capacités à l'IA. * Expertise en intégration interfonctionnelle et en liaison de données entre les systèmes propriétaires. * Preuve de la production complète de caractéristiques techniques.

Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les uns avec les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la production complète et de l'intégration technique. Vous allez relier les données entre des systèmes complexes, mettre en œuvre des pipelines de suivi d'objets avancés, et valider des approches techniques pour assurer le déploiement réussi des produits AI sur les appareils. Votre objectif sera de maintenir le seuil de qualité et d'optimiser les performances de base du produit.

percées dans le calcul, la connectivité, mobile, et maintenant, AI.

L'équipe est à l'avant-garde du prochain grand saut – la convergence de l'IA et de la XR. C'est plus que de nouveaux appareils – il s'agit de rejuger la façon dont nous interagissons avec le monde autour de nous.

des appareils XR légers comme des lunettes intelligentes et des casques pair avec l'IA utile pour augmenter l'intelligence humaine, offrant des expériences personnalisées, conversationnelles et contextuelles.

* Diriger la mise en oeuvre des améliorations de la qualité des produits et des stratégies d'optimisation des performances.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience in a sales role in the enterprise software or cloud space selling technical solutions.
* Experience leading and scaling teams in a cloud-based Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment.
* Experience selling business intelligence and cloud technologies to clients of all sizes, including enterprises and digital natives.
* Experience closing cloud business agreements with advanced technical solutions (e.g., data analytics, infrastructure, AI solutions).
* People management experience within a quota-carrying team in the cloud business.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience planning and organizing go-to-market strategies, business programs, and sales activity within your team and territory.

* Experience influencing cross-functional teams to impact business goals, customer experience, and customer expansion.

* Experience with Google Cloud, relevant AI offerings, and selling an AI technology stack.

* Experience leveraging knowledge of relevant products, solutions, and market trends, with the problem-solving abilities to analyze business performance data or market changes, to drive direction.
* Experience in people and business management, supporting career development of a sales team and business growth.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, presentation, active listening, and program management skills.

### About the job

In this role, you will lead a team responsible for growing our AI business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will effectively build relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g., Field Sales, Customer Engineering, Solution Architecture, Product) and customers, supporting the team to do the same. You will ensure your team has the necessary sales skills to demonstrate product functionality and comprehensive overviews of key business use cases, and close business. You will support a positive team culture, while leading with empathy and identifying ways to multiply the impact of the team as a whole to drive overall value for Google Cloud.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €144000 - €148000 (EUR) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

### Responsibilities

* Support your team to drive pipelines, manage business-cycles from lead generation to customer onboarding, and meet and exceed business goals.
* Partner cross-functionally to understand customers needs, impact messaging and collateral, and provide excellent prospects and customer experience.

* Develop and own the go-to-market plan to scale and impact your business in key areas: business generation, new customer growth, customer expansion and conservation, customer referenceability.
* Build and maintain relationships to influence long-term strategic direction and be a trusted advisor to your team and their accounts. Own Chief Experience Officer (CXO) relationships with key customers and inspire executives by identifying AI use cases for Google Cloud products and solutions and demonstrating opportunities for transformation.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience in a sales role in the enterprise software or cloud space selling technical solutions.
* Experience leading and scaling teams in a cloud-based Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment.
* Experience selling business intelligence and cloud technologies to clients of all sizes, including enterprises and digital natives.
* Experience closing cloud business agreements with advanced technical solutions (e.g., data analytics, infrastructure, AI solutions).
* People management experience within a quota-carrying team in the cloud business.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience planning and organizing go-to-market strategies, business programs, and sales activity within your team and territory.

* Experience influencing cross-functional teams to impact business goals, customer experience, and customer expansion.

* Experience with Google Cloud, relevant AI offerings, and selling an AI technology stack.

* Experience leveraging knowledge of relevant products, solutions, and market trends, with the problem-solving abilities to analyze business performance data or market changes, to drive direction.
* Experience in people and business management, supporting career development of a sales team and business growth.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, presentation, active listening, and program management skills.

### About the job

In this role, you will lead a team responsible for growing our AI business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will effectively build relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g., Field Sales, Customer Engineering, Solution Architecture, Product) and customers, supporting the team to do the same. You will ensure your team has the necessary sales skills to demonstrate product functionality and comprehensive overviews of key business use cases, and close business. You will support a positive team culture, while leading with empathy and identifying ways to multiply the impact of the team as a whole to drive overall value for Google Cloud.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €144000 - €148000 (EUR) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

* Support your team to drive pipelines, manage business-cycles from lead generation to customer onboarding, and meet and exceed business goals.
* Partner cross-functionally to understand customers needs, impact messaging and collateral, and provide excellent prospects and customer experience.

* Develop and own the go-to-market plan to scale and impact your business in key areas: business generation, new customer growth, customer expansion and conservation, customer referenceability.
* Build and maintain relationships to influence long-term strategic direction and be a trusted advisor to your team and their accounts. Own Chief Experience Officer (CXO) relationships with key customers and inspire executives by identifying AI use cases for Google Cloud products and solutions and demonstrating opportunities for transformation.

* Represent your business in forecasts, town halls and meetings; report forecasts and business performance in Salesforce and other tools.

* Publication record in AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* Experience working in an industry or academic research lab, focusing on multiple aspects of the "research to product" pipeline, particularly model optimization and efficiency improvements.
* Familiarity with generative AI techniques, such as image diffusion models, and their application to visual enhancement.
* Strong background in 3D computer vision and deep learning, with specific, proven expertise in Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), and 3D scene reconstruction.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will be part of the XR Semantic Perception team, which develops novel core technology around computer vision and ML, with a particular focus on scene and object understanding and 3D computer vision. You will work across the full range from research to product, as part of a team composed of Research Scientists and Software Engineers, serving multiple perception-related products at Google, with a particular focus on XR products and applications.

### Responsibilities

* Develop innovative computer vision and machine learning technology focused on 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, and novel view synthesis for XR applications.
* Drive the research, development, and optimization of 3D scene representation pipelines (such as Gaussian Splatting and Neural Representations), including improving model efficiency, training stability, and visual fidelity for large-scale scenes.
* Establish and maintain relationships with main stakeholders and keep recurring updates on the advancements of the project, making sure that their expectations are aligned to the research and engineering work.
