# Presto

Esperienza completando il lavoro come diretto e collaborando con i compagni di squadra; sviluppare la conoscenza di concetti e processi rilevanti.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

* 1 anno di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio, Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

* 1 anno di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

* 1 anno di esperienza con Infrastructure, Machine Learning.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale in Informatica o in un campo tecnico correlato.
* 1 anno di esperienza con C++.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

La missione del Retrieval Engine è quella di fornire un recupero di informazioni scalabile, facile da usare su tutti i dati di Google. Consente un recupero efficiente, affidabile, in tempo reale su set di dati su larga scala contenenti più tipi di dati, tra cui embedding, testo, geolocalizzazione e numerici.

Retrieval Engine è utilizzato per alimentare i più grandi motori di ricerca del mondo come google.com, YouTube.com e altri e stiamo costruendo infrastrutture e sistemi di qualità che alimentano le finestre di contesto del modello GenAI con informazioni pertinenti (le applicazioni example sono la modalità Ricerca AI, Ricerca Panoramica AI e Gemini).

Il team Core costruisce il fondamento tecnico dietro i prodotti di punta di Google. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori per gli elementi di design sottostanti, piattaforme di sviluppatori, componenti di prodotto e infrastrutture a Google. Questi sono i mattoni essenziali per esperienze eccellenti, sicure e coerenti per i nostri utenti e guidare il ritmo di innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso i prodotti di Google per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere le barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti. Come team Core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda.

### responsabilità

* Contribuisci alla documentazione esistente o ai contenuti educativi e adatta i contenuti in base agli aggiornamenti del prodotto/programma e al feedback degli utenti.
* Triage prodotto o problemi di sistema e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete, o operazioni di servizio e qualità.
* Scrivere il codice di sviluppo del prodotto o del sistema; il codice di revisione sviluppato da altri sviluppatori e fornire feedback per garantire le migliori pratiche (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, controllo del codice, accuratezza, testabilità e efficienza).
* Migliorare l'infrastruttura e la qualità per Gemini, google.com, ecc.
* Lavorare all'intersezione dell'infrastruttura (in esecuzione efficiente in scala) e della qualità (ritorno i migliori risultati).

## Früh

Erleben Sie den Abschluss der Arbeit wie angewiesen und die Zusammenarbeit mit Teamkollegen; Entwicklung von Wissen über relevante Konzepte und Prozesse.

Beantragen

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen (z.B. Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.

* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit Infrastruktur, Machine Learning.

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss in Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit C++.

### Über den Job

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Die Mission von Retrieval Engine ist es, eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Informationsabfrage über alle Daten von Google bereitzustellen. Es ermöglicht eine effiziente, zuverlässige Echtzeit-Abrufung über große Datensätze, die mehrere Arten von Daten enthalten, einschließlich Einbettungen, Text, Geo-Standorte und Zahlen.

Die Retrieval Engine wird verwendet, um die weltweit größten Suchmaschinen wie Google.com, YouTube.com und andere zu versorgen, und wir bauen Infrastruktur- und Qualitätssysteme auf, die die Kontextfenster des GenAI-Modells mit relevanten Informationen versorgen (Beispiele sind Search AI Mode, Search AI Overviews und Gemini).

Das Core-Team bildet die technische Grundlage für die Flaggschiffprodukte von Google. Wir sind Eigentümer und Befürworter der zugrunde liegenden Designelemente, Entwicklerplattformen, Produktkomponenten und Infrastruktur bei Google. Dies sind die wesentlichen Bausteine für hervorragende, sichere und kohärente Erlebnisse für unsere Benutzer und treiben das Innovationstempo für jeden Entwickler voran. Wir schauen uns die Produkte von Google an, um zentrale Lösungen zu entwickeln, technische Barrieren abzubauen und bestehende Systeme zu stärken. Als Kernteam haben wir ein Mandat und eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, wichtige technische Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen zu beeinflussen.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Tragen Sie zu vorhandenen Dokumentationen oder Bildungsinhalten bei und passen Sie Inhalte basierend auf Produkt- / Programmaktualisierungen und Benutzerfeedback an.
* Triage Produkt- oder Systemprobleme und Debug/Track/Resolve durch Analyse der Ursachen von Problemen und der Auswirkungen auf Hardware-, Netzwerk- oder Servicebetrieb und -qualität.
* Schreiben Sie Produkt- oder Systementwicklungscode; Überprüfen Sie den von anderen Entwicklern entwickelten Code und geben Sie Feedback, um Best Practices sicherzustellen (z. B. Stilrichtlinien, Überprüfung des Codes, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz).
* Verbessern Sie die Infrastruktur und Qualität für Gemini, Google.com usw.
* Arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Infrastruktur (effizient im Maßstab laufen) und Qualität (bringen Sie die besten Ergebnisse zurück).

## Début

Expérience de l'achèvement du travail selon les directives et collaboration avec les coéquipiers; connaissance des concepts et des processus pertinents.

Appliquer

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

* 1 an d'expérience en développement logiciel dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation (p. ex. Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

* 1 an d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

* 1 an d'expérience avec Infrastructure, Machine Learning.

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise en informatique ou domaine technique connexe.
* 1 an d'expérience avec C++.

### Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Retrieval Engine a pour mission de fournir des informations évolutives et faciles à utiliser sur toutes les données de Google. Il permet une recherche efficace, fiable et en temps réel sur des ensembles de données à grande échelle contenant de multiples types de données, y compris des intégrations, du texte, des géolocalisations et des données numériques.

Retrieval Engine est utilisé pour alimenter les plus grands moteurs de recherche du monde tels que google.com, YouTube.com et d'autres et nous construisons une infrastructure et des systèmes de qualité qui alimentent les fenêtres contextuelles du modèle GenAI avec des informations pertinentes (exemple applications sont Search AI Mode, Search AI Overviews, et Gemini).

L'équipe de base construit la base technique derrière Google produits phares. Nous sommes propriétaires et défenseurs des éléments de conception sous-jacents, des plateformes de développement, des composants de produits et de l'infrastructure chez Google. Ce sont les éléments essentiels pour des expériences excellentes, sûres et cohérentes pour nos utilisateurs et stimuler le rythme de l'innovation pour chaque développeur. Nous regardons les produits Google pour construire des solutions centrales, briser les barrières techniques et renforcer les systèmes existants. En tant qu'équipe principale, nous avons un mandat et une occasion unique d'influer sur les décisions techniques importantes de l'entreprise.

### Responsabilités

* Contribuer à la documentation ou au contenu éducatif existants et adapter le contenu en fonction des mises à jour des produits/programmes et de la rétroaction des utilisateurs.
* Trier les problèmes de produit ou de système et déboguer, suivre et résoudre en analysant les sources de problèmes et l'impact sur le matériel, le réseau ou les opérations de service et la qualité.
* Écrire le code de développement de produit ou de système; Examiner le code élaboré par d'autres développeurs et fournir des commentaires pour assurer les meilleures pratiques (p. ex., lignes directrices de style, code de vérification, précision, testabilité et efficacité).
* Améliorer l'infrastructure et la qualité pour Gemini, google.com, etc.
* Travailler à l'intersection de l'infrastructure (course efficacement à l'échelle) et de la qualité (retourner les meilleurs résultats).

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

_info\_outline_

X Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; New York, NY, USA.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a technical security role (e.g., security engineering, security research, DevSecOps, or incident response).
* Experience with vulnerability assessments and vulnerability exploitation.
* Experience in security and ethical hacking.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of offensive security experience (red teaming, vulnerability research, pen testing, etc - not just running tools) in Cloud environment.
* Experience with Artificial Intelligence.
* Ability to develop custom exploits, modify existing exploits, and bypass security controls.
* Fluency in programming languages relevant to security and cloud automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).
* Being able to clearly and concisely articulate complex technical findings, risks, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a part of the Product Security Engineering team within the Cloud CISO organization, you will be responsible for helping ensure every product in Cloud is as secure as it can be, and increasing the security in the infrastructure underlying all our products.

As a part of the Cloud Red Team, your mission is to evaluate our ability to detect and respond to known and unknown threats by simulating real-world adversaries that aim to compromise and persist in Cloud’s infrastructure. In short: Hack Cloud to make hacking Cloud harder.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $253000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

### Responsibilities

* Define and maintain the roadmap for one of the programs within Cloud Red Team, while collaborating within a highly-skilled team to plan and execute attacks against Cloud’s products, services, and infrastructure.
* Build tools and infrastructure to support attacker goals, while identifying vulnerabilities and attack vectors across Cloud services, configurations, and related technologies.
* Participate in threat modeling exercises to identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in Cloud architectures and deployments.
* Design realistic and relevant attack scenarios based on current threat intelligence and the specific Cloud environment being assessed.
* Create reports that capture the insights gained during an attack and present them to a variety of audiences.

Applica

_info\_outline_

X Nota: Applicandovi a questa posizione avrete la possibilità di condividere la vostra posizione di lavoro preferita da: Zürich, Svizzera; New York, NY, USA.

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di sicurezza tecnica (ad esempio, ingegneria della sicurezza, ricerca sulla sicurezza, DevSecOps, o risposta incidente). * Esperienza con valutazioni di vulnerabilità e sfruttamento della vulnerabilità. * Esperienza in sicurezza e hacking etico.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* 3 anni di esperienza di sicurezza offensivo (rosso tearing, ricerca sulla vulnerabilità, test della penna, ecc - non solo strumenti di esecuzione) in ambiente Cloud. * Esperienza con l'intelligenza artificiale. * Capacità di sviluppare exploit personalizzati, modificare exploit esistenti, e bypassare i controlli di sicurezza. * Fluenza nei linguaggi di programmazione rilevanti per la sicurezza e l'automazione del cloud (ad esempio, Python, Go, Bash). * Essere in grado di articolare in modo chiaro e conciso complessi risultati tecnici, rischi e strategie di bonifica sia per il pubblico tecnico che non tecnico, sia per iscritto.

Riguardo il lavoro

Il nostro team di Sicurezza lavora per creare e mantenere l'ambiente operativo più sicuro per gli utenti e gli sviluppatori di Google. Gli ingegneri di sicurezza lavorano con apparecchiature di rete e monitorano attivamente i nostri sistemi per attacchi e intrusioni. In questo ruolo, si lavorerà anche con gli ingegneri del software per identificare e correggere in modo proattivo difetti di sicurezza e vulnerabilità.

Come parte del team di Product Security Engineering dell'organizzazione CISO Cloud, sarà responsabile dell'assistenza per garantire che ogni prodotto in Cloud sia sicuro quanto può essere e per aumentare la sicurezza nell'infrastruttura che sta alla base di tutti i nostri prodotti.

Come parte del Cloud Red Team, la vostra missione è valutare la nostra capacità di rilevare e rispondere a minacce conosciute e sconosciute simulando adversari del mondo reale che mirano a compromettere e persistere nell'infrastruttura Cloud. In breve: Hack Cloud per rendere più difficile la condivisione del cloud.La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori quali le competenze legate al lavoro, l'esperienza e l'istruzione o formazione pertinenti.

USA: $174000 - $253000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefit

Learn più sui benefici a Google.

Responsabilità

* Definire e mantenere la roadmap per uno dei programmi all'interno del Cloud Red Team, collaborando all'interno di un team altamente qualificato per pianificare ed eseguire attacchi contro i prodotti, i servizi e l'infrastruttura Cloud. * Costruire strumenti e infrastrutture per supportare gli obiettivi degli attacchi, identificando vulnerabilità e vettori di attacco attraverso i servizi, le configurazioni e le tecnologie Cloud. * Partecipare a esercizi di modellazione delle minacce per identificare potenziali percorsi di attacco e debolezze nelle architetture e implementazioni Cloud.

* Progettare scenari di attacco realistici e pertinenti basati sull'intelligenza delle minacce attuali e sull'ambiente cloud specifico in fase di valutazione. * Creare report che catturano le intuizioni acquisite durante un attacco e le presentano a una varietà di pubblico.

X Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; New York, NY, USA.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a technical security role (e.g., security engineering, security research, DevSecOps, or incident response).
* Experience with vulnerability assessments and vulnerability exploitation.
* Experience in security and ethical hacking.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of offensive security experience (red teaming, vulnerability research, pen testing, etc - not just running tools) in Cloud environment.
* Experience with Artificial Intelligence.
* Ability to develop custom exploits, modify existing exploits, and bypass security controls.
* Fluency in programming languages relevant to security and cloud automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).
* Being able to clearly and concisely articulate complex technical findings, risks, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a part of the Product Security Engineering team within the Cloud CISO organization, you will be responsible for helping ensure every product in Cloud is as secure as it can be, and increasing the security in the infrastructure underlying all our products.

As a part of the Cloud Red Team, your mission is to evaluate our ability to detect and respond to known and unknown threats by simulating real-world adversaries that aim to compromise and persist in Cloud’s infrastructure. In short: Hack Cloud to make hacking Cloud harder.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $253000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

### Responsibilities

* Define and maintain the roadmap for one of the programs within Cloud Red Team, while collaborating within a highly-skilled team to plan and execute attacks against Cloud’s products, services, and infrastructure.
* Build tools and infrastructure to support attacker goals, while identifying vulnerabilities and attack vectors across Cloud services, configurations, and related technologies.
* Participate in threat modeling exercises to identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in Cloud architectures and deployments.
* Design realistic and relevant attack scenarios based on current threat intelligence and the specific Cloud environment being assessed.
* Create reports that capture the insights gained during an attack and present them to a variety of audiences.

## Security Software Engineer, Systemic Remediation, Cloud CISO

_share_

* _link_ Copy link
* _email_ Email a friend

_corporate\_fare_ Google _place_ Zürich, Switzerland

_\_bar\\_chart\__ Mid

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in software development.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
* 5 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* 5 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
* Experience in static analysis or dynamic analysis.
* Consulting experience.
* Experience building security tooling.
* Ability to influence others.
* Strong communication skills.

### About the job

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering team is responsible for ensuring that every Google Cloud product ships as secure as possible. You will do so by increasing the assurance levels of security in the infrastructure underlying all products, increasing the capabilities of each product team to develop more secure products by design and by default, from patterns, tools, and frameworks to increasing the skill level of embedded security leads. Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering owns and drives the product security strategy for Google Cloud. You will work with almost every aspect of Google’s infrastructure and on solving planet-scale infrastructure security problems that have societal-level impacts.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

### Responsibilities

* Perform security reviews, research and reproduce vulnerabilities, design secure protocols and systems, and write tests and fuzzers.
* Review and develop secure operational practices, and provide security guidance for engineers and support staff.
* Review designs and drive towards defense in depth and security by default, both with one-time reviews and longer term engagements.
* Look for vulnerabilities with techniques including reverse engineering, fuzzing, and static analysis.
* Respond to vulnerabilities with repros, variant analysis, mitigations, and hardening.

Ingegnere software di sicurezza, Rimedio sistemico, CISO nuvola

_Condividi_

* _link_ Copia link * _email_ Invia un'email ad un amico

_corporate\_fare_ Google _place_ Zurigo, Svizzera

_\_bar\\_chart\__ metà

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software. * 5 anni di esperienza di testing, e il lancio di prodotti software. * 5 anni di esperienza con il design di software e l'architettura. * 5 anni di esperienza con ingegneria della sicurezza, computer e sicurezza di rete e protocolli di sicurezza.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* 3 anni di esperienza lavorando in un'organizzazione complessa e matriceta che coinvolge progetti interfunzionali o inter-business. * Esperienza in analisi statiche o dinamiche. * Esperienza di consulenza. * Esperienza di costruzione di strumenti di sicurezza. * Capacità di influenzare gli altri. * Forte capacità di comunicazione.

Riguardo il lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google Cloud sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. Cerchiamo ingegneri che portano idee fresche in tutti i settori, tra cui il recupero delle informazioni, l'informatica distribuita, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione di lingua naturale, il design di UI e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico, critico per le esigenze di Google Cloud, con l'opportunità di cambiare team e progetti man mano che voi e la nostra azienda fast-paced crescono ed evolveranno. Avrete l'anticipazione delle nostre esigenze dei clienti e sarete autorizzati ad agire come un proprietario, agire e innovare. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership ed entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la penisola mentre continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia in avanti.

Il team di Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering è responsabile di garantire che ogni prodotto di Google Cloud venga spedito il più sicuro possibile. Lo farà aumentando i livelli di sicurezza nell'infrastruttura sottostante tutti i prodotti, aumentando le capacità di ogni team di prodotti per sviluppare prodotti più sicuri per progettazione e per impostazione predefinita, da modelli, strumenti e quadri per aumentare il livello di abilità dei cavi di sicurezza incorporati.

Lavorerete con quasi ogni aspetto delle infrastrutture di Google.s e sulla soluzione di problemi di sicurezza delle infrastrutture su scala planetaria che hanno impatti a livello sociale.

Google Cloud accelera la capacità di ogni organizzazione di trasformare digitalmente il proprio business e il proprio settore. Offriamo soluzioni di livello enterprise che sfruttano la tecnologia all'avanguardia di Google.s e strumenti che aiutano gli sviluppatori a costruire in modo più sostenibile. I clienti in più di 200 paesi e territori si rivolgono a Google Cloud come partner di fiducia per consentire la crescita e risolvere i loro problemi più critici di business.

Responsabilità

* Eseguire recensioni di sicurezza, ricerca e riprodurre vulnerabilità, progettare protocolli e sistemi sicuri, e scrivere test e fuzzer. * Rivedere e sviluppare pratiche operative sicure, e fornire guida di sicurezza per gli ingegneri e personale di supporto. * Rivedere progetti e guidare verso la difesa in profondità e sicurezza per impostazione predefinita, sia con una volta recensioni e impegni a lungo termine. * Cercare vulnerabilità con tecniche tra cui reverse engineering, fuzzing, e analisi statica. * Rispondere alle vulnerabilità con repros, analisi delle varianti, attenuazioni e indurimento.

Mittel

Erfahrung mit treibenden Fortschritten, Problemlösungen und Mentoring von mehr Nachwuchsteammitgliedern; tieferes Fachwissen und angewandtes Wissen in relevanten Bereichen.

Anwenden

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Software-Entwicklung. * 5 Jahre Erfahrung Testen und Starten von Software-Produkten. * 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Software-Design und Architektur. * 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Sicherheits-Engineering, Computer-und Netzwerk-Sicherheit und Sicherheitsprotokolle.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer komplexen, matrixierten Organisation, die cross-funktionale oder cross-business Projekte umfasst. * Erfahrung in statischer Analyse oder dynamischer Analyse. * Beratung Erfahrung. * Erfahrung Gebäudesicherheit Werkzeug. * Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen. * Starke Kommunikation Fähigkeiten.

Über den Job

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google Cloud entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion von Milliarden von Nutzern mit Informationen und anderen verändern. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationswiederherstellung, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatigem Systemdesign, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, Künstliche Intelligenz, natürlicher Sprachverarbeitung, Benutzeroberflächendesign und Mobil; die Liste wächst und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google Cloud entscheidend ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich entwickeln. Sie werden unsere Kundenbedürfnisse antizipieren und können als Eigentümer agieren, handeln und Innovationen durchführen. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und sich für neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu begeistern, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Das Team von Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering ist dafür verantwortlich, dass jedes Produkt von Google Cloud so sicher wie möglich ausgeliefert wird. Sie werden dies tun, indem Sie die Sicherheit in der Infrastruktur, die allen Produkten zugrunde liegt, erhöhen und die Fähigkeiten jedes Produktteams erhöhen, um sicherere Produkte per Design und standardmäßig zu entwickeln, von Mustern, Tools und Frameworks bis hin zu einer Steigerung des Kompetenzniveaus der eingebetteten Sicherheit. Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering besitzt und treibt die Produktsicherheitsstrategie für Google Cloud.

Sie werden mit fast jedem Aspekt der Google, s-Infrastruktur und die Lösung von planetenweiten Infrastruktur-Sicherheitsproblemen, die Auswirkungen auf gesellschaftliche Ebene haben arbeiten.

Google Cloud beschleunigt jede Organisation, die in der Lage ist, ihre Unternehmen und ihre Industrie digital zu verändern. Wir bieten Lösungen für Unternehmen, die Google, modernste Technologien und Tools nutzen, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Gebieten wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre kritischsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen.

Zuständigkeiten

* Führen Sie Sicherheitsbewertungen, Forschung und reproduzieren Schwachstellen, Design sichere Protokolle und Systeme, und schreiben Tests und Fuzzer. * Überprüfen und entwickeln sichere Betriebspraktiken, und bieten Sicherheits-Anleitung für Ingenieure und Support-Personal. * Überprüfen Sie Designs und Antrieb in Richtung Verteidigung in Tiefe und Sicherheit standardmäßig, sowohl mit einmaliger Überprüfung und längerfristige Engagements. * Suchen Sie nach Schwachstellen mit Techniken wie Reverse Engineering, Fuzzing und statische Analyse. * Antworten Sie auf Schwachstellen mit Repros, Variantenanalyse, Minderungen und Härten.

Moyenne

Expérience de la conduite des progrès, de la résolution des problèmes et du mentorat de membres d'équipes juniors; expertise approfondie et connaissances appliquées dans le domaine pertinent.

Appliquer

Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 5 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels. * 5 ans d'expérience dans les tests et le lancement de logiciels. * 5 ans d'expérience dans la conception et l'architecture de logiciels. * 5 ans d'expérience dans l'ingénierie de sécurité, la sécurité informatique et réseau et les protocoles de sécurité.

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* 3 ans d'expérience dans une organisation complexe et matricielle qui implique des projets interfonctionnels ou inter-entreprises. * Expérience en analyse statique ou en analyse dynamique. * Expérience de conseil. * Expérience de renforcement de l'outil de sécurité. * Capacité d'influencer les autres. * Fortes compétences en communication.

Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google Cloud développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent entre eux. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées de tous les domaines, y compris la récupération d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google Cloud avec des opportunités de changer d'équipes et de projets à mesure que vous et notre activité à rythme accéléré vous croissez et évoluerez. Vous anticiperz nos besoins clients et serez habilité à agir comme un propriétaire, à agir et à innover.

L'équipe de sécurité de Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering est chargée de garantir que chaque produit Google Cloud soit aussi sûr que possible. Vous le ferez en augmentant les niveaux de sécurité dans l'infrastructure sous-jacente à tous les produits, en augmentant les capacités de chaque équipe de produits à développer des produits plus sûrs par conception et par défaut, des modèles, outils et cadres à l'augmentation du niveau de compétence des leaders de sécurité embarqués.

Vous travaillerez avec presque tous les aspects de Google, l'infrastructure et sur la résolution des problèmes de sécurité des infrastructures à l'échelle planétaire qui ont des impacts sociétaux.

Google Cloud accélère chaque organisation, sa capacité de transformer numériquement son secteur d'activité et son industrie. Nous offrons des solutions de qualité d'entreprise qui tirent parti de Google, des technologies de pointe et des outils qui aident les développeurs à construire plus durablement.

Responsabilités

* Effectuer des examens de sécurité, des recherches et des reproductions de vulnérabilités, concevoir des protocoles et des systèmes sécurisés, et écrire des tests et des fuzzers. * Examiner et développer des pratiques opérationnelles sécurisées, et fournir des conseils de sécurité aux ingénieurs et au personnel de soutien. * Examiner les conceptions et la conduite vers la défense en profondeur et la sécurité par défaut, avec des examens ponctuels et des engagements à plus long terme. * Recherchez les vulnérabilités avec des techniques incluant l'ingénierie inverse, le fuzzing et l'analyse statique. * Resserrer les vulnérabilités avec des repros, l'analyse de variantes, les atténuations et le durcissement.

## Early

Experience completing work as directed, and collaborating with teammates; developing knowledge of relevant concepts and processes.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 1 year of experience in security analysis, risk modeling, or security detection scoped work.
* Experience with security and security analysis.
* Experience coding in one or more general purpose languages.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of experience in responding to security problems in target-rich environments, looking at security alerts, forensic analysis, or incident response.
* Programming experience in Python, Go, C/C++, or Java.

* Expertise in analysis of large data sets or logs to find patterns or interesting activities (using SQL, or custom tools).
* Demonstrated expertise with threat detection development or threat hunting.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

Part of Google's Detection and Response team, we monitor Google’s network and systems for threats to information security. This team builds detection to secure our production systems from insider threats, hackers, and exploits. We strive to accomplish this in the least intrusive way possible, protecting Google’s culture and innovative practices.

### Responsibilities

* Build new detection capabilities to protect our Google intellectual property, business data, and user data.
* Hunt for and respond to security events on Google's networks as part of our 24/7 global operation.

* Investigate a wide variety of security events across various Alphabet systems to assess threats to Google or its customers.

* Collaborate with teams across Google to model insider risks and cultivate new data sources.

* Participate in response to large-scale security incidents.

## Early

Experience completing work as directed, and collaborating with teammates; developing knowledge of relevant concepts and processes.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 1 year of experience in security analysis, risk modeling, or security detection scoped work.
* Experience with security and security analysis.
* Experience coding in one or more general purpose languages.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of experience in responding to security problems in target-rich environments, looking at security alerts, forensic analysis, or incident response.
* Programming experience in Python, Go, C/C++, or Java.

* Expertise in analysis of large data sets or logs to find patterns or interesting activities (using SQL, or custom tools).
* Demonstrated expertise with threat detection development or threat hunting.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

Part of Google's Detection and Response team, we monitor Google’s network and systems for threats to information security. This team builds detection to secure our production systems from insider threats, hackers, and exploits. We strive to accomplish this in the least intrusive way possible, protecting Google’s culture and innovative practices.

### Responsibilities

* Build new detection capabilities to protect our Google intellectual property, business data, and user data.
* Hunt for and respond to security events on Google's networks as part of our 24/7 global operation.

* Investigate a wide variety of security events across various Alphabet systems to assess threats to Google or its customers.

* Collaborate with teams across Google to model insider risks and cultivate new data sources.

* Participate in response to large-scale security incidents.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 7 years of experience in business development, partnerships, management consulting, or investment banking, in the Consumer Electronics, Auto, OEMs, Telecom, E-Commerce/Retail, Apps, Ads, Gaming, or Technology industries.
* Experience working with C-level executives and cross-functionally across all levels of management.

* Experience managing agreements or partnerships.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or other advanced degree.

* Experience managing complex, end-to-end partnerships.

* Experience working autonomously in a dynamic, ever-changing, and collaborative environment.

* Ability to identify potential business opportunities, assess financial/business benefit, structure agreements, and discuss terms with strategic partners.

* Ability to communicate fluently in English and at least one of the following languages: French or German in order to support client relationship management in these regions.

### About the job

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

The Knowledge & Information (K&I) Partnerships team helps Google build products by leading our engagement with a wide range of external partners. We enable strong, locally relevant products by negotiating and managing things like content partnerships (e.g., data licensing agreements) and actions integrations. These partnerships help build and differentiate Google’s products in several areas, including: Search, Gemini, Geo (Maps, Local), Research and Machine Intelligence, as well as Commerce and Ads.

The K&I Search and Gemini Partnerships team is seeking an exceptional Googler passionate about unlocking distribution opportunities across Google search, Gemini product areas. You will be responsible for developing deep partnerships, driving platform deals and engagements, and enabling features and experiences that improve user experiences across partner ecosystems. This involves establishing and managing end-to-end partnerships, from defining the partner strategy to executing the project plan.

The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

### Responsibilities

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with multiple high-stakes partners as a key contributor to Search and Gemini product goals. Manage existing partnerships, launch new relationships, drive new business opportunities, resolve business issues, and analyze and track key metrics to identify trends.
* Drive the end-to-end partner experience, ensuring successful agreement integration, including negotiating and finalizing contracts, executing account plans, pitching to partners, resolving partner issues, and advocating on behalf of the partner.
* Execute Go-to-Market plans with ambitious goals to establish new products in the region by establishing and signing new partnerships.
* Influence and collaborate effectively with other teams (Product, Engineering, Legal, and other cross-functional teams) to align resources and direction for go-to-market strategy or partner initiatives.
* Drive partner strategy, including prospecting for new partners and opportunities, conducting partner/industry research, and collaborating on product strategy.

# Mezzogiorno

Provate i progressi di guida, risolvendo i problemi, e guidando più membri del team junior; competenze più profonde e conoscenze applicate all'interno di area rilevante.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

* 7 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, partnership, consulenza di gestione o investment banking, nel settore Consumer Electronics, Auto, OEM, Telecom, E-Commerce/Retail, Apps, Ads, Gaming, o Technology.
* Esperienza di lavoro con dirigenti a livello C e cross-functionally su tutti i livelli di gestione.

* Esperienza di gestione accordi o partenariati.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale o altro grado avanzato.

* Esperienza di gestione di partnership complesse e end-to-end.

* Esperienza di lavoro autonomamente in un ambiente dinamico, in continua evoluzione e collaborativo.

* Capacità di identificare potenziali opportunità di business, valutare le indennità finanziarie/commerciali, accordi di struttura e discutere i termini con partner strategici.

* Capacità di comunicare fluentemente in inglese e almeno una delle seguenti lingue: francese o tedesco al fine di supportare la gestione dei rapporti con i clienti in queste regioni.

### Riguardo al lavoro

La linea di prodotti e servizi di Google per i nostri clienti non smette mai di crescere. Il team di Partnerships Development è responsabile per la ricerca e l'esplorazione di nuove opportunità con i partner di Google. Equipaggiato con il tuo business acum e la vasta conoscenza del prodotto, sei proprio sulla linea anteriore di interagire con i nostri partner, e aiutarli a trovare modi per crescere utilizzando le nuove offerte di prodotto di Google. La vostra conoscenza di verticali e relazioni rilevanti con i giocatori chiave del settore contribuirà a modellare le nostre grandi applicazioni e contenuti per prodotti come YouTube, Google TV e Commercio.

Il team di Knowledge & Information (K&I) Partnerships aiuta Google a costruire prodotti guidando il nostro impegno con una vasta gamma di partner esterni. Consentiamo prodotti forti e localmente rilevanti negoziando e gestendo cose come i partenariati di contenuti (ad esempio, accordi di licenza di dati) e integrazioni di azioni. Questi partenariati aiutano a costruire e differenziare i prodotti di Google in diversi settori, tra cui: Ricerca, Gemelli, Geo (Maps, Local), Ricerca e Machine Intelligence, così come Commercio e annunci.

Il team di K&I Search e Gemini Partnerships sta cercando un Googler eccezionale appassionato di sbloccare le opportunità di distribuzione attraverso le aree di ricerca di Google, prodotti Gemini. Sarete responsabili per lo sviluppo di partnership profonde, offerte piattaforma di guida e impegni, e per consentire funzionalità ed esperienze che migliorano le esperienze degli utenti in ecosistemi partner. Ciò comporta la creazione e la gestione di partenariati end-to-end, dalla definizione della strategia partner per l'esecuzione del piano di progetto.

L'organizzazione Global Partnerships è responsabile dell'esplorazione di nuove opportunità con i partner di Google. Il team di Google Global Partnerships lavora con una vasta gamma di partner per portare il meglio di Google per alimentare il loro business. Il team di Global Partnerships supporta i propri team di prodotti di Google con partnership essenziali per aiutare le esperienze degli utenti di Google nella pubblicità, Ricerca, Assistente, Mappe, Viaggi, Shopping, Pagamenti e altro ancora. I team creano partnership, strategie di go-to-market e crescita aziendale incubata per una varietà di prodotti.

### responsabilità

* Costruire e mantenere relazioni strategiche con più partner di alto livello come contributore chiave agli obiettivi di ricerca e di prodotto Gemini. Gestire partnership esistenti, lanciare nuove relazioni, guidare nuove opportunità di business, risolvere problemi di business, e analizzare e tracciare metriche chiave per identificare le tendenze.
* Guidare l'esperienza partner end-to-end, garantire l'integrazione di un accordo di successo, compresi i contratti di negoziazione e di finalizzazione, l'esecuzione dei piani di account, il lancio a partner, la risoluzione dei problemi dei partner, e sostenendo per conto del partner.
* Eseguire i piani Go-to-Market con obiettivi ambiziosi per stabilire nuovi prodotti nella regione, stabilendo e firmando nuove partnership.
* Influenza e collaborare efficacemente con altri team (Product, Engineering, Legal e altri team interfunzionali) per allineare le risorse e la direzione per strategie di go-to-market o iniziative partner.
* Guidare la strategia partner, tra cui la prospettiva di nuovi partner e opportunità, condurre la ricerca partner / industria, e la collaborazione sulla strategia di prodotto.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 7 years of experience in business development, partnerships, management consulting, or investment banking, in the Consumer Electronics, Auto, OEMs, Telecom, E-Commerce/Retail, Apps, Ads, Gaming, or Technology industries.
* Experience working with C-level executives and cross-functionally across all levels of management.

* Experience managing agreements or partnerships.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or other advanced degree.

* Experience managing complex, end-to-end partnerships.

* Experience working autonomously in a dynamic, ever-changing, and collaborative environment.

* Ability to identify potential business opportunities, assess financial/business benefit, structure agreements, and discuss terms with strategic partners.

* Ability to communicate fluently in English and at least one of the following languages: French or German in order to support client relationship management in these regions.

### About the job

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

The Knowledge & Information (K&I) Partnerships team helps Google build products by leading our engagement with a wide range of external partners. We enable strong, locally relevant products by negotiating and managing things like content partnerships (e.g., data licensing agreements) and actions integrations. These partnerships help build and differentiate Google’s products in several areas, including: Search, Gemini, Geo (Maps, Local), Research and Machine Intelligence, as well as Commerce and Ads.

The K&I Search and Gemini Partnerships team is seeking an exceptional Googler passionate about unlocking distribution opportunities across Google search, Gemini product areas. You will be responsible for developing deep partnerships, driving platform deals and engagements, and enabling features and experiences that improve user experiences across partner ecosystems. This involves establishing and managing end-to-end partnerships, from defining the partner strategy to executing the project plan.

The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

### Responsibilities

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with multiple high-stakes partners as a key contributor to Search and Gemini product goals. Manage existing partnerships, launch new relationships, drive new business opportunities, resolve business issues, and analyze and track key metrics to identify trends.
* Drive the end-to-end partner experience, ensuring successful agreement integration, including negotiating and finalizing contracts, executing account plans, pitching to partners, resolving partner issues, and advocating on behalf of the partner.
* Execute Go-to-Market plans with ambitious goals to establish new products in the region by establishing and signing new partnerships.
* Influence and collaborate effectively with other teams (Product, Engineering, Legal, and other cross-functional teams) to align resources and direction for go-to-market strategy or partner initiatives.
* Drive partner strategy, including prospecting for new partners and opportunities, conducting partner/industry research, and collaborating on product strategy.

## Mitte

Erleben Sie, wie Sie Fortschritte vorantreiben, Probleme lösen und mehr jüngere Teammitglieder betreuen; tieferes Fachwissen und angewandtes Wissen in relevanten Bereichen.

Beantragen

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

* 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Partnerschaften, Managementberatung oder Investment Banking, in den Branchen Consumer Electronics, Auto, OEMs, Telekommunikation, E-Commerce / Einzelhandel, Apps, Anzeigen, Gaming oder Technologie.
* Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften auf C-Ebene und funktionsübergreifend auf allen Managementebenen.

* Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Vereinbarungen oder Partnerschaften.

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master oder andere fortgeschrittene Grad.

* Erfahrung in der Verwaltung komplexer, durchgängiger Partnerschaften.

* Erleben Sie autonomes Arbeiten in einer dynamischen, sich ständig verändernden und kollaborativen Umgebung.

* Fähigkeit, potenzielle Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren, den finanziellen / geschäftlichen Nutzen zu bewerten, Vereinbarungen zu strukturieren und Bedingungen mit strategischen Partnern zu besprechen.

* Fähigkeit, fließend in Englisch und mindestens einer der folgenden Sprachen zu kommunizieren: Französisch oder Deutsch, um das Kundenbeziehungsmanagement in diesen Regionen zu unterstützen.

### Über den Job

Die Produkt- und Servicelinie von Google für unsere Kunden wächst immer weiter. Das Team für Partnerschaftsentwicklung ist dafür verantwortlich, neue Möglichkeiten mit den Partnern von Google zu suchen und zu erkunden. Ausgestattet mit Ihrem Geschäftssinn und umfangreichem Produktwissen stehen Sie an vorderster Front bei der Interaktion mit unseren Partnern und helfen ihnen, Wege zu finden, um mit den neuesten Produktangeboten von Google zu wachsen. Ihr Wissen über relevante Branchen und Beziehungen zu wichtigen Branchenakteuren wird dazu beitragen, unsere großartigen Anwendungen und Inhalte für Produkte wie YouTube, Google TV und Commerce zu gestalten.

Das Team von Knowledge & Information (K&I) Partnerships unterstützt Google bei der Entwicklung von Produkten, indem es unser Engagement mit einer Vielzahl von externen Partnern leitet. Wir ermöglichen starke, lokal relevante Produkte, indem wir Inhaltepartnerschaften (z. B. Datenlizenzvereinbarungen) und Maßnahmenintegrationen aushandeln und verwalten. Diese Partnerschaften tragen dazu bei, die Produkte von Google in verschiedenen Bereichen zu entwickeln und zu differenzieren, darunter Search, Gemini, Geo (Maps, Local), Research und Machine Intelligence sowie Commerce und Ads.

Das Team von K&I Search und Gemini Partnerships sucht einen außergewöhnlichen Googler, der sich für die Erschließung von Vertriebsmöglichkeiten in den Produktbereichen Google Search und Gemini begeistert. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Entwicklung tiefer Partnerschaften, die Förderung von Plattform-Deals und -Engagements sowie die Ermöglichung von Funktionen und Erfahrungen, die die Benutzererfahrung in Partner-Ökosystemen verbessern. Dies beinhaltet die Einrichtung und Verwaltung von End-to-End-Partnerschaften, von der Definition der Partnerstrategie bis zur Ausführung des Projektplans.

Die Organisation Global Partnerships ist dafür verantwortlich, neue Möglichkeiten mit den Partnern von Google zu erkunden. Das Team von Google Global Partnerships arbeitet mit einer Vielzahl von Partnern zusammen, um das Beste von Google für sein Geschäft zu nutzen. Das Team von Global Partnerships unterstützt die eigenen Produktteams von Google mit wichtigen Partnerschaften, um die Benutzererfahrungen von Google in den Bereichen Werbung, Suche, Assistent, Karten, Reisen, Einkaufen, Zahlungen und mehr zu verbessern. Teams schaffen produktfähige Partnerschaften, Go-to-Market-Strategien und fördern das Geschäftswachstum für eine Vielzahl von Produkten.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Aufbau und Pflege strategischer Beziehungen mit mehreren High-Stakes-Partnern als wichtiger Beitrag zu den Produktzielen von Search und Gemini. Verwalten Sie bestehende Partnerschaften, starten Sie neue Beziehungen, fördern Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, lösen Sie Geschäftsprobleme und analysieren und verfolgen Sie wichtige Metriken, um Trends zu identifizieren.
* Fördern Sie die End-to-End-Partnererfahrung, indem Sie eine erfolgreiche Vertragsintegration sicherstellen, einschließlich der Verhandlung und des Abschlusses von Verträgen, der Ausführung von Kontoplänen, des Pitchens an Partner, der Lösung von Partnerproblemen und der Verteidigung im Namen des Partners.
* Umsetzung von Go-to-Market-Plänen mit ehrgeizigen Zielen zur Etablierung neuer Produkte in der Region durch Gründung und Unterzeichnung neuer Partnerschaften.
* Einfluss nehmen und effektiv mit anderen Teams (Produkt-, Ingenieur-, Rechts- und andere funktionsübergreifende Teams) zusammenarbeiten, um Ressourcen und Richtung für Go-to-Market-Strategien oder Partnerinitiativen auszurichten.
* Förderung der Partnerstrategie, einschließlich der Suche nach neuen Partnern und Möglichkeiten, Durchführung von Partner-/Industrieforschung und Zusammenarbeit bei der Produktstrategie.

## Moyenne

Expérience de la conduite des progrès, de la résolution des problèmes et du mentorat d'un plus grand nombre de membres de l'équipe junior; expertise approfondie et connaissances appliquées dans le domaine pertinent.

Appliquer

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

* 7 ans d'expérience en développement d'entreprise, en partenariat, en conseil en gestion ou en banque d'investissement, dans les industries de l'électronique de consommation, de l'automobile, des OEM, des télécommunications, du commerce électronique/de détail, des applications, des publicités, des jeux ou de la technologie.
* Expérience de travail avec des cadres de niveau C et interfonctionnellement à tous les niveaux de gestion.

* Expérience de gestion des ententes ou des partenariats.

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise ou autre diplôme avancé.

* Expérience de gestion de partenariats complexes de bout en bout.

* Expérience de travail autonome dans un environnement dynamique, en constante évolution et collaboratif.

* Capacité de déterminer les possibilités d'affaires potentielles, d'évaluer les avantages financiers et commerciaux, de structurer les ententes et de discuter des modalités avec les partenaires stratégiques.

* Capacité de communiquer couramment en anglais et dans au moins une des langues suivantes : français ou allemand afin de soutenir la gestion de la relation client dans ces régions.

### Sur le travail

La gamme de produits et de services de Google à nos clients ne cesse jamais de croître. L'équipe de développement des partenariats est chargée de rechercher et d'explorer de nouvelles opportunités avec les partenaires de Google. Équipés de votre sens de l'entreprise et d'une vaste connaissance des produits, vous êtes en première ligne d'interagir avec nos partenaires, et les aider à trouver des moyens de croître en utilisant les nouvelles offres de produits de Google. Vos connaissances des verticales pertinentes et des relations avec les principaux acteurs de l'industrie aideront à façonner nos applications et notre contenu pour des produits tels que YouTube, Google TV et Commerce.

L'équipe de Partenariats du savoir et de l'information (K & I) aide Google à créer des produits en dirigeant notre engagement auprès d'un large éventail de partenaires externes. Nous permettons des produits solides et pertinents localement en négociant et en gérant des choses comme les partenariats de contenu (p. ex., les accords de licence de données) et les intégrations d'actions. Ces partenariats aident à construire et à différencier les produits de Google dans plusieurs domaines, y compris: Recherche, Gemini, Geo (Cartes, Local), Recherche et Intelligence Machine, ainsi que Commerce et annonces.

L'équipe K&I Search et Gemini Partnerships est à la recherche d'un Googler exceptionnel passionné par les possibilités de distribution dans les domaines de recherche Google, Gemini. Vous serez responsable du développement de partenariats profonds, des accords de plate-forme et des engagements, et des fonctionnalités et expériences habilitantes qui améliorent l'expérience des utilisateurs dans les écosystèmes partenaires. Il s'agit d'établir et de gérer des partenariats de bout en bout, depuis la définition de la stratégie des partenaires jusqu'à l'exécution du plan de projet.

L'organisation Global Partnerships est chargée d'explorer de nouvelles opportunités avec les partenaires de Google. L'équipe de partenariat mondial de GoogleS travaille avec un large éventail de partenaires pour apporter le meilleur de Google pour alimenter leur entreprise. L'équipe Global Partnerships prend en charge ses propres équipes de produits avec des partenariats essentiels pour aider Google Expériences utilisateur dans la publicité, Recherche, Assistant, Cartes, Voyage, Shopping, Paiements et plus encore. Les équipes créent des partenariats axés sur les produits, des stratégies de mise en marché et incubent la croissance des entreprises pour une variété de produits.

### Responsabilités

* Établir et maintenir des relations stratégiques avec de nombreux partenaires de haut niveau en tant que contributeur clé aux objectifs de recherche et de produits Gemini. Gérer les partenariats existants, lancer de nouvelles relations, créer de nouvelles occasions d'affaires, résoudre les problèmes d'affaires, et analyser et suivre les principales mesures pour identifier les tendances.
* Exploiter l'expérience des partenaires de bout en bout, assurer la réussite de l'intégration des ententes, y compris la négociation et la finalisation des contrats, l'exécution des plans de compte, la présentation aux partenaires, la résolution des problèmes des partenaires et la défense des intérêts du partenaire.
* Exécuter des plans d'accès au marché avec des objectifs ambitieux pour établir de nouveaux produits dans la région en établissant et en signant de nouveaux partenariats.
* Influencer et collaborer efficacement avec d'autres équipes (produits, génie, services juridiques et autres équipes interfonctionnelles) pour harmoniser les ressources et l'orientation des stratégies de mise en marché ou des initiatives de partenaires.
* Encourager la stratégie des partenaires, y compris la prospection de nouveaux partenaires et de nouvelles possibilités, mener des recherches sur les partenaires et l'industrie et collaborer à la stratégie des produits.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).
* 1 year of experience with Computer Vision (e.g., image classification and processing, object detection, visual search), video generation, or signal processing.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Proficiency in code and system health, diagnosis and resolution, and software test engineering.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Develop innovative computer vision and machine learning technology for applications in the field of spatial AI and context awareness.
* Productionalize innovative computer vision, deep learning and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the area of third-dimension (3D) scene understanding, including the design and implementation of such algorithms targeted at XR devices such as headsets and glasses.
* Lead the charge in developing and deploying Sensing across a range of XR products and use-cases.
* Collaborate strategically, directly interfacing with system owners to jointly define roadmaps for major XR perception endpoints.
* Scale our impact by developing robust systems and processes that ensure XR perception can support geometric and semantic sensing across a range of products and use cases

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o equivalente esperienza pratica. * 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. * 1 anno di esperienza con l'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione di modelli, valutazione di modelli, ottimizzazione, elaborazione dati, debugging). * 1 anno di esperienza con Computer Vision (ad esempio, classificazione ed elaborazione di immagini, rilevamento di oggetti, ricerca visiva), generazione di video, o elaborazione di segnali.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o un campo tecnico correlato. * 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi. * L'esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili. * Proficienza in salute di codice e sistema, diagnosi e risoluzione, e software test engineering.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s ha bisogno con l'opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda fast-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership ed essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia. Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da

scoperte in calcolo, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. XR di Google

team è in prima linea nel prossimo grande salto. la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di un semplice nuovo dispositivo. si tratta di reimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo intorno a noi. Stiamo costruendo un futuro dove

dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali intelligenti e cuffie abbinano con AI utile per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversative e contestuali.

Responsabilità

* Sviluppare una visione innovativa del computer e una tecnologia di apprendimento automatico per applicazioni nel campo della consapevolezza dello spazio e del contesto. * Producibilità di visione innovativa del computer, apprendimento profondo e intelligenza artificiale (AI) nell'area della comprensione della scena di terza-Fnder 3D, compresa la progettazione e l'implementazione di tali algoritmi mirati a dispositivi XR come auricolari e occhiali. * Guidare la carica nello sviluppo e nella distribuzione di Sensing in una gamma di prodotti XR e casi di utilizzo.

* Il sistema è strategicamente in contatto diretto con i proprietari di sistemi per definire insieme le tabelle di marcia per i principali endpoint di percezione XR. * Scala il nostro impatto sviluppando sistemi e processi robusti che garantiscono che la percezione XR possa supportare il rilevamento geometrico e semantico in una gamma di prodotti e casi di utilizzo

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Develop innovative computer vision and machine learning technology for applications in the field of spatial AI and context awareness.
* Productionalize innovative computer vision, deep learning and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the area of third-dimension (3D) scene understanding, including the design and implementation of such algorithms targeted at XR devices such as headsets and glasses.
* Lead the charge in developing and deploying Sensing across a range of XR products and use-cases.
* Collaborate strategically, directly interfacing with system owners to jointly define roadmaps for major XR perception endpoints.
* Scale our impact by developing robust systems and processes that ensure XR perception can support geometric and semantic sensing across a range of products and use cases

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion von Milliarden von Nutzern mit Informationen und anderen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinausreichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zur Umstellung von Teams und Projekten im Zuge des Wachstums und der Entwicklung unserer schnelllebigen Geschäftsfelder ausgestattet ist. Unsere Ingenieure müssen vielseitig sein, Führungsqualitäten aufweisen und sich für die Bewältigung neuer Probleme im gesamten Gesamtumfang begeistern, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. Seit Jahrzehnten hat die Computerrevolution unsere Welt geprägt von

Durchbrüche in Computing, Konnektivität, Mobil, und jetzt, KI. Googles XR

team ist an der Spitze des nächsten großen Sprungs – die Konvergenz von KI und XR. Dies ist mehr als nur neue Geräte – es geht um die Neugestaltung, wie wir mit der Welt um uns herum interagieren.

leichte XR-Geräte wie Smart-Brillen und Headsets verbinden sich mit hilfreicher KI, um menschliche Intelligenz zu erweitern und personalisierte, gesprächs- und kontextbezogene Erlebnisse zu bieten.

Zuständigkeiten

* Entwicklung innovativer Computer Vision und Machine Learning Technologie für Anwendungen im Bereich der räumlichen KI und Kontextbewusstsein. * Produktionalisieren Sie innovative Computer Vision, Deep Learning und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) im Bereich der dritten-Meilen (3D) Szene Verständnis, einschließlich der Gestaltung und Implementierung solcher Algorithmen auf XR-Geräte wie Headsets und Brillen. * Führen Sie die Verantwortung bei der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Sensing über eine Reihe von XR-Produkte und Anwendungsfälle.

* Zusammenarbeit mit Systembetreibern, um gemeinsam Roadmaps für wichtige Endpunkte der XR-Wahrnehmung zu definieren. * Skalieren Sie unsere Wirkung durch die Entwicklung robuster Systeme und Prozesse, die gewährleisten, dass die XR-Wahrnehmung die geometrische und semantische Erfassung über eine Reihe von Produkten und Anwendungsfällen unterstützen kann.

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 8 years of experience as a sales engineer or technical consultant in a cloud computing environment or in a customer-facing role.

* 2 years of experience managing a software engineering, FDE, or similar technical customer-facing team in a cloud computing environment.

* Experience in Python or similar coding language.

* Experience developing AI/GenAI solutions utilizing AI tools, or designing multi-agent workflows or RAG systems.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

* Experience designing end-to-end secure, observable multi-agent systems using complex design patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection), state management, and tool-calling protocols.
* Experience designing intuitive interfaces for complex AI and agentic systems, prioritizing context engineering, transparency, and explainability to foster user trust.
* Experience architecting AI solutions within complex infrastructures, ensuring data sovereignty and secure governance.
* Experience performing discovery interviews to identify business problems and translate complex hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.

### About the job

As a Manager of a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, you will lead engineers who bridge the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. You will be responsible for a team that doesn't just consult, but codes, debugs and jointly deploys bespoke agentic solutions directly within customer environments. In this role, you will provide deep-dive technical mentorship to your team while balancing high-level alignment with Product, Engineering, and Google Cloud Regional Sales leadership. You will empower and unblock your team as they resolve production-level obstacles, including data readiness issues, integration complexities, and state-management issues that hinder AI from achieving enterprise-grade maturity.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale.
