### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 8 years of experience as a sales engineer or technical consultant in a cloud computing environment or in a customer-facing role.

* 2 years of experience managing a software engineering, FDE, or similar technical customer-facing team in a cloud computing environment.

* Experience in Python or similar coding language.

* Experience developing AI/GenAI solutions utilizing AI tools, or designing multi-agent workflows or RAG systems.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

* Experience designing end-to-end secure, observable multi-agent systems using complex design patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection), state management, and tool-calling protocols.
* Experience designing intuitive interfaces for complex AI and agentic systems, prioritizing context engineering, transparency, and explainability to foster user trust.
* Experience architecting AI solutions within complex infrastructures, ensuring data sovereignty and secure governance.

### About the job

You will be responsible for a team that doesn't just consult, but codes, debugs and jointly deploys bespoke agentic solutions directly within customer environments. In this role, you will provide deep-dive technical mentorship to your team while balancing high-level alignment with Product, Engineering, and Google Cloud Regional Sales leadership. You will empower and unblock your team as they resolve production-level obstacles, including data readiness issues, integration complexities, and state-management issues that hinder AI from achieving enterprise-grade maturity.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre l'équipe Go-To-Market de Google Cloud, qui mène la révolution de l'IA pour les entreprises du monde entier. Vous excellerez en tirant parti de la crédibilité de la marque de Google – un héritage fondé sur l'invention de technologies fondamentales et prouvé à l'échelle. Nous vous fournissons le portefeuille AI le plus avancé au monde, y compris les modèles frontière Gemini, et la plateforme Altex AI complète, vous aidant à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires. Nous sommes une culture collaborative offrant un accès direct aux esprits d'ingénierie et de recherche de DeepMind, vous permettant de résoudre les défis des clients. Rejoignez-nous pour être le catalyseur de notre mission, stimuler le succès client et définir la nouvelle ère du cloud – le marché est à vous. ### Responsabilités * Servir de chef de file technique, établir des normes de code, des pratiques exemplaires en matière d'architecture et des points de repère pour élever l'excellence en génie dans toute l'équipe. * Partenaire avec Sales and Tech Leadership pour définir les exigences pour des opportunités de grande valeur, en déployant des experts spécialisés (MLOps, GenMedia ou systèmes Agentic) sur des comptes clés. * Diriger l'embauche technique pour le FDE, évaluer l'expertise AI/ML, l'ingénierie des systèmes et les compétences en codage pour constituer une équipe d'ingénierie exceptionnelle. * Recenser les lacunes en matière de compétences dans les nouvelles technologies (protocole de contexte de modèle, appel d'outils et modèles de base), en veillant à ce que l'équipe conserve l'expertise en matière dans une pile d'IA en évolution. * Collaborer avec Produits et Ingénierie pour résoudre les obstacles et traduire les connaissances sur le terrain en feuilles de route tout en construisant des outils internes pour stimuler l'efficacité organisationnelle.

## Senior Field Sales Account Manager, Google Cloud

_share_

* _email_ Email a friend

_corporate\_fare_ Google _place_ Zürich, Switzerland

_\_bar\\_chart\__ Advanced

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of sales experience in the technology industry with SaaS, PaaS or IaaS products and platforms.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience with large, complex commercial and legal negotiations working with procurement, legal, and business teams.
* Experience promoting Google Cloud computing technologies to large and complex organizations across geographies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and import and export talent and ideas to achieve a broader organizational goal.
* Ability to influence decisions at the executive level.
* Ability to present analyses and break down technical concepts into simple terms to present to technical and non-technical audiences.

### About the job

As a Field Sales Representative (FSR) focused on developing and growing a strategic manufacturing enterprise account, your primary responsibility is to grow Google Cloud’s share of the customer’s wallet and secure incremental workloads to accelerate their consumption and revenue.

You will co-lead the engagement with the account and assist them in solving their complex challenges with our solutions. Your success will rely upon your ability to identify specific business problems, work seamlessly with stakeholders across the account, and partner with your extended team to develop technical solutions to solve them. You will be responsible for building meaningful relationships across various levels within the account, from developers to C-suite executives, which includes preparing for and facilitating high-stakes executive briefings.

Additionally, you will lead a cross-functional team and leverage the right resources including customer engineering, business development, cross-functional sellers, and system integrator partners, to maximize outcomes.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

### Responsibilities

* Create, build, and maintain customer relationships, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor on their long-term strategy, technology, and business decisions, particularly in the context of IT and manufacturing transformation.
* Collaborate closely with the Key Account Director, Principal Architect, Customer Engineers, Product Management, and Partners, in alignment with the overarching account strategy, to lead prospecting, identification, and acquisition of new workloads to meet and exceed growth ambitions.
* Become an expert on the customer's business, including their digital and product portfolio, technology strategy, strategic growth plans, business drivers, financial structure, vertical market offering, and engaged landscape.
* Manage complex business cycles, lead commercial agreements, present to C-level executives, and negotiate terms.

Avanzato

Esperienza dei risultati e del processo decisionale, risoluzione di problemi ambigui e influenza delle parti interessate; competenza approfondita in materia.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 10 anni di esperienza commerciale nel settore tecnologico con prodotti e piattaforme SaaS, PaaS o IaaS.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Esperienza con grandi, complesse trattative commerciali e legali che lavorano con i team di approvvigionamento, legali e di business. * Esperienza promuovendo le tecnologie di calcolo di Google Cloud a grandi e complesse organizzazioni attraverso le geografie. * Capacità di collaborare efficacemente attraverso i confini organizzativi, costruire relazioni, e importare ed esportare talenti e idee per raggiungere un obiettivo organizzativo più ampio. * Capacità di influenzare le decisioni a livello esecutivo. * Capacità di presentare analisi e scomporre concetti tecnici in termini semplici da presentare a pubblico tecnico e non tecnico.

Riguardo il lavoro

Come rappresentante di Field Sales (FSR) focalizzato sullo sviluppo e la crescita di un account aziendale di produzione strategica, la vostra responsabilità principale è quella di aumentare la quota di Google Cloud.s del portafoglio del cliente.s e di garantire carichi di lavoro incrementale per accelerare i loro consumi e ricavi.

Co-leader dell'impegno con l'account e li aiuterà a risolvere le loro complesse sfide con le nostre soluzioni. Il vostro successo si baserà sulla vostra capacità di identificare specifici problemi aziendali, lavorare senza soluzione di continuità con le parti interessate in tutto il conto, e partner con il vostro team esteso per sviluppare soluzioni tecniche per risolverli. Sarete responsabili della costruzione di relazioni significative attraverso vari livelli all'interno del conto, dagli sviluppatori ai dirigenti C-suite, che comprende la preparazione e la facilitazione di riunioni esecutive ad alto livello.

Inoltre, guiderai un team interfunzionale e sfrutterai le risorse giuste, tra cui ingegneria dei clienti, sviluppo aziendale, venditori cross-funzionali e partner di sistema di 11 e 11, per massimizzare i risultati.

Google Cloud accelera la capacità di ogni organizzazione di trasformare digitalmente il proprio business e il proprio settore. Offriamo soluzioni di livello enterprise che sfruttano la tecnologia all'avanguardia di Google.s e strumenti che aiutano gli sviluppatori a costruire in modo più sostenibile. I clienti in più di 200 paesi e territori si rivolgono a Google Cloud come partner di fiducia per consentire la crescita e risolvere i loro problemi più critici di business.

Responsabilità

* Creare, costruire e mantenere relazioni con i clienti, stabilendosi come consulente di fiducia sulla loro strategia, tecnologia e decisioni a lungo termine e business, in particolare nel contesto della trasformazione IT e della produzione. * 21a, in stretta collaborazione con il direttore dell'account chiave, Principal Architect, Customer Engineers, Product Management, e Partners, in linea con la strategia globale dell'account, per condurre la prospezione, l'identificazione e l'acquisizione di nuovi carichi di lavoro per soddisfare e superare le ambizioni di crescita.

* Diventare un esperto sul business del cliente, tra cui il loro portafoglio di prodotti e digitali, strategia tecnologica, piani di crescita strategica, driver aziendali, struttura finanziaria, offerta verticale di mercato, e paesaggio impegnato. * Gestire cicli aziendali complessi, condurre accordi commerciali, presenti a livello C-level dirigenti, e negoziare termini.

Erweitert

Erfahrung im Besitz von Ergebnissen und Entscheidungsfindung, Lösung von mehrdeutigen Problemen und Einflussnahme auf die Interessenträger;tiefes Fachwissen im Bereich.

Anwenden

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 10 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung in der Technologiebranche mit SaaS, PaaS oder IaaS Produkten und Plattformen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Erfahrung mit großen, komplexen kommerziellen und rechtlichen Verhandlungen, die mit Beschaffungs-, Rechts- und Geschäftsteams arbeiten. * Erfahrung mit Google Cloud-Computing-Technologien für große und komplexe Organisationen in allen Regionen. * Fähigkeit, über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg effektiv zusammenzuarbeiten, Beziehungen aufzubauen, Talente und Ideen zu importieren und zu exportieren, um ein breiteres Organisationsziel zu erreichen. * Fähigkeit, Entscheidungen auf der Exekutivebene zu beeinflussen. * Fähigkeit, Analysen darzustellen und technische Konzepte in einfache Begriffe zu zerlegen, um technischen und nicht-technischen Zielgruppen zu präsentieren.

Über den Job

Als Field Sales Representative (FSR) konzentriert sich die Entwicklung und der Ausbau eines strategischen Unternehmenskontos für die Herstellung von Produkten auf Ihre Hauptverantwortung: die Google Cloud, den Anteil des Kunden, die Brieftasche und die Sicherung zusätzlicher Arbeitsbelastungen, um ihren Verbrauch und Umsatz zu beschleunigen.

Sie werden die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Account führen und sie bei der Lösung ihrer komplexen Herausforderungen mit unseren Lösungen unterstützen. Ihr Erfolg beruht auf Ihrer Fähigkeit, spezifische Geschäftsprobleme zu identifizieren, nahtlos mit Stakeholdern über den Account hinweg zusammenzuarbeiten und mit Ihrem erweiterten Team technische Lösungen zu entwickeln, um diese zu lösen. Sie sind verantwortlich für den Aufbau sinnvoller Beziehungen über verschiedene Ebenen innerhalb des Accounts, von Entwicklern bis zu C-Suite-Führungskräften, die die Vorbereitung und Erleichterung von High-Stakes Executive Briefings umfasst.

Darüber hinaus führen Sie ein funktionsübergreifendes Team und nutzen die richtigen Ressourcen, einschließlich Customer Engineering, Business Development, funktionsübergreifende Verkäufer und Systemintegrator-Partner, um die Ergebnisse zu maximieren.

Google Cloud beschleunigt jede Organisation, die in der Lage ist, ihre Unternehmen und ihre Industrie digital zu verändern. Wir bieten Lösungen für Unternehmen, die Google, modernste Technologien und Tools nutzen, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Gebieten wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre kritischsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen.

Zuständigkeiten

* Erstellen, bauen und pflegen Sie Kundenbeziehungen, indem Sie sich als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für ihre langfristige Strategie, Technologie und Geschäftsentscheidungen, insbesondere im Kontext der IT- und Fertigungstransformation, etablieren. * Eng mit dem Key Account Director, Principal Architect, Customer Engineers, Product Management und Partner zusammenarbeiten, um in Abstimmung mit der übergeordneten Account-Strategie die Erkundung, Identifizierung und Beschaffung neuer Workloads zu ermöglichen, um Wachstumsambitionen zu erfüllen und zu übertreffen.

* Werden Sie ein Experte für das Geschäft des Kunden, einschließlich ihres digitalen und Produktportfolios, Technologiestrategie, strategische Wachstumspläne, Geschäftstreiber, Finanzstruktur, vertikales Marktangebot und engagierte Landschaft. * Verwalten Sie komplexe Geschäftszyklen, leiten Sie kommerzielle Vereinbarungen, präsentieren Sie C-Level-Manager, und verhandeln Sie Bedingungen.

Avancé

Expérience de la propriété des résultats et de la prise de décisions, de la résolution des problèmes ambigus et de l'influence des parties prenantes; expertise dans le domaine.

Appliquer

Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 10 ans d'expérience commerciale dans l'industrie de la technologie avec les produits et les plateformes SaaS, PaaS ou IaaS.

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* Expérience de la mise en oeuvre de négociations commerciales et juridiques complexes et de vastes équipes d'approvisionnement, de droit et d'affaires. * Expérience de la promotion des technologies de calcul Google Cloud auprès des grandes et complexes organisations à travers les géographies. * Capacité de collaborer efficacement au-delà des frontières organisationnelles, d'établir des relations et d'importer et d'exporter des talents et des idées pour atteindre un objectif organisationnel plus large. * Capacité d'influencer les décisions au niveau des cadres supérieurs. * Capacité de présenter des analyses et de décomposer les concepts techniques en termes simples à présenter aux publics techniques et non techniques.

Sur le travail

En tant que Représentant de la Vente sur le terrain (FSR) axé sur le développement et la croissance d'un compte d'entreprise de fabrication stratégique, votre responsabilité principale est de développer Google Cloud, la part du client, portefeuille et sécuriser les charges de travail supplémentaires pour accélérer leur consommation et leurs revenus.

Vous allez codiriger l'engagement avec le compte et les aider à résoudre leurs défis complexes avec nos solutions. Votre réussite dépendra de votre capacité à identifier des problèmes d'affaires spécifiques, travailler en parfaite harmonie avec les intervenants dans tout le compte, et de votre équipe élargie pour développer des solutions techniques pour les résoudre. Vous serez responsable de l'établissement de relations significatives à différents niveaux dans le compte, des développeurs aux cadres de C-suite, qui comprend la préparation et la facilitation de réunions d'information de haute qualité.

De plus, vous dirigerez une équipe interfonctionnelle et tirerez parti des bonnes ressources, y compris l'ingénierie de la clientèle, le développement des affaires, les vendeurs interfonctionnels et les partenaires d'intégrateur de système, pour maximiser les résultats.

Google Cloud accélère chaque organisation, sa capacité de transformer numériquement son secteur d'activité et son industrie. Nous offrons des solutions de qualité d'entreprise qui tirent parti de Google, des technologies de pointe et des outils qui aident les développeurs à construire plus durablement.

Responsabilités

* Créer, construire et maintenir des relations avec la clientèle, en vous établissant comme un conseiller de confiance sur leur stratégie à long terme, la technologie et les décisions d'affaires, en particulier dans le contexte de la transformation de l'informatique et de la fabrication. * Collaborer étroitement avec le directeur principal des comptes, architecte principal, ingénieurs clients, gestion des produits et partenaires, en harmonie avec la stratégie globale des comptes, pour diriger la prospection, l'identification et l'acquisition de nouvelles charges de travail afin de répondre aux ambitions de croissance et de les dépasser.

* Devenez un expert dans les affaires du client, y compris leur portefeuille numérique et de produits, stratégie technologique, plans de croissance stratégique, moteurs d'affaires, structure financière, offre de marché vertical, et le paysage engagé. * Gérer des cycles d'affaires complexes, diriger des accords commerciaux, présenter aux cadres de niveau C, et négocier des conditions.

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
* Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch, and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform).
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers.
* Ability to communicate in French or German fluently as this is a customer-facing role that requires interactions in French or German with local stakeholders.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Experience in a post-sales or technical consulting delivery function.
* Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
* Excellent communication skills, and proven experience enabling technical teams on Agentic AI, at scale.

### About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in the Google Cloud Consulting organization, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. You will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. Your role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will embed with accounts, serve a dual purpose providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll leverage Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as a developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
* Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
* Co-build with partner’s engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring project success and high end-user adoption and scale impact through assets and scaled technical events, such as scaled and bespoke partner hackathons.

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
* Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch, and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform).
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers.
* Ability to communicate in French or German fluently as this is a customer-facing role that requires interactions in French or German with local stakeholders.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Experience in a post-sales or technical consulting delivery function.
* Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
* Excellent communication skills, and proven experience enabling technical teams on Agentic AI, at scale.

### About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in the Google Cloud Consulting organization, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. You will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. Your role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will embed with accounts, serve a dual purpose providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll leverage Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as a developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
* Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
* Co-build with partner’s engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring project success and high end-user adoption and scale impact through assets and scaled technical events, such as scaled and bespoke partner hackathons.

## Advanced

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in public cloud architecture, including compute, networking, IAM, and microservices.
* Experience in pre-sales agreement acceleration, running technical proof of concepts (PoCs), and leading technical workshops.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience working in at least one of the following domains: artificial intelligence (AI), data, or infrastructure.
* Experience in enterprise technology buying and evaluation processes.
* Understanding of large-scale computing solutions, and the business-to-technology translation skills needed to challenge partner delivery strategies.
* Ability to deliver results and work cross-functionally alongside direct Google Cloud Platform Customer Engineers to position and orchestrate a solution consisting of multiple products.
* Ability to drive and influence partner technical audiences, identify expansion engagements within partner accounts, and ensure accelerated agreement velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations on partner-led delivery agreements .

### About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Partner Solution Architect, serve as the pre-sales solution design authority for our priority Regional System Integrators (RSIs) and strategic partners across the South geo clusters. You will be the ecosystem co-pilot to Google Cloud's Account Platform Customer Engineers. Where the Account Platform Customer Engineer owns the direct customer relationship and strategy, you will own your partner's technical capability to successfully deliver it. You will move seamlessly from regional advisory to deep, domain-specific execution (AI, Data, or Infrastructure) to capture the pre-sales gap, while ruthlessly deflecting post-sales delivery.

## Advanced

Experience owning outcomes and decision making, solving ambiguous problems and influencing stakeholders;deep expertise in domain.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development.

* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* 5 years of experience leading ML design and optimizing ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).
* 2 years of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).

### Preferred qualifications:

* PhD or Postdoc in Computer Science, Applied Math, Computational Sciences, or a related scientific discipline with a history of paper authorship.
* 5 years of experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and algorithmic background.
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
* Ability to drive independent, research-adjacent software development and translate academic theories into concrete, scalable products.
* Excellent track record of technical or scientific contributions to complex, large-scale projects.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As a Staff Research Software Engineer (R-SWE), you will act as a principal technical bridge, translating scientific AI research into robust, scalable, and intuitive software systems. You will lead the design and implementation of highly multi-agent reasoning models while collaborating with deep learning researchers, product managers, and external scientific partners.

You will lead software engineering for the Co-Scientist team in Zurich. Co-Scientist is a multi-agent AI system built on Gemini designed to act as an autonomous virtual scientific colleague. It utilises a "generate, debate, and evolve" approach to accelerate scientific discovery enabling researchers to synthesize literature, evaluate hypotheses, and optimize experimental designs.

The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

### Responsibilities

* Own projects end-to-end, leading teams from initial scientific research concepts through software design, testing, deployment, and performance analysis.
* Architect, build, and deploy agentic AI systems, coordinating multi-agent prompting techniques and asynchronous task execution frameworks.
* Drive technical decisions, sound architectural choices, and full-stack software development using Python, C++, and Google's core backend components.
* Design and establish robust evaluation pipelines, automated test suites, and diagnostic datasets to measure agent performance under extreme scale.
* Drive collaborative research with Google DeepMind, Google Research, and university labs to solve complex, open-ended scientific problems. Provide technical leadership, mentor junior engineers, and advocate engineering quality across the organisation.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience developing in C++ or Python.
* 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Knowledge of Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), camera, and magnetometer sensor models and calibration techniques.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Write product or system development code.
* Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
* Implement solutions in one or more specialized Machine Learning (ML) areas, utilize ML infrastructure, and contribute to model optimization and data processing.

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o equivalente esperienza pratica. * 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. * 2 anni di esperienza in C++ o Python. * 1 anno di esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti: Discorso/audio (ad esempio, duplicare e rispondere alla voce umana), apprendimento di rinforzo (ad esempio, processo decisionale sequenziale), infrastruttura ML, o specializzazione in un altro campo ML.

* 1 anno di esperienza con l'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione di modelli, valutazione di modelli, ottimizzazione, elaborazione dati, debug).

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o un campo tecnico correlato. * 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi. * L'esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili. * Conoscenza di unità di misura inerziale (IMU), modelli di sensori di fotocamera e magnetometro e tecniche di taratura.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s ha bisogno con l'opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda fast-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership ed essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia. Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da

scoperte in calcolo, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. XR di Google

team è in prima linea nel prossimo grande salto. la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di un semplice nuovo dispositivo. si tratta di reimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo intorno a noi. Stiamo costruendo un futuro dove

dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali intelligenti e cuffie abbinano con AI utile per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversative e contestuali.

Responsabilità

* Scrivere codice di sviluppo di prodotti o sistemi. * Collaborare con i coetanei e le parti interessate attraverso revisioni di progettazione e codice per garantire le migliori pratiche tra le tecnologie disponibili (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, checking code in, accuratezza, verificabilità ed efficienza). * Contribuire alla documentazione esistente o contenuti educativi e adattare i contenuti in base agli aggiornamenti di prodotto/programma e feedback degli utenti. * Problemi di prodotto o sistema triage e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete, o operazioni di servizio e qualità.

* Implementa soluzioni in uno o più settori specializzati di Machine Learning (ML), utilizza l'infrastruttura ML e contribuisce all'ottimizzazione dei modelli e all'elaborazione dei dati.

* Bachelor, s Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen, oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Entwicklung in C++ oder Python. * 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einer oder mehreren der folgenden: Speech/Audio (z.B. Technologie-Duplizieren und reagieren auf die menschliche Stimme), Verstärkungslernen (z.B. sequenzielle Entscheidungsfindung), ML-Infrastruktur, oder Spezialisierung auf einem anderen ML-Bereich.

* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit ML-Infrastruktur (z.B. Modellauswertung, Modellauswertung, Optimierung, Datenverarbeitung, Debugging).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen. * Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien. * Kenntnisse der Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), Kamera, Magnetometer-Sensormodelle und Kalibriertechniken.

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion von Milliarden von Nutzern mit Informationen und anderen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinausreichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zur Umstellung von Teams und Projekten im Zuge des Wachstums und der Entwicklung unserer schnelllebigen Geschäftsfelder ausgestattet ist. Unsere Ingenieure müssen vielseitig sein, Führungsqualitäten aufweisen und sich für die Bewältigung neuer Probleme im gesamten Gesamtumfang begeistern, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. Seit Jahrzehnten hat die Computerrevolution unsere Welt geprägt von

Durchbrüche in Computing, Konnektivität, Mobil, und jetzt, KI. Googles XR

team ist an der Spitze des nächsten großen Sprungs – die Konvergenz von KI und XR. Dies ist mehr als nur neue Geräte – es geht um die Neugestaltung, wie wir mit der Welt um uns herum interagieren.

leichte XR-Geräte wie Smart-Brillen und Headsets verbinden sich mit hilfreicher KI, um menschliche Intelligenz zu erweitern und personalisierte, gesprächs- und kontextbezogene Erlebnisse zu bieten.

Zuständigkeiten

* Schreiben Sie Produkt- oder Systementwicklungscode. * Zusammenarbeit mit Gleichaltrigen und Stakeholdern durch Design- und Codebewertungen, um beste Praktiken zwischen verfügbaren Technologien (z.B. Stilrichtlinien, Code-Checking, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz) zu gewährleisten. * Beitragen Sie zu vorhandenen Dokumentations- oder Bildungsinhalten und passen Sie Inhalte auf der Grundlage von Produkt/Programm-Updates und Benutzerfeedback an. * Triage Produkt- oder Systemprobleme und Debug/Track/Resolve durch Analyse der Quellen von Problemen und der Auswirkungen auf Hardware, Netzwerk oder Serviceoperationen und Qualität.

* Implementierung von Lösungen in einem oder mehreren spezialisierten Machine Learning (ML) Bereichen, Nutzung der ML-Infrastruktur und Beitrag zur Modelloptimierung und Datenverarbeitung.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in Python or C++ programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with computer vision (e.g., image classification and processing, object detection, visual search), video generation, or signal processing.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience building and optimizing production-level pipelines for 3D computer vision or machine learning models.
* Experience with on-device and server-side deployment frameworks.
* Proficiency in developing and deploying software for low-power, high-performance hardware.
* Proven ability to perform power breakdown analysis and optimize for strict hardware KPIs.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will focus on productionization. You will be transforming advanced models and pipelines into production-ready assets. You will be developing robust algorithms and frameworks to complete the end-to-end pipeline for both prototyping and final production, ensuring seamless deployment across on-device and server-based platforms. You will focus on optimization and system delivery; training machine learning models are not a requirement.For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Lead the productionization process by preparing models and pipelines for deployment.
* Develop algorithms and frameworks to support end-to-end pipeline development for on-device and server environments.
* Optimize system performance specifically for low-power and high-performance hardware constraints.
* Execute detailed implementations and conduct thorough power breakdown analysis.
* Ensure the achievement of critical power Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) necessary for the deployment of real-time spatial technologies.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia in avanti.

In questo ruolo, vi concentrerete sulla produzione. Trasformerete modelli e condotte avanzati in risorse di produzione-ready. Svilupperete algoritmi e framework robusti per completare la pipeline end-to-end sia per la prototipazione che per la produzione finale, garantendo una distribuzione senza soluzione di continuità su piattaforme on-device e server-based. Vi concentrerete sull'ottimizzazione e la consegna del sistema; modelli di formazione di apprendimento automatico non sono un requisito.Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da

scoperte in calcolo, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. XR di Google

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in Python or C++ programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with computer vision (e.g., image classification and processing, object detection, visual search), video generation, or signal processing.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience building and optimizing production-level pipelines for 3D computer vision or machine learning models.
* Experience with on-device and server-side deployment frameworks.
* Proficiency in developing and deploying software for low-power, high-performance hardware.
* Proven ability to perform power breakdown analysis and optimize for strict hardware KPIs.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will focus on productionization. You will be transforming advanced models and pipelines into production-ready assets. You will be developing robust algorithms and frameworks to complete the end-to-end pipeline for both prototyping and final production, ensuring seamless deployment across on-device and server-based platforms. You will focus on optimization and system delivery; training machine learning models are not a requirement.For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Lead the productionization process by preparing models and pipelines for deployment.
* Develop algorithms and frameworks to support end-to-end pipeline development for on-device and server environments.
* Optimize system performance specifically for low-power and high-performance hardware constraints.
* Execute detailed implementations and conduct thorough power breakdown analysis.
* Ensure the achievement of critical power Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) necessary for the deployment of real-time spatial technologies.

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion von Milliarden von Nutzern mit Informationen und anderen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinausreichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie sich auf die Produktion konzentrieren. Sie werden fortschrittliche Modelle und Pipelines in produktionsfähige Anlagen umwandeln. Sie werden robuste Algorithmen und Frameworks entwickeln, um die End-to-End-Pipeline für Prototyping und Endproduktion zu vervollständigen, wodurch eine nahtlose Bereitstellung auf on-device und serverbasierten Plattformen gewährleistet wird. Sie werden sich auf Optimierung und Systembereitstellung konzentrieren; Trainingsmodelle für maschinelles Lernen sind keine Anforderung.Seit Jahrzehnten hat die Computerrevolution unsere Welt durch die neue Form der Computerrevolution geprägt.

Durchbrüche in Computing, Konnektivität, Mobil, und jetzt, KI. Googles XR

team ist an der Spitze des nächsten großen Sprungs – die Konvergenz von KI und XR. Dies ist mehr als nur neue Geräte – es geht um die Neugestaltung, wie wir mit der Welt um uns herum interagieren.

leichte XR-Geräte wie Smart-Brillen und Headsets verbinden sich mit hilfreicher KI, um menschliche Intelligenz zu erweitern und personalisierte, gesprächs- und kontextbezogene Erlebnisse zu bieten.

Zuständigkeiten

* Führen Sie den Produktionsprozess durch die Vorbereitung von Modellen und Pipelines für den Einsatz. * Entwickeln Sie Algorithmen und Frameworks, um die End-to-End-Pipeline-Entwicklung für On-Device- und Server-Umgebungen zu unterstützen. * Optimieren Sie die Systemleistung speziell für stromarme und leistungsstarke Hardware-Beschränkungen. * Führen Sie detaillierte Implementierungen aus und führen Sie eine gründliche Stromausfallanalyse durch. * Sicherstellen Sie die Erreichung der kritischen Leistung Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), die für den Einsatz von Echtzeit-Raumtechnologien erforderlich sind.

Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les uns avec les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes dans toute la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Vous allez transformer des modèles et pipelines avancés en actifs prêts à la production. Vous allez développer des algorithmes et des cadres robustes pour compléter le pipeline de bout en bout pour le prototypage et la production finale, assurant un déploiement sans faille sur les plateformes sur les appareils et les serveurs. Vous allez vous concentrer sur l'optimisation et la livraison du système; la formation des modèles d'apprentissage automatique ne sont pas une exigence.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience with software development in C++ and Python or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience with machine learning tools and algorithms, specifically deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and deep learning models.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
* Knowledge of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and Generative AI.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

### Responsibilities

* Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.
* Perform model training, evaluation, and deployment to solve business-critical problems.This includes exploration of new model architectures, augmenting existing training data, finding better evaluation methods and feedback signals, and identifying headroom opportunities.
* Understand production systems, visualize, monitor, and optimize performance.
* Stay up-to-date with latest tools and research in the field working actively with our collaborators.

Applicare ### Titolo minimo: * Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 3 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in C++ e Python o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. * 2 anni di esperienza con strumenti e algoritmi di machine learning, implementando in modo specifico Modelli di Grande Lingua (LLM) e modelli di deep learning. ### Qualifiche preferenziali: * Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati. * 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi. * 1 anno di test di esperienza, manutenzione o lancio di prodotti software. * Conoscenza degli algoritmi di machine learning, incluso l'apprendimento supervisionato e non supervisionato, l'apprendimento profondo, l'apprendimento di rinforzo e l'intelligenza artificiale genetica. ### Riguardo al lavoro Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia. In questo ruolo, con le tue competenze tecniche gestirai priorità di progetto, scadenze e consegnabili. Potrai progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software. Google Ads sta aiutando ad alimentare Internet aperto con la migliore tecnologia che collega e crea valore per le persone, editori, inserzionisti, e Google. Siamo costituiti da più team, la costruzione di prodotti pubblicitari di Google, tra cui ricerca, display, shopping, viaggi e pubblicità video, nonché analisi. I nostri team creano esperienze fidate tra persone e aziende con annunci utili. Aiutiamo a crescere le aziende di tutte le dimensioni da piccole imprese, a grandi marchi, ai creatori di YouTube, con efficaci strumenti di inserzionista che forniscono risultati misurabili. Permettiamo anche a Google di interagire con i clienti in scala. ### responsabilità * Progetti propri end-to-end dall'idea iniziale alla progettazione, all'analisi e all'implementazione. * Eseguire la formazione, la valutazione e la distribuzione del modello per risolvere i problemi business-critical. Questo include l'esplorazione di nuove architetture di modelli, l'aumento dei dati di formazione esistenti, la ricerca di metodi di valutazione migliori e segnali di feedback, e l'individuazione delle opportunità di headroom. * Comprendere i sistemi di produzione, visualizzare, monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni. * Resta aggiornato con gli ultimi strumenti e la ricerca sul campo lavorando attivamente con i nostri collaboratori.

Unsere Teams schaffen vertrauenswürdige Erfahrungen zwischen Menschen und Unternehmen mit nützlichen Anzeigen. Wir helfen Unternehmen jeder Größe, von kleinen Unternehmen über große Marken bis hin zu YouTube-Erstellern, mit effektiven Werbetreibenden-Tools, die messbare Ergebnisse liefern. Wir ermöglichen es Google auch, mit Kunden in großem Maßstab zu interagieren. ### Zuständigkeiten * Eigene Projekte end-to-end von der ersten Idee über Design, Analyse und Umsetzung. * Führen Sie Modellschulungen, -bewertungen und -bereitstellung durch, um geschäftskritische Probleme zu lösen. Dazu gehören die Erkundung neuer Modellarchitekturen, die Erweiterung bestehender Trainingsdaten, die Suche nach besseren Bewertungsmethoden und Feedbacksignalen sowie die Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten für den Headroom. * Verstehen Sie Produktionssysteme, visualisieren, überwachen und optimieren Sie die Leistung. * Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit den neuesten Tools und der Forschung in diesem Bereich und arbeiten Sie aktiv mit unseren Mitarbeitern zusammen.

## Senior Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering, Borg Node SRE

_share_

* _link_ Copy link
* _email_ Email a friend

_corporate\_fare_ Google _place_ Zürich, Switzerland

_\_bar\\_chart\__ Mid

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.
* 2 years of experience leading projects and providing technical leadership.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

### About the job

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

### Responsibilities

* Engage in and improve the whole life-cycle of services, from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement.
* Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
* Grow systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Conduct sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

# Mezzogiorno

Provate i progressi di guida, risolvendo i problemi, e guidando più membri del team junior; competenze più profonde e conoscenze applicate all'interno di area rilevante.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea in Informatica, un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.
* 5 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo del software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione.
* 3 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, analisi e risoluzione dei problemi di sistemi distribuiti su larga scala.
* 2 anni di esperienza leader progetti e fornire leadership tecnica.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale in Informatica o Ingegneria.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combina software e ingegneria dei sistemi per la costruzione e l'esecuzione di sistemi su larga scala, massicciamente distribuiti e tolleranti. SRE assicura che i servizi di Google Cloud, sia i nostri sistemi internamente critici che quelli esterni, abbiano affidabilità, tempi di avanzamento adeguati alle esigenze del cliente e velocità di miglioramento. Inoltre SRE manterrà un occhio sempre attento alla capacità e alle prestazioni dei nostri sistemi.

Gran parte del nostro sviluppo software si concentra sull'ottimizzazione dei sistemi esistenti, l'infrastruttura di costruzione e l'eliminazione del lavoro attraverso l'automazione. Nel team SRE avrete la possibilità di gestire le complesse sfide di scala che sono uniche per Google Cloud, utilizzando le vostre competenze nel codifica, algoritmi, analisi della complessità e progettazione di sistemi su larga scala. La cultura della curiosità intellettuale di SRE, la risoluzione dei problemi e l'apertura è fondamentale per il suo successo. La nostra organizzazione riunisce persone con una vasta gamma di sfondi, esperienze e prospettive. Li incoraggiamo a collaborare, pensare in grande e correre rischi in un ambiente privo di colpa. Promuoviamo l'auto-direzione a lavorare su progetti significativi, mentre ci sforziamo anche di creare un ambiente che fornisce il supporto e la mentorship necessari per imparare e crescere. Dietro tutto ciò che i nostri utenti vedono online è l'architettura costruita dal team di Infrastrutture Tecniche per mantenerla in funzione. Dallo sviluppo e dal mantenimento dei nostri data center per la costruzione della nuova generazione di piattaforme Google, rendiamo possibile il portafoglio prodotti di Google. Siamo orgogliosi di essere gli ingegneri dei nostri ingegneri e di avere l'amore per le garanzie di vuoto, facendo le cose a parte così possiamo ricostruirle. Teniamo le nostre reti in funzione, garantendo ai nostri utenti la migliore e più veloce esperienza possibile.

### responsabilità

* Impegnarsi e migliorare l'intero ciclo di vita dei servizi, dall'inizio e dal design, fino all'implementazione, al funzionamento e alla raffinatezza.
* I servizi di supporto prima di passare dal vivo attraverso attività come la consulenza di progettazione di sistema, lo sviluppo di piattaforme software e quadri, la pianificazione delle capacità e le recensioni di lancio.
* Mantenere i servizi una volta che sono live misurando e monitorando la disponibilità, latenza e la salute generale del sistema.
* Crescere i sistemi in modo sostenibile attraverso meccanismi come l'automazione, ed evolvere i sistemi spingendo per cambiamenti che migliorano l'affidabilità e la velocità.
* Condurre risposta agli incidenti sostenibili e postmortems incolpabili.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.
* 2 years of experience leading projects and providing technical leadership.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

### About the job

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

### Responsibilities

* Engage in and improve the whole life-cycle of services, from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement.
* Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
* Grow systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Conduct sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

## Mitte

Beantragen

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
* 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen.
* 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Entwerfen, Analysieren und Beheben von großen verteilten Systemen.
* 2 Jahre Erfahrung als Leiter von Projekten und technische Führung.

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss in Informatik oder Ingenieurwissenschaften.

### Über den Job

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) kombiniert Software- und Systemtechnik, um groß angelegte, massiv verteilte, fehlertolerante Systeme zu bauen und auszuführen. SRE stellt sicher, dass die Dienste von Google Cloud – sowohl unsere intern kritischen als auch unsere extern sichtbaren Systeme – Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit entsprechend den Bedürfnissen des Kunden und eine schnelle Verbesserungsrate aufweisen. Darüber hinaus werden SREs die Kapazität und Leistung unserer Systeme stets im Auge behalten.

Ein Großteil unserer Softwareentwicklung konzentriert sich auf die Optimierung bestehender Systeme, den Aufbau von Infrastruktur und die Beseitigung von Arbeit durch Automatisierung. Im SRE-Team haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die komplexen Herausforderungen der Skalierung, die für Google Cloud einzigartig sind, zu bewältigen und gleichzeitig Ihre Expertise in den Bereichen Codierung, Algorithmen, Komplexitätsanalyse und groß angelegtes Systemdesign zu nutzen. Die Kultur der intellektuellen Neugier, Problemlösung und Offenheit von SRE ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Unsere Organisation bringt Menschen mit einer Vielzahl von Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Wir ermutigen sie, zusammenzuarbeiten, groß zu denken und Risiken in einer schuldfreien Umgebung einzugehen. Wir fördern die Selbstorientierung, um an sinnvollen Projekten zu arbeiten, während wir uns auch bemühen, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, das die Unterstützung und Mentorschaft bietet, die zum Lernen und Wachsen erforderlich ist. Hinter allem, was unsere Benutzer online sehen, steht die Architektur, die vom Team für technische Infrastruktur erstellt wurde, um sie am Laufen zu halten. Von der Entwicklung und Wartung unserer Rechenzentren bis hin zum Aufbau der nächsten Generation von Google-Plattformen machen wir das Produktportfolio von Google möglich. Wir sind stolz darauf, die Ingenieure unserer Ingenieure zu sein und lieben es, Garantien aufzuheben, indem wir Dinge auseinander nehmen, damit wir sie wieder aufbauen können. Wir halten unsere Netzwerke am Laufen und stellen sicher, dass unsere Benutzer die bestmögliche und schnellste Erfahrung haben.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Engagieren und verbessern Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Diensten, von der Einführung und dem Design bis hin zur Bereitstellung, zum Betrieb und zur Verfeinerung.
* Supportdienste, bevor sie durch Aktivitäten wie Systemdesignberatung, Entwicklung von Softwareplattformen und Frameworks, Kapazitätsplanung und Launch Reviews live gehen.
* Pflegen Sie die Dienste, sobald sie live sind, indem Sie die Verfügbarkeit, Latenz und den allgemeinen Systemzustand messen und überwachen.
* Erweitern Sie Systeme nachhaltig durch Mechanismen wie Automatisierung und entwickeln Sie Systeme, indem Sie auf Veränderungen drängen, die die Zuverlässigkeit und Geschwindigkeit verbessern.
* Führen Sie nachhaltige Reaktion auf Vorfälle und tadellose Postmortems durch.
