## Moyenne

Expérience de la conduite des progrès, de la résolution des problèmes et du mentorat d'un plus grand nombre de membres de l'équipe junior; expertise approfondie et connaissances appliquées dans le domaine pertinent.

Appliquer

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat en informatique, domaine connexe ou expérience pratique équivalente.
* 5 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation.
* 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception, l'analyse et le dépannage de systèmes distribués à grande échelle.
* 2 ans d'expérience à la tête de projets et à la direction technique.

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise en informatique ou en génie.

### Sur le travail

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combine l'ingénierie des logiciels et des systèmes pour construire et exécuter des systèmes à grande échelle, massivement distribués, tolérants aux défauts. SRE s'assure que les services de Google Cloud – à la fois nos systèmes internes critiques et nos systèmes externes – sont fiables, adaptés aux besoins du client et à un rythme d'amélioration rapide. En outre, les SRE's garderont un œil sur la capacité et les performances de nos systèmes.

Une grande partie de notre développement logiciel est axée sur l'optimisation des systèmes existants, la construction d'infrastructures et l'élimination du travail par l'automatisation. Sur l'équipe SRE, vous aurez la possibilité de gérer les défis complexes d'échelle qui sont uniques à Google Cloud, tout en utilisant votre expertise dans le codage, les algorithmes, l'analyse de complexité et la conception de systèmes à grande échelle. La culture de la curiosité intellectuelle, de la résolution de problèmes et de l'ouverture de SRE est la clé de son succès. Notre organisation réunit des personnes ayant une grande variété d'horizons, d'expériences et de perspectives. Nous les encourageons à collaborer, à penser grand et à prendre des risques dans un environnement exempt de responsabilité. Nous encourageons l'auto-direction à travailler sur des projets significatifs, tout en nous efforçant de créer un environnement qui offre le soutien et le mentorat nécessaires pour apprendre et grandir. Derrière tout ce que nos utilisateurs voient en ligne se trouve l'architecture construite par l'équipe Infrastructure Technique pour la maintenir en marche. Du développement et de la maintenance de nos centres de données à la construction de la prochaine génération de plateformes Google, nous rendons le portefeuille de produits de Google possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être les ingénieurs de nos ingénieurs et nous aimons annuler les garanties en démontant les choses pour pouvoir les reconstruire. Nous veillons à ce que nos réseaux soient opérationnels et que nos utilisateurs disposent de la meilleure expérience possible.

### Responsabilités

* Intégrer et améliorer l'ensemble du cycle de vie des services, depuis le début et la conception jusqu'au déploiement, à l'exploitation et au raffinement.
* Les services d'appui avant qu'ils ne passent par des activités telles que le conseil en conception de systèmes, l'élaboration de plates-formes et de cadres logiciels, la planification des capacités et les examens de lancement.
* Maintenir les services une fois qu'ils sont en vie en mesurant et en surveillant la disponibilité, la latence et la santé globale du système.
* Développer durablement les systèmes grâce à des mécanismes comme l'automatisation, et évoluer les systèmes en poussant vers des changements qui améliorent la fiabilité et la vitesse.
* Mener des interventions d'incident durables et des postmortems irréprochables.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in Python or C++ programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience in Machine Learning methods with a strong background in 3D geometry.
* Proficiency in building and deploying models for both on-device and server environments.
* Demonstrated ability to independently handle data generation, model training, and optimization pipelines.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on 3D geometry, you will be responsible for the entire model life cycle from data generation to model optimization. You will bridge the gap between advanced research in monocular depth modeling and the real-world requirements for robustness in video and user interface environments.For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Manage the end-to-end training process for high-impact machine learning models.
* Develop and optimize models capable of running efficiently on both consumer devices and server-side infrastructure.
* Own the robustness and data quality of depth models to resolve critical stability and user experience challenges.
* Adapt research in monocular depth modeling to ensure reliable performance across real-world scenarios.

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in linguaggi di programmazione Python o C++, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. * 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di infrastrutture su larga scala, sistemi distribuiti o reti, o esperienza con tecnologie di calcolo, archiviazione o architettura hardware. * 1 anno di esperienza con infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione di modelli, valutazione di modelli, ottimizzazione, elaborazione dati, debug).

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili. * Esperienza in metodi di apprendimento automatico con un forte background in geometria 3D. * Proficienza nella costruzione e distribuzione di modelli sia per ambienti di dispositivo che server. * Capacità dimostrativa di gestire in modo indipendente la generazione dei dati, l'addestramento dei modelli e l'ottimizzazione dei gasdotti.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia in avanti.

Come ingegnere di apprendimento automatico con un focus sulla geometria 3D, sarete responsabili per l'intero ciclo di vita del modello dalla generazione dei dati all'ottimizzazione del modello. Potrai colmare il divario tra la ricerca avanzata nella modellazione della profondità monoculare e le esigenze reali di robustezza in ambienti di video e interfaccia utente.Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da

scoperte in calcolo, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. XR di Google

team è in prima linea nel prossimo grande salto. la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di un semplice nuovo dispositivo. si tratta di reimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo intorno a noi. Stiamo costruendo un futuro dove

dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali intelligenti e cuffie abbinano con AI utile per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversative e contestuali.

Responsabilità

* Gestire il processo di formazione end-to-end per modelli di apprendimento automatico ad alto impatto. * Sviluppare e ottimizzare modelli in grado di funzionare in modo efficiente sia sui dispositivi di consumo e l'infrastruttura server-side. * Possiede la robustezza e la qualità dei dati dei modelli di profondità per risolvere le sfide di stabilità critica e di esperienza utente. * Adattare la ricerca in modellazione profondità monoculare per garantire prestazioni affidabili in scenari reali.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in Python or C++ programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience in Machine Learning methods with a strong background in 3D geometry.
* Proficiency in building and deploying models for both on-device and server environments.
* Demonstrated ability to independently handle data generation, model training, and optimization pipelines.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on 3D geometry, you will be responsible for the entire model life cycle from data generation to model optimization. You will bridge the gap between advanced research in monocular depth modeling and the real-world requirements for robustness in video and user interface environments.For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Manage the end-to-end training process for high-impact machine learning models.
* Develop and optimize models capable of running efficiently on both consumer devices and server-side infrastructure.
* Own the robustness and data quality of depth models to resolve critical stability and user experience challenges.
* Adapt research in monocular depth modeling to ensure reliable performance across real-world scenarios.

Mittel

Erfahrung mit treibenden Fortschritten, Problemlösungen und Mentoring von mehr Nachwuchsteammitgliedern; tieferes Fachwissen und angewandtes Wissen in relevanten Bereichen.

Anwenden

Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor, s Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in Python oder C++ Programmiersprachen, oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss. * 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung von großräumigen Infrastruktur, verteilten Systemen oder Netzwerken, oder Erfahrung mit Computertechnologien, Speicher- oder Hardwarearchitektur. * 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit ML-Infrastruktur (z.B. Modellausbau, Modellauswertung, Optimierung, Datenverarbeitung, Debugging).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Erfahrung in der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien. * Erfahrung in maschinellem Lernen mit einem starken Hintergrund in der 3D-Geometrie. * Kompetenz beim Aufbau und der Bereitstellung von Modellen für On-Device- und Server-Umgebungen. * Demonstration der Fähigkeit, Datengenerierung, Modellschulung und Optimierungspipelines selbstständig zu handhaben.

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion von Milliarden von Nutzern mit Informationen und anderen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinausreichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Als Maschinenbauingenieur mit Schwerpunkt 3D-Geometrie sind Sie für den gesamten Modelllebenszyklus von der Datengenerierung bis zur Modelloptimierung verantwortlich. Sie überbrücken die Lücke zwischen der fortgeschrittenen Forschung in der mono- und mono-Klassischen Tiefenmodellierung und den realen Anforderungen an Robustheit in Video- und User-Interface-Umgebungen.Seit Jahrzehnten hat die Computerrevolution unsere Welt durch die Entwicklung neuer Technologien geprägt.

Durchbrüche in Computing, Konnektivität, Mobil, und jetzt, KI. Googles XR

team ist an der Spitze des nächsten großen Sprungs – die Konvergenz von KI und XR. Dies ist mehr als nur neue Geräte – es geht um die Neugestaltung, wie wir mit der Welt um uns herum interagieren.

leichte XR-Geräte wie Smart-Brillen und Headsets verbinden sich mit hilfreicher KI, um menschliche Intelligenz zu erweitern und personalisierte, gesprächs- und kontextbezogene Erlebnisse zu bieten.

Zuständigkeiten

* Verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Trainingsprozess für hochwirksame Machine-Learning-Modelle. * Entwickeln und optimieren Sie Modelle, die sowohl auf Consumer-Geräten als auch auf Server-seitigen Infrastrukturen effizient funktionieren können. * Besitzen Sie die Robustheit und Datenqualität von Tiefenmodellen, um kritische Stabilität und Benutzererfahrungsherausforderungen zu lösen. * Adaptieren Sie die Forschung in mono-Kerntiefenmodellierung, um zuverlässige Leistung über reale Szenarien hinweg zu gewährleisten.

Moyenne

Expérience de la conduite des progrès, de la résolution des problèmes et du mentorat de membres d'équipes juniors; expertise approfondie et connaissances appliquées dans le domaine pertinent.

Appliquer

Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 2 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels en langage de programmation Python ou C++, ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé. * 2 ans d'expérience dans le développement d'infrastructures à grande échelle, systèmes ou réseaux distribués, ou expérience avec les technologies de calcul, l'architecture de stockage ou de matériel. * 1 an d'expérience avec l'infrastructure ML (p. ex. déploiement de modèles, évaluation de modèles, optimisation, traitement de données, débogage).

Titres de compétence privilégiés:

* Expérience de développement de technologies accessibles. * Expérience en méthodes d'apprentissage automatique avec un solide bagage en géométrie 3D. * Compétence en construction et déploiement de modèles pour les environnements sur les appareils et les serveurs. * Capacité démontrée de gérer de façon indépendante la production de données, la formation de modèles et les pipelines d'optimisation.

Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les uns avec les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes dans toute la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

En tant qu'ingénieur de Machine Learning avec un accent sur la géométrie 3D, vous serez responsable de tout le cycle de vie du modèle de la génération de données à l'optimisation du modèle. Vous comblerez l'écart entre la recherche avancée dans la modélisation de profondeur monoculaire et les exigences du monde réel pour la robustesse dans les environnements d'interface vidéo et utilisateur.

percées dans le calcul, la connectivité, mobile, et maintenant, AI.

L'équipe est à l'avant-garde du prochain grand saut – la convergence de l'IA et de la XR. C'est plus que de nouveaux appareils – il s'agit de rejuger la façon dont nous interagissons avec le monde autour de nous.

des appareils XR légers comme des lunettes intelligentes et des casques pair avec l'IA utile pour augmenter l'intelligence humaine, offrant des expériences personnalisées, conversationnelles et contextuelles.

## Software Engineer III, AI/ML Shopping Creator, YouTube

_share_

_corporate\_fare_ YouTube _place_ Zürich, Switzerland

_\_bar\\_chart\__ Mid

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
* 1 year of experience with Machine Learning (ML) infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience in B2C or e-commerce software.
* Experience in debugging and resolving system issues, and addressing technical debt.
* Experience building scalable test automation frameworks for complex, AI systems.
* Experience in C++ and Python.
* Deep understanding of ML/LLM systems.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret quality metrics, identify regression patterns, and drive data-informed modeling decisions.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In YouTube Shopping Creator, we leverage advanced infrastructure to empower creators in producing high-quality, shopping-enabled content. A key business priority is expanding the creator and shopping content and driving active engagement with shopping features.

Our mission is to enable creators to launch and scale their Shopping journey through seamless activation, intelligent matchmaking, and data-driven inspiration.

As a team, we drive growth by owning the Activation and Inspiration Critical User Journey's. Beyond onboarding, we create and leverage Creator Profiles and AI/ML predictive modeling to provide actionable insights, helping creators discover the best merchants, lucrative offers, and relevant products for their audience.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

### Responsibilities

* Lead the design and development of innovative ML/AI-driven models and features.
* Architect and build systems that deeply integrate LLMs and other AI technologies to provide intelligent recommendations.
* Drive integrations across multiple product partners, lead by strong collaborations and partnerships.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Data Scientists, and other engineering teams to define and deliver the roadmap for ML/AI capabilities.
* Foster a collaborative environment.

descriptionByLocale.it: YouTube Zürich, Svizzera ### Titolo minimo: * Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. * 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. * 1 anno di esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti: Speech/audio (ad esempio, la tecnologia che duplica e risponde alla voce umana), l'apprendimento di rinforzo (ad esempio, il processo decisionale sequenziale), l'infrastruttura ML o la specializzazione in un altro campo ML. * 1 anno di esperienza con l'infrastruttura Machine Learning (ML) (ad esempio, distribuzione di modelli, valutazione dei modelli, ottimizzazione, elaborazione dei dati, debugging). ### Qualifiche preferenziali: * Esperienza nel software B2C o e-commerce. * Esperienza nel debug e risolvere problemi di sistema, e affrontare il debito tecnico. * Provare la costruzione di sistemi di automazione di test scalabili per sistemi complessi e AI. * Esperienza in C++ e Python. * Profonda comprensione dei sistemi ML/LLM. * Forte capacità analitiche di interpretare metriche di qualità, identificare i modelli di regressione e guidare le decisioni di modellazione informate. ### Riguardo al lavoro Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e la memorizzazione dei dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. In qualità di ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia. In YouTube Shopping Creator, facciamo leva sulle infrastrutture avanzate per consentire ai creatori di produrre contenuti di alta qualità e accessibili allo shopping. Una priorità chiave del business sta espandendo il contenuto del creatore e dello shopping e guida il coinvolgimento attivo con le caratteristiche dello shopping. La nostra missione è quella di consentire ai creatori di lanciare e scalare il loro viaggio Shopping attraverso l'attivazione senza soluzione di continuità, il matchmaking intelligente e l'ispirazione data-driven. In qualità di team, guidiamo la crescita possedendo l'Attivazione e l'Ispirazione Critical User Journey's. Oltre a salire a bordo, creiamo e leviamo i profili Creator e la modellazione predittiva AI/ML per fornire intuizioni attuabili, aiutando i creatori a scoprire i migliori commercianti, offerte lucrative e prodotti rilevanti per il loro pubblico. Su YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo è un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo la comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme. ### responsabilità * Guidare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di modelli e caratteristiche innovativi guidati ML/AI. * Architetto e costruire sistemi che integrano profondamente LLM e altre tecnologie AI per fornire raccomandazioni intelligenti. * Integrazioni di trasmissione attraverso più partner di prodotto, guidate da forti collaborazioni e partnership. * Collabora a stretto contatto con Product Manager, UX Designers, Data Scientists e altri team di ingegneria per definire e fornire la roadmap per le capacità ML/AI. * Promuovere un ambiente collaborativo.

Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobilgeräte; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. In YouTube Shopping Creator nutzen wir fortschrittliche Infrastruktur, um Schöpfer in die Lage zu versetzen, qualitativ hochwertige, einkaufsfähige Inhalte zu produzieren. Eine wichtige Geschäftspriorität ist die Erweiterung der Ersteller- und Einkaufsinhalte und die Förderung der aktiven Beschäftigung mit Einkaufsfunktionen. Unsere mission ist es, schöpfern zu ermöglichen, ihre shopping-reise durch nahtlose aktivierung, intelligentes matchmaking und datengesteuerte inspiration zu starten und zu skalieren. Als Team treiben wir das Wachstum voran, indem wir die Activation and Inspiration Critical User Journey besitzen. Über das Onboarding hinaus erstellen und nutzen wir Creator-
• Profile und AI / ML-prädiktive Modellierung, um umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu liefern und den Entwicklern zu helfen, die besten Händler, lukrativen Angebote und relevanten Produkte für ihr Publikum zu entdecken. Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und eine Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Kraft zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was er liebt, und uns dabei miteinander zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und grenzenloser Kreativität bewegen wir uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß - und das alles zusammen. ### Zuständigkeiten * Führen Sie das Design und die Entwicklung innovativer ML / AI-basierter Modelle und Funktionen. * Architektur und Bau von Systemen, die LLMs und andere KI-Technologien tief integrieren, um intelligente Empfehlungen zu geben. * Fördern Sie Integrationen über mehrere Produktpartner hinweg, angeführt von starken Kooperationen und Partnerschaften. * Arbeiten Sie eng mit Produktmanagern, UX-Designern, Data Scientists und anderen Engineering-Teams zusammen, um die Roadmap für ML / AI-Funktionen zu definieren und bereitzustellen. * Pflegen Sie ein kollaboratives Umfeld.
descriptionByLocale.fr: YouTube Zürich, Suisse ### Titres minimums: * Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. * 2 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation, ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé. * 1 an d'expérience avec un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants : discours/audio (p. ex., duplication de la technologie et réponse à la voix humaine), renforcement de l'apprentissage (p. ex., prise de décision séquentielle), infrastructure ML ou spécialisation dans un autre domaine ML. * 1 année d'expérience avec l'infrastructure d'apprentissage automatique (p. ex. déploiement de modèles, évaluation de modèles, optimisation, traitement des données, débogage). ### Titres préférés: * Expérience en B2C ou en logiciel de commerce électronique. * Expérience en matière de débogage et de résolution des problèmes de système, et de traitement de la dette technique. * Expérimentez la construction de cadres d'automatisation d'essais évolutives pour des systèmes d'IA complexes. * Expérience en C++ et Python. * Connaissance approfondie des systèmes ML/LLM. * Fortes compétences analytiques pour interpréter les paramètres de qualité, identifier les modèles de régression et orienter les décisions de modélisation fondées sur les données. ### Sur le travail Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et l'autre. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la récupération d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur en logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google.Vous aurez l'occasion de changer d'équipes et de projets au fur et à mesure que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide grandirez et évoluerez. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes dans l'ensemble de la pile alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie. Dans YouTube Shopping Creator, nous mettons à profit l'infrastructure avancée pour donner aux créateurs les moyens de produire des contenus de haute qualité et adaptés aux achats. L'une des principales priorités de l'entreprise est d'élargir le contenu du créateur et du magasinage et de stimuler l'engagement actif avec les fonctionnalités de magasinage. Notre mission est de permettre aux créateurs de lancer et d'élargir leur parcours d'achat grâce à une activation transparente, à des matchmakings intelligents et à une inspiration basée sur les données. En tant qu'équipe, nous favorisons la croissance en étant propriétaires de l'Activation et Inspiration Critical User Journey. Au-delà de l'embarquement, nous créons et mettons à profit Creator Profiles et la modélisation prédictive de l'IA/ML pour fournir des renseignements concrets, aidant les créateurs à découvrir les meilleurs marchands, des offres lucratives et des produits pertinents pour leur public. Sur YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix, et que le monde est un meilleur endroit quand nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Nous travaillons ensemble pour donner à chacun le pouvoir de partager son histoire, d'explorer ce qu'il aime et de se connecter dans le processus. Travaillant à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'une créativité illimitée, nous agissons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous explorons de nouvelles idées, résolvons de vrais problèmes et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble. ### Responsabilités * Diriger la conception et le développement de modèles et de caractéristiques innovateurs pilotés par ML/AI. * Architecte et construit des systèmes qui intègrent profondément les LLM et d'autres technologies d'IA pour fournir des recommandations intelligentes. * Diriger les intégrations entre plusieurs partenaires de produits, sous la direction de collaborations et de partenariats solides. * Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les concepteurs d'UX, les Data Scientists et d'autres équipes d'ingénierie pour définir et livrer la feuille de route pour les capacités ML/AI. * Favoriser un environnement de collaboration.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in C++ or Python programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Deep understanding of machine learning principles to ensure algorithms perform within strict power limits.
* Maintaining a current and thorough understanding of the latest developments in Digital Signal Processors (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP), and system-on-chip (SoC) architectures to effectively leverage hardware-specific features for maximum efficiency and thermal management.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to ensure feature performance remains consistent across all use cases. You will work at the intersection of ML and system architecture, technical specialists will define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware. You will optimize the end-to-end performance of ML models to ensure compliance with strict power and thermal constraints, as the scope of the role encompasses leveraging specialized expertise in Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) and Digital Signal Processors (DSP) architectures to accelerate machine learning models while maintaining system stability and device performance standards.The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first-party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

### Responsibilities

* Utilise Digital Signal Processors (DSP) and Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) architectures to accelerate ML models while effectively minimizing thermal impact.
* Conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to maintain consistent feature performance across all use cases.
* Own the end-to-end performance optimization of models to operate within a strict power budget.
* Define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware at the intersection of ML and system architecture.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in linguaggi di programmazione C++ o Python, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. * 1 anno di esperienza con l'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, l'implementazione di modelli, la valutazione di modelli, l'elaborazione dei dati, il debug).

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati. * L'esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili. * La profonda comprensione dei principi di apprendimento automatico per garantire che gli algoritmi funzionino entro limiti di potenza rigorosi. * Mantenere una comprensione attuale e approfondita degli ultimi sviluppi nel Digital Signal Processor (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processor (HTP), e architetture system-on-chip (SoC) per sfruttare efficacemente le caratteristiche hardware-specifiche per la massima efficienza e gestione termica.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia avanti.

In questo ruolo, si condurrà rigorosa potenza di 271ng e implementare ottimizzate hardware-specifico per garantire prestazioni di funzionalità rimane coerente in tutti i casi di utilizzo. Lavorerà all'intersezione di ML e architettura di sistema, specialisti tecnici definiranno gli standard di efficienza su hardware di nuova generazione.

Ottimizzerete le prestazioni end-to-end dei modelli ML per garantire il rispetto di vincoli termici e di potenza rigorosi, poiché l'ambito del ruolo comprende l'utilizzo di competenze specializzate in architetture Hexagon Tensor 45H (HTP) e Digital Signal 45H (DSP) per accelerare i modelli di apprendimento automatico mantenendo al contempo la stabilità del sistema e gli standard di prestazioni dei dispositivi.Il team di Piattaforme e Dispositivi comprende le varie piattaforme software di calcolo di Google in ambienti (desktop, mobile, applicazioni), nonché i nostri dispositivi e servizi di prima parte che combinano il meglio dei dispositivi

Google AI, software e hardware.

I team di ricerca, progettazione e sviluppo di nuove tecnologie in questo settore rendono l'interazione dei nostri utenti con il calcolo più veloce e senza soluzione di continuità, creando esperienze innovative per i nostri utenti di tutto il mondo.

Responsabilità

* Architetture di segnale digitale da utility (DSP) e HTP (Hexagon Tensor) per accelerare i modelli ML riducendo al minimo l'impatto termico. * Condurre una potenza rigorosa di affilatura e implementare ottimizzazioni hardware-specifiche per mantenere prestazioni costanti in tutti i casi di utilizzo. * Possedere l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni end-to-end dei modelli per operare entro un budget di potenza rigoroso. * Definire gli standard di efficienza sull'hardware di prossima generazione all'intersezione di ML e architettura di sistema.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in C++ or Python programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Deep understanding of machine learning principles to ensure algorithms perform within strict power limits.
* Maintaining a current and thorough understanding of the latest developments in Digital Signal Processors (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP), and system-on-chip (SoC) architectures to effectively leverage hardware-specific features for maximum efficiency and thermal management.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to ensure feature performance remains consistent across all use cases. You will work at the intersection of ML and system architecture, technical specialists will define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware. You will optimize the end-to-end performance of ML models to ensure compliance with strict power and thermal constraints, as the scope of the role encompasses leveraging specialized expertise in Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) and Digital Signal Processors (DSP) architectures to accelerate machine learning models while maintaining system stability and device performance standards.The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first-party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

### Responsibilities

* Utilise Digital Signal Processors (DSP) and Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) architectures to accelerate ML models while effectively minimizing thermal impact.
* Conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to maintain consistent feature performance across all use cases.
* Own the end-to-end performance optimization of models to operate within a strict power budget.
* Define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware at the intersection of ML and system architecture.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereichen. * Erfahrung bei der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien. * Tiefes Verständnis der Prinzipien des maschinellen Lernens, um sicherzustellen, dass Algorithmen innerhalb strenger Leistungsgrenzen funktionieren. * Aufrechterhaltung eines aktuellen und gründlichen Verständnisses der neuesten Entwicklungen in Digital Signal Processors (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) und System-on-Chip (SoC) Architekturen, um effektiv hardwarespezifische Funktionen für maximale Effizienz und thermisches Management zu nutzen.

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion mit Informationen und anderen Menschen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Funktion führen Sie strenge Leistungsprofile durch und implementieren hardwarespezifische Optimierungen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Leistung der Funktionen in allen Anwendungsfällen konstant bleibt. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von ML und Systemarchitektur, technische Spezialisten definieren die Effizienzstandards auf Hardware der nächsten Generation.

Sie optimieren die durchgängige Leistung von ML-Modellen, um die Einhaltung strenger Leistungs- und thermischer Einschränkungen zu gewährleisten, da der Aufgabenbereich die Nutzung spezialisierter Expertise in Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) und Digital Signal Processors (DSP) Architekturen umfasst, um Modelle zum maschinellen Lernen zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig die Systemstabilität und die Leistungsstandards für Geräte zu wahren.Das Team von Platforms and Devices umfasst die verschiedenen Computersoftwareplattformen von Google in Umgebungen (Desktop, Mobilgeräte, Anwendungen) sowie unsere Geräte und Dienstleistungen von Erstanbietern, die das Beste aus der Welt vereinen.

Google AI, Software und Hardware.

In diesem Bereich forschen, entwerfen und entwickeln wir neue Technologien, um die Interaktion unserer Nutzer mit dem Rechnen schneller und nahtloser zu gestalten und innovative Erfahrungen für unsere Nutzer auf der ganzen Welt zu entwickeln.

Zuständigkeiten

* Verwenden Sie Digital Signal Processors (DSP) und Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) Architekturen, um ML Modelle zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig die thermischen Auswirkungen effektiv zu minimieren. * Führen Sie strenge Leistungsprofile und implementieren Sie hardwarespezifische Optimierungen, um konsistente Leistungsfähigkeit in allen Anwendungsfällen zu halten. * Eigene die End-to-End-Performance-Optimierung von Modellen, um innerhalb eines strengen Leistungsbudgets zu arbeiten. * Definieren Sie die Effizienzstandards auf Hardware der nächsten Generation an der Kreuzung von ML und Systemarchitektur.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 years of experience with software development in C++, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* Experience in Backend software development and Data Analysis.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

* 2 years of experience with data structures or algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

### Responsibilities

* As a Software Engineer on the YouTube Content Management System team, you will design, build, evolve, and maintain the critical systems that facilitate the interactions between YouTube and all major media companies worldwide.
* Designing and implementing global-scale systems:Work with dozens of teams across YouTube to architect and evolve the storage,indexing and serving infrastructure for YouTube’s global copyright database of billions of assets and copyright claims.
* Pushing Boundaries:Lead the integration of agentic tools to automate complex investigations and data reconciliation.
* Domain Mastery:Developing deep domain expertise is a core requirement of this role, as the copyright landscape is complex and rapidly evolving, driven by advancements in Generative AI and shifts in regulatory frameworks.

Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo condiviso per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali e ci divertiamo. E lo facciamo tutti insieme. Sie werden Softwarelösungen entwickeln, entwickeln, testen, bereitstellen, pflegen und verbessern.Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und Gemeinschaft aufbauen.Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Macht zu geben, ihre Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was sie lieben, und sich miteinander in diesem Prozess zu verbinden. Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von modernster Technologie und grenzenloser Kreativität und bewegen uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß – und wir tun es gemeinsam. Zuständigkeiten * Als Software Engineer im Team des YouTube Content Management Systems werden Sie die kritischen Systeme entwerfen, bauen, weiterentwickeln und pflegen, die die Interaktionen zwischen YouTube und allen großen Medienunternehmen weltweit erleichtern. * Entwerfen und implementieren von Systemen im globalen Maßstab: Arbeiten Sie mit Dutzenden von Teams auf YouTube, um die Speicherung, Indexierung und Bereitstellung von Infrastruktur für YouTube, die globale Copyright-Datenbank mit Milliarden von Vermögenswerten und Urheberrechtsansprüchen, zu entwerfen und zu verbessern. * Pushing Boundaries:Führen Sie die Integration von Agententools, um komplexe Untersuchungen und Datenabgleich zu automatisieren. * Domain Mastery:Die Entwicklung von Deep Domain Know-how ist eine Kernanforderung dieser Rolle, da die Copyrightlandschaft komplex und sich rasch entwickelt, angetrieben durch Fortschritte in Generative KI und Veränderungen in regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen.

Titres de compétence privilégiés: * Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou dans des domaines techniques connexes. * 2 ans d'expérience dans les structures ou algorithmes de données. * Expérience de développement de technologies accessibles. Sur le travail Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les uns avec les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie. Avec votre expertise technique, vous gérerez les priorités de projet, les échéances et les livrables.Vous concevrez, développerez, testerez, déployer, maintenir et améliorerez les solutions logicielles. Chez YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix et que le monde est un meilleur endroit lorsque nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Travaillant à l'intersection de la technologie de pointe et de la créativité sans limites, nous nous dirigeons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous étudions de nouvelles idées, résolvons des problèmes réels et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble. Responsabilités * En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel de l'équipe YouTube Content Management System, vous concevez, construisez, développez et maintenez les systèmes critiques qui facilitent les interactions entre YouTube et toutes les grandes entreprises médiatiques dans le monde. * Conception et mise en œuvre de systèmes à l'échelle mondiale :Travailler avec des dizaines d'équipes sur YouTube pour concevoir et développer l'infrastructure de stockage, d'indexation et de service pour YouTube, base de données mondiale sur les droits d'auteur de milliards d'actifs et les droits d'auteur. * Pousser les limites :Passer l'intégration d'outils d'agents pour automatiser les enquêtes complexes et la réconciliation des données. * Maîtrise du domaine : Développer une expertise profonde est une exigence essentielle de ce rôle, car le paysage du droit d'auteur est complexe et en évolution rapide, animé par les progrès dans l'IA Generative et les changements dans les cadres réglementaires.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience in program management.

* Experience with software development lifecycles and related tools such as bug trackers, software repositories, and code testing frameworks.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience in driving organizational change, including the development of new frameworks, processes, and standards for security engineering.
* Experience in evaluating the security posture of AI/ML systems, including Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and threat modeling for AI applications.
* Experience building dashboards and utilizing data-driven insights to measure security efficacy.
* Ability to understand engineering fundamentals and system architecture.
* Exceptional communication skills including experience communicating with executive stakeholders at director or VP level.

### About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

### Responsibilities

* Lead the end-to-end execution of large-scale, complex security programs, influencing strategy and driving high-impact results across multiple quarters.

* Negotiate and align priorities with executive stakeholders across engineering, product, and research, resolving conflicting goals and driving organizational consensus.
* Partner with technical leads to translate high-level security objectives into actionable technical roadmaps and project plans. Regularly communicate program status, risks, and impact to stakeholders and leadership, fostering transparency and trust.
* Monitor program health using data-driven metrics, proactively identifying roadblocks, and driving resolution to ensure adherence to milestones and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)/Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Identify opportunities to streamline engineering workflows, automate manual tasks, and improve overall operational efficiency.

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea in tecnica o esperienza pratica equivalente.

* 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei programmi.

* Esperienza con cicli di vita di sviluppo del software e relativi strumenti come bug tracker, repository software e quadri di test del codice.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Esperienza nel guidare il cambiamento organizzativo, compreso lo sviluppo di nuovi quadri, processi e standard per l'ingegneria della sicurezza. * Esperienza nella valutazione della postura di sicurezza dei sistemi AI/ML, compresi i modelli di lingua larga (LLM), flussi di lavoro di thank e la modellazione delle minacce per le applicazioni AI. * Esperienza nella costruzione di dashboard e l'utilizzo di informazioni guidate dai dati per misurare l'efficacia della sicurezza. * Capacità di capire i fondamentali ingegneristici e l'architettura di sistema.

* Capacità di comunicazione eccezionali, compresa l'esperienza di comunicazione con le parti interessate a livello di direttore o di VP.

Riguardo il lavoro

Un problema non è risolto veramente fino a quando non è risolto per tutti. That.s perché Googlers costruire prodotti che aiutano a creare opportunità per tutti, sia in fondo alla strada o in tutto il mondo. Come un responsabile tecnico di programma di Google, you.ll utilizzare la vostra competenza tecnica per condurre progetti complessi e multidisciplinari dall'inizio alla fine. You.ll lavorare con gli stakeholder per pianificare i requisiti, identificare i rischi, gestire i programmi dei progetti, e comunicare chiaramente con i partner cross-funzionali in tutta l'azienda.

Sei altrettanto a tuo agio a spiegare le analisi e le raccomandazioni del tuo team ai dirigenti, mentre stai discutendo i compromessi tecnici nello sviluppo dei prodotti con gli ingegneri.

Responsabilità

* Guidare l'esecuzione end-to-end di programmi di sicurezza su larga scala, complessi, influenzando la strategia e guidando i risultati ad alto impatto su più trimestri.

* Negoziare e allineare le priorità con gli stakeholder esecutivi attraverso l'ingegneria, il prodotto e la ricerca, risolvere obiettivi contrastanti e guidare il consenso organizzativo. * Partner con i portali tecnici per tradurre obiettivi di sicurezza di alto livello in roadmap tecnici e piani di progetto attuabili.

* Monitorare lo stato di salute dei programmi utilizzando metriche basate sui dati, identificare proattivamente i blocchi stradali e la risoluzione della guida per garantire l'aderenza alle tappe fondamentali e agli accordi di livello di servizio (SLA) / obiettivi di livello di servizio (SLO). * Identificare le opportunità di semplificare i flussi di lavoro ingegneristici, automatizzare le attività manuali e migliorare l'efficienza operativa complessiva.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience in program management.

* Experience with software development lifecycles and related tools such as bug trackers, software repositories, and code testing frameworks.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience in driving organizational change, including the development of new frameworks, processes, and standards for security engineering.
* Experience in evaluating the security posture of AI/ML systems, including Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and threat modeling for AI applications.
* Experience building dashboards and utilizing data-driven insights to measure security efficacy.
* Ability to understand engineering fundamentals and system architecture.
* Exceptional communication skills including experience communicating with executive stakeholders at director or VP level.

### About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

### Responsibilities

* Lead the end-to-end execution of large-scale, complex security programs, influencing strategy and driving high-impact results across multiple quarters.

* Negotiate and align priorities with executive stakeholders across engineering, product, and research, resolving conflicting goals and driving organizational consensus.
* Partner with technical leads to translate high-level security objectives into actionable technical roadmaps and project plans. Regularly communicate program status, risks, and impact to stakeholders and leadership, fostering transparency and trust.
* Monitor program health using data-driven metrics, proactively identifying roadblocks, and driving resolution to ensure adherence to milestones and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)/Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Identify opportunities to streamline engineering workflows, automate manual tasks, and improve overall operational efficiency.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

* 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience with C++.
* Experience with Data Analysis and Ad Quality.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

### Responsibilities

* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
* Design and implement prediction models for YouTube curated creator bundles.

Media

Esperienza di guida progressi, risolvere i problemi, e di mentoring più membri del team junior; esperienza più profonda e conoscenze applicate all'interno del settore pertinente.

Applica

Qualifiche minime:

* Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

* 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato.

* 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo completo dello stack, attraverso back-end come Java, Python, Go/lang, o C++ codebases, ed esperienza front-end tra cui JavaScript o TypeScript, HTML, CSS o equivalente.

Qualificazioni preferite:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati.

* 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi. * Esperienza con C++. * Esperienza con Analisi dati e Qualità Ad.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s ha bisogno con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e il nostro business veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il tahale, mostrare qualità di leadership ed essere entusiasti di assumere nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia in avanti. Google Ads sta aiutando a alimentare l'open internet con la migliore tecnologia che collega e crea valore per persone, editori, inserzionisti e Google.

Noi. eravamo costituiti da più team, costruendo Google.s Prodotti pubblicitari tra cui ricerca, visualizzazione, shopping, viaggi e video pubblicitari, così come analisi. I nostri team creano esperienze di fiducia tra persone e imprese con annunci utili. Aiutiamo a crescere le aziende di tutte le dimensioni da piccole imprese, a grandi marche, a creatori di YouTube, con efficaci strumenti di inserzionista che offrono risultati misurabili. Consentiamo anche a Google di impegnarsi con i clienti su scala.

Responsabilità

* Partecipare a, o condurre recensioni di design con i pari e stakeholder per decidere tra le tecnologie disponibili. * Recensione del codice sviluppato da altri sviluppatori e fornire feedback per garantire le migliori pratiche (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, checking codice in, precisione, verificabilità, ed efficienza). * Problemi di prodotto o sistema Triage e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete, o operazioni di servizio e qualità. * Progettare e implementare modelli di previsione per YouTubeaded creator bundle.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

* 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience with C++.
* Experience with Data Analysis and Ad Quality.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

### Responsibilities

* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
* Design and implement prediction models for YouTube curated creator bundles.
